descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people.

Pictet Asset Management (Pictet AM) manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service.

Pictet AM's Compliance Team is organised around three main areas: Distribution, Investment & Trading, and Core Compliance. This role is part of the Global Investment and Trading Compliance pillar based in Geneva, primarily responsible for the Global Compliance framework for Pictet AM’s investment and trading platforms (e.g. best execution, market abuse, gatekeeping, e-coms recording and monitoring and related training). The role reports directly to the Head of Investment & Trading Compliance.

Your role

• Establishing and upholding our Global Investment & Trading Compliance Governance Framework, while promoting a culture of positive compliance throughout Pictet AM.
• Performing and supervising the execution of the Compliance Monitoring Plan (CMP) for Pictet AM, ensuring the timely completion of associated tasks, and reporting to boards, committees, and Senior Management.
• Defining, updating and maintaining Investment & Trading Compliance Framework and policies.
• Analysing the effect of Pictet AM new business initiatives and investment products on the CMP.
• Monitoring Best Execution ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
• Supporting the Gatekeeper within Equity and Fixed Income, ensuring compliance with Pictet AM Gatekeeper policies and procedures.
• Serving as the primary point of contact for all Investment and Trading Compliance related inquiries and issues, providing expert guidance and support to internal teams and
external stakeholders.
• Monitoring industry-wide compliance initiatives as well as global regulatory developments and conduct analyses as to how such developments impact Pictet AM.
• Conducting comprehensive and periodic thematic reviews, and control testing to continuously strengthen our compliance framework.
• Supporting the broader compliance team to ensure continuity of compliance related activities as and when required.

Your profile

• Proven experience in an asset management firm and sound knowledge of the financial services sector.
• Knowledge of FINMA, SEC, FCA, ESMA and EU rules and regulations is a plus with willingness to learn.
• Effective analytical and organisational skills and strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to investigate issues, proactively problem solve and handle multiple tasks with attention to detail working to strict deadlines.
• Team player and ability to build positive relationships across the business internally and externally and commitment to contributing to a strong compliance culture within the firm.
• Strong judgement, integrity, and professional demeanour that instils confidence in others.
• Desire to take ownership of and manage own workload to a high standard.
• Tech-savvy, you will be comfortable adjusting to new systems and operating at an expert user level with MS Office applications.
• Experience in programming languages such as Python, SQL, VBA would be a plus.
• Fluency in English and French.
• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

Ref: ITCO/CT/RH

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

La tua squadra

Pictet Asset Management gestisce i beni di alcune delle più grandi istituzioni del mondo, intermediari finanziari e dei loro clienti. La nostra cultura accoglie pensatori e centri indipendenti intorno all'eccellenza degli investimenti, una prospettiva a lungo termine e una dedizione al servizio clienti.

Stiamo cercando di assumere un ingegnere software altamente motivato e imprenditoriale per il nostro dipartimento di Equities. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di costruire strumenti innovativi che trasformino i dati di sostenibilità complessi in insight attuabili per decisioni finanziarie responsabili. In qualità di membro del team di alto impatto, si prenderanno la proprietà di progettare e costruire questi sistemi intuitivi e end-to-end.

Il tuo ruolo

• Progettazione, costruzione e mantenimento di applicazioni web end-to-end, tra cui front-end, back-end e livelli di database.

• Implementare le capacità di AI agentic in strumenti di contenuto e l'adozione di flussi di lavoro AI e le migliori pratiche.

• Collaborare con team interfunzionali per progettare intuitivi UI di alta qualità che rendono i dati complessi facili da capire e navigare.

Il tuo profilo

• Provata esperienza nella costruzione di un grande prodotto o 7+ anni di esperienza professionale.

• Adottatore precoce di pratiche ingegneristiche agentiche, con una forte presa dell'attuale ecosistema AI (frameworks, tooling e workflow).

• Fondamenti a tutto campo forti: React, TypeScript/JavaScript sul frontend; API Python e REST/GraphQL sul backend; database SQL e NoSQL.

• Hands-on esperienza di distribuzione e soluzioni operative end-to-end (idealmente in AWS), tra cui l'ingestione dei dati, la trasformazione e il servizio, con pratiche solide intorno a test, versione e osservabilità.

• UnitÃ imprenditoriale e una mentalità analitica affilata, con la capacitÃ di dilagare rapidamente su nuovi domini, strumenti e tecniche attraverso l'autoapprendimento.

• Fluente in inglese.

• Deve essere residente in Svizzera o disposto a trasferirsi.

Cosa offriamo

• La piena proprietà di un prodotto strategico da una fase iniziale, modellando le sue capacità di architettura, flusso di dati e intelligenza artificiale.

• Un ambiente che incoraggia sperimentazione, innovazione e apprendimento continuo.

• Una stretta collaborazione con ingegneri esperti e utenti non tecnici.

• Disposizioni di lavoro flessibili e ambiente di lavoro di alta qualità.

Nota

Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie.

REF.: FSE/CM/VK

Diversità e inclusione

Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione nel posto di lavoro.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

Pictet Asset Management manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service.

We are seeking to hire a highly motivated and entrepreneurial Software Engineer for our Equities department. Our goal is to build innovative tools that transform complex sustainability data into actionable insights for responsible financial decisions. As an early, high-impact member of the team, you will take ownership of architecting and building these intuitive, end-to-end systems.

Your role

• Designing, building and maintaining end-to-end web applications, including front-end, back-end, and database layers.

• Implementing agentic AI capabilities into content tools and drive adoption of AI workflows and best practices.

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to design intuitive high-quality UIs that make complex data easy to understand and navigate.

Your profile

• Proven experience in building a great product or 7+ years of professional experience.

• Early adopter of agentic engineering practices, with a strong grasp of the current AI ecosystem (frameworks, tooling, and workflows).

• Strong full-stack fundamentals: React, TypeScript/JavaScript on the frontend; Python and REST/GraphQL APIs on the backend; SQL and NoSQL databases.

• Hands-on experience deploying and operating solutions end-to-end (ideally in AWS), including data ingestion, transformation, and serving, with solid practices around testing, versioning, and observability.

• Entrepreneurial drive and a sharp analytical mindset, with the ability to quickly ramp up on new domains, tools, and techniques through self-learning.

• Fluent in English.

• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

What we offer

• Full ownership of a strategic product from an early stage, shaping its architecture, data flows, and AI capabilities.

• An environment that encourages experimentation, innovation, and continuous learning.

• Close collaboration with experienced engineers and non-technical users.

• Flexible working arrangements and high quality working environment.

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

REF.: FSE/CM/VK

descriptionByLocale.de:
Dein Team

Pictet Asset Management verwaltet die Vermögenswerte einiger der weltweit größten Institutionen, Finanzintermediäre und deren Kunden. Unsere Kultur begrüßt unabhängige Denker und konzentriert sich auf Investitionsexzellenz, eine langfristige Perspektive und ein Engagement für den Kundenservice.

Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten und unternehmerischen Software Engineer für unsere Equities-Abteilung. Unser Ziel ist es, innovative Tools zu entwickeln, die komplexe Nachhaltigkeitsdaten in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse für verantwortungsvolle Finanzentscheidungen verwandeln. Als frühes, einflussreiches Mitglied des Teams übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Architektur und den Aufbau dieser intuitiven End-to-End-Systeme.

Deine Rolle

• Entwerfen, Erstellen und Pflegen von End-to-End-Webanwendungen, einschließlich Front-End-, Back-End- und Datenbankschichten.

• Implementierung agentischer KI-Fähigkeiten in Content-Tools und Förderung der Einführung von KI-Workflows und Best Practices.

• Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, um intuitive, hochwertige Benutzeroberflächen zu entwerfen, die komplexe Daten einfach zu verstehen und zu navigieren machen.

Dein Profil

• Bewährte Erfahrung im Aufbau eines großartigen Produkts oder 7+ Jahre Berufserfahrung.

• Early Adopter von Agentic Engineering-Praktiken, mit einem starken Verständnis des aktuellen KI-Ökosystems (Frameworks, Tools und Workflows).

• Starke Full-Stack-Grundlagen: React, TypeScript/JavaScript im Frontend; Python und REST/GraphQL APIs im Backend; SQL und NoSQL Datenbanken.

• Hands-on-Erfahrung bei der Bereitstellung und dem Betrieb von End-to-End-Lösungen (idealerweise in AWS), einschließlich Datenaufnahme, -transformation und -service, mit soliden Praktiken rund um Testen, Versionierung und Beobachtbarkeit.

• Unternehmerischer Antrieb und eine scharfe analytische Denkweise, mit der Fähigkeit, neue Domänen, Werkzeuge und Techniken durch Selbstlernen schnell zu nutzen.

• fließend in Englisch.

• Muss in der Schweiz ansässig oder bereit sein, umzuziehen.

Was wir bieten

• Voller Besitz eines strategischen Produkts von einem frühen Stadium, die Gestaltung seiner Architektur, Datenflüsse und KI-Fähigkeiten.

• Eine Umgebung, die Experimente, Innovationen und kontinuierliches Lernen fördert.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren und nicht-technischen Anwendern.

• Flexible Arbeitsvereinbarungen und hochwertige Arbeitsumgebung.

Anmerkung:

Wir werden keine CVs über Agenturen akzeptieren.

REF: FSE/CM/VK

Vielfalt & Inklusion

Pictet ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit und engagiert sich für die Schaffung eines vielfältigen Umfelds. Wir respektieren alle Menschen und suchen ihre Einbeziehung in den Arbeitsplatz.

Votre équipe

Pictet Asset Management gère les actifs de certaines des plus grandes institutions du monde, des intermédiaires financiers et de leurs clients. Notre culture accueille des penseurs indépendants et des centres autour de l'excellence en investissement, d'une perspective à long terme et d'un dévouement au service à la clientèle.

Nous cherchons à embaucher un ingénieur logiciel hautement motivé et entrepreneurial pour notre département Equities. Notre objectif est de mettre au point des outils novateurs qui transforment des données complexes sur la durabilité en idées pratiques pour des décisions financières responsables. En tant que membre de l'équipe à haut impact, vous serez propriétaire de l'architecture et de la construction de ces systèmes de bout en bout intuitifs.

Votre rôle

• Conception, construction et maintenance d'applications Web de bout en bout, y compris les couches front-end, back-end et base de données.

• Mettre en œuvre des capacités d'intelligence artificielle dans les outils de contenu et favoriser l'adoption de flux de travail et de pratiques exemplaires en matière d'intelligence artificielle.

• Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour concevoir des interfaces intuitives de haute qualité qui rendent les données complexes faciles à comprendre et à naviguer.

Votre profil

• Expérience éprouvée dans la construction d'un excellent produit ou 7+ ans d'expérience professionnelle.

• L'adoption précoce de pratiques d'ingénierie agentique, avec une forte compréhension de l'écosystème actuel de l'IA (cadres, outillage et workflows).

• Solides fondamentaux : Réagir, TypeScript/JavaScript sur le frontend ; API Python et REST/GraphQL sur les bases de données SQL et NoSQL.

• Expérience pratique du déploiement et de l'exploitation des solutions de bout en bout (idéalement dans les SSFE), y compris l'ingestion de données, la transformation et le service, avec des pratiques solides en matière de test, de version et d'observabilité.

• Une dynamique entrepreneuriale et un état d'esprit analytique aigu, avec la capacité d'augmenter rapidement sur de nouveaux domaines, outils et techniques par l'auto-apprentissage.

• En anglais.

• Il doit résider en Suisse ou vouloir déménager.

Ce que nous offrons

• La pleine propriété d'un produit stratégique dès le début, façonnant son architecture, ses flux de données et ses capacités d'IA.

• Un environnement qui encourage l'expérimentation, l'innovation et l'apprentissage continu.

• Collaboration étroite avec des ingénieurs expérimentés et des utilisateurs non techniques.

• Des modalités de travail flexibles et un environnement de travail de haute qualité.

Remarque

Nous n'accepterons aucun CV par l'intermédiaire d'agences.

REF: FSE/CM/VK

Pictet est un employeur à chances égales et s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Nous respectons toutes les personnes et nous cherchons à les inclure dans le milieu de travail.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra

Unisciti alla nostra sede europea di Bank Pictet & Cie (Europe) AG (BPAG) a Francoforte sul Meno, in quanto stiamo cercando un motivato Working Student Financial Risk Management (m/f/d) per sostenere le nostre iniziative strategiche e business quotidiano esclusivamente in loco a Francoforte sul Meno.

BPAG è un istituto finanziario leader con una forte presenza in tutta Europa, sedi operative in Lussemburgo, Spagna, Monaco, Francia, Italia e Regno Unito. Questa è un'occasione emozionante per contribuire a progetti d'impatto all'interno di un ambiente collaborativo e internazionale nel cuore del nostro ufficio di Francoforte.

Se siete appassionati di Financial Risk Management e desiderosi di fare la differenza in una prestigiosa organizzazione paneuropea, non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione.

Il tuo ruolo

Scopri e supporta/contribuisci a:

• Esecuzione e automazione dei processi di controllo relativi alle diverse attività della Banca.

• Rischio finanziario e non finanziario modellazione e test di stress.

• Miglioramento e automazione della segnalazione dei rischi.

• Analizzare su nuove metriche di rischio, nuovi prodotti/servizi, miglioramenti della metodologia di rischio e -implementazioni.

Il tuo profilo

• Senior BSc o uno studente di MSc in un campo di studio preferibilmente quantitativo, ad esempio, economia quantitativa, finanza quantitativa / gestione del rischio, tecnologia finanziaria, scienza applicata dei dati, analisi di business computazionale, o equivalente.

• Forte capacità di codifica (ad esempio Python, VBA).

• Ottima conoscenza della suite Microsoft Office.

• La fluidità in tedesco o francese vicino all'inglese, sarebbe un vantaggio.

• Forte capacità analitiche e di comunicazione.

• Problema-solving mentalità e focalizzato sul lavoro di squadra e la collaborazione.

• Affidabile e affidabile.

• Ti piace lavorare in un ambiente multiculturale e multilingue.

Nota

A Pictet, troverete più di una semplice posizione, scoprirete un'occasione unica per contribuire a un'importante banca privata rinomata per la sua tradizione di indipendenza, pensiero a lungo termine, partnership, responsabilità e spirito imprenditoriale.

Vi invitiamo a unirvi al nostro team impegnato e collaborativo e non esitate ad accogliervi a Pictet.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

Join our European headquarters of Bank Pictet & Cie (Europe) AG (BPAG) in Frankfurt am Main as we are seeking a motivated Working Student Financial Risk Management (m/f/d) to support our strategic initiatives and daily business exclusively on site in Frankfurt am Main.

BPAG is a leading financial institution with a strong presence across Europe, operating branches in Luxembourg, Spain, Monaco, France, Italy and the UK. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to impactful projects within a collaborative, international environment at the heart of our Frankfurt office.

If you are passionate about Financial Risk Management and eager to make a difference in a prestigious, pan-European organization, we look forward to your application.

Your role

Learn about and support/contribute to:

• Execution and automation of control processes related to the Bank’s different activities.

• Financial and non-financial risk modelling and stress testing.

• Enhancement and automation of risk reporting.

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet Tech division specializes in designing and integrating cutting-edge software applications, including advanced portfolio management systems, sophisticated trading platforms, and comprehensive banking and corporate solutions. As a key contributor to the Group’s strategic advancements, the division plays a vital role in driving transformative innovations that enhance our services and deliver exceptional value to our clients.

We are seeking a DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer to strengthen the reliability and performance of the bank’s strategic application processes through an advanced monitoring and observability framework across both on-premises and cloud environments. Monitoring is designed and implemented in close cooperation with software engineering teams in order to track end-to-end application chains. Industrialize application and business‑process deployments by designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure production releases and a stable IT production environment.. Participation in a periodic 24/7 on-call shift is required.

Your role

• Provide support to operations teams. Lead post-incident reviews, including Root Cause Analysis and post-mortems. Define and track preventive action plans.

• Collaborate with business and technical teams to align system reliability with operational needs and produce clear operational documentation.

• Industrialize and standardize the deployment of applications and business processes through automated CI/CD pipelines.

• Design, implement and maintain monitoring and observability solutions for business processes, including dashboards, reliability indicators, alerting and end-to-end flow traceability, with advanced use of the Grafana Observability Stack across on-premises systems and cloud services.

• Analyze business-process performance and recommend improvements.

• Integrate new processing tasks into the production schedule and/or optimize existing ones.

• Configure and implement data transfers with external partners, ensuring reliability, traceability and end-to-end monitoring.

• Contribute to the cloud strategy, including deployments, scalability, resilience, disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

• Automate recurring tasks through scripts, workflows and tooling in collaboration with development and operations teams

• Ensure compliance with regulatory and data-protection requirements.

Your profile

• Master's degree / Engineering degree in Computer science

• Fluent in french and english

• Minimum 7 years of experience in a similar role, ideally within a banking environment or fund administration

• Strong expertise in monitoring and observability tools, as well as distributed tracing concepts (Grafana, Dynatrace, Jaeger).

• Good knowledge of cloud environments from major providers (AWS, Azure, or equivalent), with a sound understanding of IaaS, PaaS and SaaS service models.

• Solid knowledge enabling effective use of Kubernetes and Docker infrastructures, including operations, scaling and monitoring.

• Familiarity with DevOps concepts and Site Reliability Engineering practices, including reliability indicators, capacity management and scalability.

• Good command of SQL and ability to work with data in Oracle, PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) databases, as well as sound knowledge of Prometheus for metrics collection and analysis.

• Good knowledge of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change and Configuration Management), with the ability to apply them pragmatically in a critical IT production environment.

• Understanding of business processes related to fund administration / transfer agency and the associated regulatory framework.

La tua squadra

Le funzioni aziendali includono le attività non bancarie del Gruppo e impiega oltre 900 persone. Queste funzioni sono svolte da specialisti con competenze in tutte le unità aziendali e includono le Comunicazioni, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legale, Risk, Strategy & Projects e dipartimenti fiscali.

Ti unirai al Risk & Compliance Data Office, che mira ad essere il partner affidabile e innovativo dei dati per la comunità Risk & Compliance del Gruppo. L'unità abilita il processo decisionale informato e la gestione del rischio proattiva attraverso tecnologie all'avanguardia, piattaforme scalabili e dati di alta qualità. La sua missione è quella di fornire soluzioni di dati affidabili, ben governate e previsionali che soddisfino i requisiti normativi in evoluzione, favoriscano le intuizioni basate sui dati e consentono un processo decisionale sicuro e strategico.

Questa posizione si concentrerà inizialmente più fortemente sull'ingegneria dei dati, supportando l'evoluzione delle piattaforme di dati Risk & Compliance e la migrazione di dati e funzionalità di analisi a Snowflake. Come per tutti gli ingegneri di analisi, il ruolo dovrebbe evolversi nel tempo in risposta alle esigenze aziendali e alle priorità del team.

Il tuo ruolo

• Lavorare con i responsabili del rischio, gli agenti di conformità e la leadership esecutiva per tradurre obiettivi strategici e requisiti normativi in prodotti di dati robusti e di alta qualità, tra cui analisi, dashboard e soluzioni di reporting.
• Agire come consulente di dati di fiducia per le parti interessate, fornire guida e supporto per garantire un uso efficace di analisi e reportistica, traducendo i requisiti aziendali ambigui in specifiche tecniche chiare e attuabili.
• Prendendo la proprietà end-to-end di temi aziendali guidando proattivamente iniziative che allineano le soluzioni di dati con le esigenze aziendali e di fornire valore misurabile, dalla fonte di dati alla comprensione esecutiva.
• Sviluppare l'architettura e gestire la catena del valore end-to-end per i verticali dei dati di rischio e di conformità, assicurando che i risultati di analisi e report possano essere utilizzati in tutto il Gruppo.
• Progettare e implementare metriche precise e corrette e dashboard interattivi che si allineano al controllo normativo e supportano la postura strategica del Gruppo.
• Guidare l'ammodernamento e lo snellimento della logica aziendale legacy migrando e automatizzando le soluzioni nelle moderne architetture di dati e piattaforme cloud, oltre a implementare approcci innovativi, come l'AI, gli agenti intelligenti e l'automazione, per migliorare le capacità di analisi.
• Garantire una rigorosa qualità dei dati e controlli in linea con il quadro di governance dei dati del Gruppo al fine di mantenere l'integrità dei dati di rischio e conformità mission-critical.
• Gestire richieste ad hoc ad-sensibili ad alto volume, tempo e complesse relazioni normative in modo autonomo e resiliente.
• Impegnarsi attivamente con gli stakeholder per anticipare le loro esigenze, identificare le opportunità per migliorare i dati e sostenere le migliori pratiche nell'analisi e nella reportistica.
• Contribuire a iniziative interfunzionali per allineare la comunità Risk & Compliance e il Gruppo sulla governance dei dati, la strategia dei dati, l'alfabetizzazione dei dati e le migliori pratiche.

Il tuo profilo

• Un master in Data Analytics, Informatica, Finanza, Ingegneria o un campo correlato. Certificazioni avanzate (ad esempio FRM o CFA) sarebbero un vantaggio.
• Almeno cinque anni di esperienza in un ruolo di dati ad alto impatto, come Data Engineering, Data Analytics o AI/ML, comprese le competenze pratiche.
• Competenza a livello di esperti in SQL e Python, tra cui la progettazione, la manutenzione e l'orchestrazione dei moderni flussi di lavoro ETL/ELT.
• L'esperienza con Snowflake e le moderne piattaforme di dati cloud-based sarebbe un bene forte.

Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 900 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units and include the Communications, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Risk, Strategy & Projects, and Tax departments.

You will join the Risk & Compliance Data Office, which aims to be the trusted and innovative data partner for the Group’s Risk & Compliance community. The unit empowers informed decision making and proactive risk management through cutting edge technology, scalable platforms and high-quality data. Its mission is to deliver reliable, well-governed and forward-looking data solutions that meet evolving regulatory requirements, foster data driven insights and enable confident, strategic decision making.

This position will initially focus more strongly on data engineering, supporting the evolution of Risk & Compliance data platforms and the migration of data and analytics capabilities to Snowflake. As with all Analytics Engineers, the role is expected to evolve over time in response to business needs and team priorities.

Your role

• Working with risk managers, compliance officers and executive leadership to translate strategic goals and regulatory requirements into robust, high-quality data products, including analytics, dashboards and reporting solutions.
• Acting as a trusted data advisor to stakeholders, providing guidance and support to ensure effective use of analytics and reporting, while translating ambiguous business requirements into clear, actionable technical specifications.
• Taking end-to-end ownership of business themes by proactively driving initiatives that align data solutions with business needs and deliver measurable value, from data source to executive insight.
• Developing the architecture and managing the end-to-end value chain for risk and compliance data verticals, ensuring that the resulting analytics and reports can be used across the Group.
• Designing and rolling out precise, executive-ready metrics and interactive dashboards that stand up to regulatory scrutiny and support the Group’s strategic risk posture.
• Driving the modernisation and streamlining of legacy business logic by migrating and automating solutions into modern data architectures and cloud platforms, as well as implementing innovative approaches, such as AI, intelligent agents and automation, to enhance analytics capabilities.
• Ensuring rigorous data quality and controls in line with the Group's data governance framework in order to maintain the integrity of mission-critical risk and compliance data.
• Managing high-volume, time-sensitive ad hoc requests and complex regulatory reports autonomously and resiliently.
• Proactively engaging with stakeholders to anticipate their needs, identifying opportunities for data-driven improvements and championing best practices in analytics and reporting.
• Contributing to cross-functional initiatives to align the Risk & Compliance community and the Group on data governance, data strategy, data literacy and best practices.

Your profile

• A master’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Engineering or a related field. Advanced certifications (e.g. FRM or CFA) would be a plus.
• At least five years’ experience in a high impact data role, such as Data Engineering, Data Analytics or AI/ML, including hands-on expertise.
• Expert-level proficiency in SQL and Python, including the design, maintenance and orchestration of modern ETL/ELT workflows.
• Experience with Snowflake and modern cloud-based data platforms would be a strong asset.
• Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms such as Tableau, Power BI or equivalent.
• Knowledge of risk management, compliance, banking operations and/or regulatory reporting would be an advantage.
• Entrepreneurial and “can‑do” attitude, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast‑paced matrix environment.
• Strong communication, problem solving, organisational, interpersonal and project management skills.
• Excellent command of French and English, both written and spoken.
• Must be resident in Switzerland, or willing to relocate.

Seine Mission ist es, zuverlässige, gut verwaltete und zukunftsweisende Datenlösungen zu liefern, die sich ändernden regulatorischen Anforderungen entsprechen, datengetriebene Erkenntnisse fördern und eine zuverlässige, strategische Entscheidungsfindung ermöglichen.

Diese Position wird sich zunächst stärker auf Data Engineering konzentrieren und die Entwicklung von Risk & Compliance-Datenplattformen und die Migration von Daten- und Analysefunktionen zu Snowflake unterstützen. Wie bei allen Analytics Engineers wird erwartet, dass sich die Rolle im Laufe der Zeit als Reaktion auf Geschäftsanforderungen und Teamprioritäten weiterentwickelt.

Deine Rolle

• Zusammenarbeit mit Risikomanagern, Compliance Officers und Führungskräften, um strategische Ziele und regulatorische Anforderungen in robuste, qualitativ hochwertige Datenprodukte zu übersetzen, einschließlich Analysen, Dashboards und Berichtslösungen.

• Gewährleistung einer strengen Datenqualität und -kontrollen im Einklang mit dem Data-Governance-Rahmenwerk der Gruppe, um die Integrität der unternehmenskritischen Risiko- und Compliance-Daten zu gewährleisten.

Les fonctions corporatives comprennent les activités non bancaires du Groupe et emploient plus de 900 personnes. Ces fonctions sont exercées par des spécialistes spécialisés dans toutes les unités opérationnelles et comprennent les services des communications, de la conformité, des finances, des ressources humaines, de la sécurité de l'information, de la vérification interne, du droit, du risque, de la stratégie et des projets, et des services fiscaux.

Vous rejoindrez le Risk & Compliance Data Office, qui a pour objectif d'être le partenaire de confiance et d'innovation pour la communauté Risk & Compliance du Groupe. L'unité permet une prise de décision éclairée et une gestion proactive des risques grâce à une technologie de pointe, à des plates-formes évolutives et à des données de haute qualité. Sa mission est d'offrir des solutions de données fiables, bien gérées et tournées vers l'avenir qui répondent à des exigences réglementaires changeantes, de favoriser des connaissances fondées sur les données et de permettre la prise de décisions stratégiques confiantes.

Cette position se concentrera d'abord plus fortement sur l'ingénierie des données, en soutenant l'évolution des plateformes de données de risque et de conformité et la migration des capacités de données et d'analyse vers Snowflake. Comme pour tous les ingénieurs en analyse, le rôle devrait évoluer au fil du temps pour répondre aux besoins opérationnels et aux priorités de l'équipe.

Votre rôle

• Collaborer avec les gestionnaires des risques, les agents de conformité et les dirigeants pour traduire les objectifs stratégiques et les exigences réglementaires en produits de données robustes et de haute qualité, y compris les analyses, les tableaux de bord et les solutions de rapport.
• En tant que conseiller en données de confiance auprès des intervenants, fournir des conseils et du soutien pour assurer une utilisation efficace de l'analyse et des rapports, tout en traduisant les exigences opérationnelles ambiguës en spécifications techniques claires et réalisables.
• S'approprier de bout en bout les thèmes d'affaires en prenant des initiatives proactives qui harmonisent les solutions de données avec les besoins de l'entreprise et fournissent une valeur mesurable, de la source des données à la vision de la direction.
• Développer l'architecture et gérer la chaîne de valeur de bout en bout pour les verticales de données de risque et de conformité, en veillant à ce que les analyses et les rapports qui en résultent puissent être utilisés dans l'ensemble du Groupe.
• Conception et déploiement de mesures précises, prêtes à l'exécution et de tableaux de bord interactifs qui résistent à l'examen réglementaire et soutiennent la posture de risque stratégique du Groupe.
• Favoriser la modernisation et la rationalisation de la logique commerciale existante en migrant et en automatisant des solutions dans des architectures de données modernes et des plateformes cloud, ainsi que la mise en œuvre d'approches innovantes, telles que l'IA, les agents intelligents et l'automatisation, pour améliorer les capacités d'analyse.
• Assurer une qualité et un contrôle rigoureux des données conformément au cadre de gouvernance des données du Groupe afin de préserver l'intégrité des données sur les risques et la conformité critiques pour la mission.
• Gérer de façon autonome et résiliente les demandes ponctuelles et les rapports réglementaires complexes en volume élevé.
• Collaboration proactive avec les intervenants pour anticiper leurs besoins, cerner les possibilités d'améliorations fondées sur les données et promouvoir les pratiques exemplaires en matière d'analyse et de rapport.
• Contribuer aux initiatives interfonctionnelles visant à harmoniser la communauté des risques et de la conformité et le Groupe sur la gouvernance des données, la stratégie en matière de données, la littératie des données et les pratiques exemplaires.

Votre profil

• Maîtrise en analyse des données, informatique, finance, génie ou un domaine connexe. Les certifications avancées (p. ex. FRM ou FCA) seraient un plus.
• Au moins cinq ans d'expérience dans un rôle de données à impact élevé, comme Data Engineering, Data Analytics ou AI/ML, y compris une expertise pratique.
• Compétences de niveau expert en SQL et Python, y compris la conception, la maintenance et l'orchestration de flux de travail ETL/ELT modernes.
• L'expérience avec Snowflake et les plateformes de données modernes basées sur le cloud serait un atout important.
• Expérience de l'information commerciale et des plateformes de rapport comme Tableau, Power BI ou équivalent.
• La connaissance de la gestion des risques, de la conformité, des opérations bancaires et/ou des rapports réglementaires serait un avantage.
• Entrepreneuriel et attitude «can‐do» avec la capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et collaborative dans un environnement matriciel à rythme rapide.
• Des compétences solides en communication, résolution de problèmes, organisation, relations interpersonnelles et gestion de projets.
• Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, écrit et parlé.
• Il doit résider en Suisse ou vouloir déménager.

Stiamo cercando un esperto esperto di tasse per aderire al nostro team Tax Operations Advisory su base temporanea. Il tuo ruolo

• Fornire competenze su tutti i processi operativi relativi alla ritenuta fiscale e ai pagamenti su conti, dichiarazione fiscale alle autorità e reporting fiscale per i clienti spagnoli. Fornire competenze sul reporting fiscale per i clienti belgi.
• Controllare ed eseguire controlli sulle attività di reportistica fiscale, emettere raccomandazioni, e garantire il loro follow-up e implementazione.
• Assicurarsi che le regole fiscali siano correttamente applicate all'interno della nostra configurazione operativa.
• Monitorare gli sviluppi del diritto tributario e dei regolamenti e valutare il loro impatto sui nostri servizi fiscali e reporting.
• Prendere un ruolo attivo nelle iniziative di trasformazione che sfruttano l'IA.

• Laurea magistrale in economia o diritto, o equivalente background professionale.
• Almeno 5 anni in un ruolo fiscale simile, idealmente con esperienza di audit.
• Forte competenza nel reporting fiscale spagnolo per le persone e le aziende.
• Conoscenza profonda di prodotti finanziari complessi (attivo privato, derivati, prodotti strutturati) da una prospettiva fiscale, e l'esperienza con la loro configurazione operativa nei sistemi bancari.

• Eccellente capacità di scrittura, comunicazione e presentazione.
• Prove capacità di leadership e capacità di influenzare e collaborare con gli stakeholder.
• In grado di lavorare sia indipendentemente che come parte di un team, sotto pressione temporale e con alta precisione.
• Sono necessarie fluidità in inglese e una conoscenza di lavoro dello spagnolo; il francese è un bene.
• Tech-savvy e confortevole lavorare con strumenti e dati AI.
• Deve essere residente in Svizzera.

Unire le operazioni fiscali significa lavorare al centro del quadro normativo e di assistenza clienti della Banca, dove la vostra esperienza supporta direttamente la fiducia dei clienti, l’eccellenza operativa e la reputazione del Gruppo con le autorità fiscali.

Your team

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.
The Tax Operations Department in Geneva is the Group’s centre of expertise for operational tax. We provide private clients with comprehensive tax reporting, while ensuring the Bank complies with global tax regulations (FATCA/QI, CRS, Swiss and EU tax rules) and maintains strong relationships with tax authorities.
We are seeking an experienced tax expert to join our Tax Operations Advisory team on a temporary basis. This team identifies relevant tax rules, supports internal teams with their implementation, and provides ongoing support and regulatory monitoring across all Tax Operations activities.

Your role

• Provide expertise on all operational processes related to withholding tax and payments on accounts, tax declaration to authorities and tax reporting for Spanish clients. Provide expertise on tax reporting for Belgian clients.
• Oversee and perform controls on tax reporting production activities, issue recommendations, and ensure their follow-up and implementation.
• Ensure tax rules are correctly applied within our operational setup.
• Monitor developments in tax law and regulations and assess their impact on our tax services and reporting.
• Take an active role in transformation initiatives leveraging AI.

Your profile

• Master’s degree in economics or law, or equivalent professional background.
• At least 5 years in a similar tax role, ideally with audit experience.
• Strong expertise in Spanish tax reporting for individuals and companies.
• Deep knowledge of complex financial products (private assets, derivatives, structured products) from a tax perspective, and experience with their operational setup in banking systems.
• Ability to translate legal texts into practical operational requirements.
• Excellent writing, communication and presentation skills.
• Proven leadership skills and ability to influence and collaborate with stakeholders.
• Able to work both independently and as part of a team, under time pressure and with high accuracy.
• Fluency in English and a working knowledge of Spanish are required; French is an asset.
• Tech‑savvy and comfortable working with AI tools and data.
• Must be resident in Switzerland.

Joining Tax Operations means working at the core of the Bank’s regulatory and client servicing framework, where your expertise directly supports client trust, operational excellence and the Group’s reputation with tax authorities.

• Technisch versiertes und komfortables Arbeiten mit KI-Tools und Daten.
• Muss in der Schweiz wohnen.

Der Beitritt zu Tax Operations bedeutet, im Kern des regulatorischen und Kundenservice-Rahmens der Bank zu arbeiten, wo Ihre Expertise das Vertrauen der Kunden, die operative Exzellenz und den Ruf der Gruppe bei den Steuerbehörden direkt unterstützt.

Nous cherchons un expert fiscal expérimenté pour rejoindre temporairement notre équipe consultative des opérations fiscales. Cette équipe détermine les règles fiscales pertinentes, appuie les équipes internes dans leur mise en oeuvre et fournit un soutien continu et une surveillance réglementaire dans toutes les activités des opérations fiscales.

Votre rôle

• Fournir une expertise sur tous les processus opérationnels liés à la retenue à la source et aux paiements sur comptes, déclaration fiscale aux autorités et déclaration fiscale pour les clients espagnols. Fournir une expertise en matière de déclaration fiscale aux clients belges.
• Superviser et contrôler les activités de production de déclarations fiscales, formuler des recommandations et assurer leur suivi et leur mise en oeuvre.
• Assurez-vous que les règles fiscales sont correctement appliquées dans notre configuration opérationnelle.
• Surveiller l'évolution de la législation et de la réglementation fiscales et évaluer leur incidence sur nos services fiscaux et nos déclarations.
• Participer activement aux initiatives de transformation en tirant parti de l'IA.

Votre profil

• Maîtrise en économie ou en droit, ou formation professionnelle équivalente.
• Au moins 5 ans dans un rôle fiscal similaire, idéalement avec l'expérience de la vérification.
• Forte expertise en matière de déclaration fiscale espagnole pour les particuliers et les entreprises.
• Connaissance approfondie des produits financiers complexes (actifs privés, dérivés, produits structurés) du point de vue fiscal, et expérience de leur configuration opérationnelle dans les systèmes bancaires.
• Capacité de traduire les textes juridiques en exigences opérationnelles pratiques.
• Excellentes compétences en écriture, communication et présentation.
• Compétences et capacité éprouvées en leadership pour influencer et collaborer avec les intervenants.
• Capable de travailler à la fois indépendamment et en équipe, sous pression de temps et avec une grande précision.
• Une maîtrise de l'anglais et une connaissance pratique de l'espagnol sont nécessaires; le français est un atout.
• Tech‐savy et confortable de travailler avec les outils et les données d'IA.
• Il doit résider en Suisse.

Rejoindre les Opérations fiscales signifie travailler au cœur du cadre de réglementation et de service à la clientèle de la Banque, où votre expertise soutient directement la confiance des clients, l'excellence opérationnelle et la réputation du Groupe auprès des autorités fiscales.

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Today, FPS Europe employs around 200 staff in Luxembourg and is seeking to recruit a Transfer Agent for Daily and Late Shift position.

Your role

As part of the Transfer Agent unit and more specifically the Dealing Team, your main role will be to manage the daily execution of transactions (subscriptions, redemptions, transfers, switches, reports) on UCI shares, as well as for monitoring transactions until settlement.

Daily shift is starting around from 8.00am to 6pm base on the daily activity.

Late shift is starting around from 1.00pm to 10pm base on the daily activity.

Responsibilities:

• Entering and checking orders for UCI share subscriptions/redemptions, transfers and conversions.

• Recording and monitoring cash and fund securities transactions together with the Reconciliation unit of the custody bank.

• Preparing and sending out confirmations and reporting (on fund flows) to promoters, distributors and other fund intermediaries.

• Understanding and booking corporate actions (issues, splits, mergers, liquidations, etc.).

• Responding to different requests from clients (inside and outside the Group) to guarantee that a quality service is provided that meets the requirements of demanding clients.

• Managing client commissions for in-house and third-party funds.

Your profile

Qualifications and experience:

• University degree (min BAC +3), specialising in Economics or Finance, or equivalent knowledge gained through work experience.

• Min 5 years’ experience in a similar position.

Specific knowledge:

• In-depth understanding of fund administration and transfer-agent processes.

• Knowledge of Multifonds software will be considered as an advantage.

• Experience of managing special funds with periodic NAV calculation and weekly, monthly, quarterly subscription/redemption schedules, cut-off dates, etc.

• Knowledge of advanced features of MS Excel.

• Available to work during off-hours and in shift (early / late).

Language skills:

• French and English are both mandatory.

Personal qualities:

• Extremely rigorous in checking, sending, confirming and monitoring orders.

• Flexible and versatility.

• Resistant to stress.

• Enthusiastic and able to show initiative in solving problems.

• An enquiring mind and an ability to learn new things quickly.

• Integrate and control asset openings on our global platform, Neoxam.

• Challenge various asset types against counterparty prices.

• Regularly review and update these settings.

• Master’s degree in Finance, economics.

• 2 to 5 years’ experience minimum in a similar position with a strong understanding of financial products and market structures.

• Strong understanding on financial products.

Technology & Operations entwerfen und integrieren Softwareanwendungen, die von Portfoliomanagementsystemen, Handelsplattformen bis hin zu Bank- und Unternehmenslösungen reichen. Die Division ist für einige der wichtigsten Innovationen der Gruppe verantwortlich, während sie den Geschäftsbetrieb aufrechterhält und Depot- und Fondsverwaltungsdienste entwickelt.

Diese Funktion befindet sich in der Abteilung Clients & Assets Services, in der Einheit Asset Data Management.

Deine Rolle

Als Banking Operations Officer sind Sie für die Überwachung der Eröffnung und Preisgestaltung einer Vielzahl von Finanzprodukten verantwortlich. Dies umfasst eine breite Palette von Vermögenswerten, wie börsennotierte Produkte (Aktien, Anleihen, Kredite, Derivate), OTC-Produkte (IRS, CDS, FX & Equity-Optionen, TRS, CFD) und strukturierte Produkte (Autocall, Reverse Convertible, Doppelwährungseinlagen, Akkumulatoren, Airbags). Sie verwalten den gesamten Workflow, vom Handelsempfang und der Integration in die Datenbank der Bank über das Lifecycle-Management bis hin zur Instrumentenpreisgestaltung.

Ein weiterer Aspekt der Rolle wird die Verwaltung unserer komplexen Plattform und ihrer Entwicklung sein und eng mit unserem Produktanalysten zusammenarbeiten.

• Integrieren und kontrollieren Sie Asset-Eröffnungen auf unserer globalen Plattform Neoxam.

• Überwachen und veröffentlichen Sie Asset-Daten, Preise, Griechen, Marktdaten und Analysen auf allen unterstützten Plattformen.

• Verwalten Sie den Lebenszyklus aller Assets aus der Perspektive der Asset-Daten (Corpac-Ereignisse, Eröffnungen, Abwicklungen).

• Unterstützung verschiedener Nutzer dieser Daten (Buchhalter für Investmentfonds, Bewerter, Administratoren, Vermögensverwalter, Vermögensverwalter usw.).

• Fordern Sie verschiedene Anlagetypen gegen die Preise der Gegenpartei heraus.

• Kontaktaufnahme mit den wichtigsten Interessengruppen im Falle von Problemen.

• Implementieren Sie die erforderlichen Konfigurationen für Abfragen und Daten- / Preisflüsse für neu registrierte Wertpapiere von unseren verschiedenen Finanzinformationsanbietern (Bloomberg, SIX, Reuters, ICE).

• Überprüfen und aktualisieren Sie diese Einstellungen regelmäßig.

Geforderte Erfahrung:

• Master-Abschluss in Finanzen, Wirtschaft.

• 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung mindestens in einer ähnlichen Position mit einem starken Verständnis von Finanzprodukten und Marktstrukturen.

Hard Skills:

• Starkes Verständnis für Finanzprodukte.

• Solide technische Fähigkeiten, insbesondere mit Datenmanagement-Tools und Finanzplattformen.

• Hintergrund in der mathematischen Finanzierung.

• Erfahrener Benutzer von Office-Software-Anwendungen, insbesondere Excel.

• Programmierkenntnisse: VBA, SQL oder eine andere Sprache ist ein Asset.

Soft Skills:

• Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben und Projekte mit Vielseitigkeit in einer dynamischen Umgebung zu bewältigen.

• Hervorragende Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit Fähigkeiten, um mit verschiedenen Teams und Stakeholdern zu arbeiten.

• Starke analytische Denkweise und Liebe zum Detail, mit einem proaktiven Ansatz zur Problemlösung.

• Ein forschender Geist mit starken Lernfähigkeiten und einer gut entwickelten kritischen Fakultät.

• Genauigkeit und Gründlichkeit bei der Suche nach den Informationen, die für die Bewertung von Wertpapieren erforderlich sind.

Votre rôle

En tant qu'agent des opérations bancaires, vous serez chargé de superviser l'ouverture et la tarification d'une gamme variée de produits financiers. Cela comprend un large éventail d'actifs, tels que les produits cotés (équités, obligations, prêts, dérivés), les produits OTC (IRS, CDS, options FX & Equity, TRS, CFD) et les produits structurés (autocall, convertibles inversés, dépôts en double devise, accumulateurs, coussins gonflables). Un autre aspect du rôle sera de gérer notre plateforme complexe et son développement, en étroite collaboration avec notre analyste de produits.

• Implémenter les configurations nécessaires pour les requêtes et les flux de données/prix pour les titres nouvellement enregistrés de nos différents fournisseurs d'information financière (Bloomberg, SIX, Reuters, ICE).

• Examiner et mettre à jour régulièrement ces paramètres.

Votre profil

Expérience demandée:

• Maîtrise en finance, économie.

• 2 à 5 ans d'expérience minimum dans une position similaire avec une bonne compréhension des produits financiers et des structures du marché.

Compétences difficiles :

• Une bonne compréhension des produits financiers.

• Des compétences techniques solides, notamment avec des outils de gestion des données et des plateformes financières.

• Contexte en finance mathématique.

• Utilisateur qualifié d'applications logicielles de bureau, en particulier Excel.

• Compétences de programmation : VBA, SQL ou une autre langue est un atout.

Compétences douces :

• Capacité à gérer plusieurs tâches et projets avec polyvalence dans un environnement dynamique.

• Excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration pour travailler avec diverses équipes et parties prenantes.

• Forte attitude analytique et attention aux détails, avec une approche proactive de la résolution des problèmes.

• Un esprit en quête avec de solides compétences d'apprentissage et une faculté critique bien développée.

• Exactitude et rigueur dans la recherche de l'information nécessaire pour évaluer les valeurs mobilières.

• Bonne capacité de collaborer et de trouver une solution gagnante.

Compétences linguistiques :

• Français: niveau de connaissance

• Anglais : bonne connaissance (écrite et parlée)

Un tel document sera demandé dans le but de vérifier le caractère des candidats, en tenant compte du domaine d'activité de notre établissement et, plus particulièrement, des tâches décrites dans la description de travail.

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

This function is in the Clients & Assets Services department, in the Asset Data Management unit.

Your role

The scope of the function is to oversee all the workflow from the trade reception, data analysis and life cycle data management to instruments pricing. The scope of asset includes mutual funds, hedges funds and private equity.

• Integration and control of assets opening in our global platform Neoxam through prospectus analysis and identification of investment strategies & trading conditions,..

• Contact our external service providers Vestima, Telekurs

• Introduce the necessary settings for queries and Data/pricing flows for securities newly registered in our systems from our various financial information providers (Bloomberg, SIX).

• Searching for this information for newly opened securities in our system and providing the assistance requested by the various users of these prices (accountants for investment funds, valuers, administrators, asset managers, wealth managers, etc.).

• Updating the prices (final and/or estimated NAV) of fund units based on all information available(statements, e-mails, websites, feed providers, stock market quotations, etc.).

• Carrying out the necessary validations using control files (Variations, Impact NAV, No Load, Stale Price, etc.)

• Liaise directly with our main stakeholders in case of issue.

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Finance-oriented training (BAC+2/3).

• Initial experience in fund pricing would be an asset

Knowledge / technical skills:

• Good knowledge of financial products in general and hedges funds in particular

• Good knowledge of financial information providers.

• Skilled user of office software applications.

Soft skills:

• Driven and capable of showing initiative in solving problems.

• An enquiring mind with strong learning skills and a well-developed critical faculty.

• Accuracy and thoroughness in searching for the information required to value securities.

• Good capacity to collaborate and find win-win solution.

Language skills:

• French: fluent level

• English: good knowledge (written and spoken)

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and mordern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Technology & Operations entwerfen und integrieren Softwareanwendungen, die von Portfolio-Management-Systemen, Handelsplattformen bis hin zu Bank- und Unternehmenslösungen reichen. Die Division ist für einige der wichtigsten Innovationen der Gruppe verantwortlich, während sie den Geschäftsbetrieb aufrechterhält und Depot- und Fondsverwaltungsdienste entwickelt.

Diese Funktion befindet sich in der Abteilung für Bankgeschäfte, in der Einheit Assets Servicing.

Deine Rolle

Der Umfang der Funktion besteht darin, den gesamten Workflow vom Handelsempfang, der Datenanalyse und dem Lebenszyklusdatenmanagement bis hin zur Instrumentenpreisgestaltung zu überwachen. Der Anwendungsbereich umfasst Investmentfonds, Hedgefonds und Private Equity.

• Integration und Kontrolle der Eröffnung von Vermögenswerten in unserer globalen Plattform Neoxam durch Prospektanalyse und Identifizierung von Anlagestrategien und Handelsbedingungen.

• Kontaktieren Sie unseren externen Dienstleister Vestima, Telekurs

• Führen Sie die erforderlichen Einstellungen für Abfragen und Daten-/Preisflüsse für Wertpapiere ein, die neu in unseren Systemen von unseren verschiedenen Finanzinformationsanbietern (Bloomberg, SIX) registriert wurden.

• Suche nach diesen Informationen für neu eröffnete Wertpapiere in unserem System und Bereitstellung der von den verschiedenen Nutzern dieser Preise angeforderten Unterstützung (Buchhalter für Investmentfonds, Gutachter, Administratoren, Vermögensverwalter, Vermögensverwalter usw.).

• Aktualisierung der Preise (endgültiger und/oder geschätzter NAV) der Fondseinheiten auf der Grundlage aller verfügbaren Informationen (Erklärungen, E-Mails, Websites, Feed-Anbieter, Börsennotierungen usw.).

• Durchführung der erforderlichen Validierungen mithilfe von Kontrolldateien (Variationen, Impact NAV, No Load, Stale Price, etc.)

• Wenden Sie sich im Falle eines Problems direkt an unsere wichtigsten Stakeholder.

Dein Profil

Geforderte Erfahrung:

• Finanzorientierte Ausbildung (BAC+2/3).

• Erste Erfahrungen mit Fondspreisen wären ein Vermögenswert

Kenntnisse / technische Fähigkeiten:

• Gute Kenntnisse von Finanzprodukten im Allgemeinen und Hedgefonds im Besonderen

• Gute Kenntnisse von Finanzinformationsanbietern.

• Erfahrener Benutzer von Office-Software-Anwendungen.

Soft Skills:

• Angetrieben und fähig, Initiative bei der Lösung von Problemen zu zeigen.

• Ein forschender Geist mit starken Lernfähigkeiten und einer gut entwickelten kritischen Fakultät.

• Genauigkeit und Gründlichkeit bei der Suche nach den für die Bewertung von Wertpapieren erforderlichen Informationen.

• Gute Fähigkeit, zusammenzuarbeiten und Win-Win-Lösungen zu finden.

Sprachkenntnisse:

• Französisch: fließend

• Englisch: gute Kenntnisse (geschrieben und gesprochen)

Dieses von den Behörden ausgestellte Dokument darf nicht älter als drei Monate sein. Ein solches Dokument wird mit dem Ziel angefordert, eine Charakterprüfung der Kandidaten unter Berücksichtigung des Tätigkeitsbereichs unserer Einrichtung und insbesondere der in der Stellenbeschreibung beschriebenen Aufgaben durchzuführen.

Flexible und moderne Arbeitsweisen

Technologie & Opérations concevoir et intégrer des applications logicielles allant des systèmes de gestion de portefeuille, plates-formes de négociation aux solutions bancaires et corporatives. La tua squadra

Le funzioni aziendali comprendono le attività non bancarie del Gruppo e impiega oltre 700 persone. Queste funzioni sono svolte da specialisti con competenze in tutte le unità aziendali e includono i servizi di Comunicazione, Compliance, Finanza, Risorse Umane, Sicurezza dell'Informazione, Audit Interno, Legale, Rischio, Fiscale e Sostenibilità.

Con sede a Ginevra, si unirà al Group Sustainability Office (GSO), che sostiene l'avanzamento della strategia di sostenibilità di Pictet in tutta l'azienda. Potrai collaborare a stretto contatto con i membri del team di ricerca, il team GSO più ampio e gli accademici esterni per sviluppare approfondimenti basati sulle prove su questioni legate alla sostenibilità.

Il tuo ruolo

In questo ruolo, si guida la ricerca empirica su argomenti di sostenibilità e i loro collegamenti con la finanza, inizialmente concentrandosi sulla resilienza ambientale. Il vostro lavoro contribuirà a plasmare e sostenere il continuo sviluppo delle ambizioni di sostenibilità a lungo termine di Pictet.

Lei sarà responsabile di:

• Guidare o contribuire a progetti di ricerca di importanza strategica per l'Ufficio Sostenibilità del Gruppo in collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni e gli accademici esterni, compresa la pubblicazione dei risultati della ricerca.

• Contribuire alla progettazione di metodologie di ricerca e alle analisi empiriche.

• Tradurre argomenti di sostenibilità e finanza complessi in chiare e attuabili intuizioni per una vasta gamma di stakeholder, tra cui i team di investimento, gestione, rischio e vendite.

• Sostenere il team GSO con iniziative e progetti ad hoc.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea magistrale in sostenibilità, finanza, economia o campo correlato; PhD considerato un bene forte.

• Forte conoscenza dei temi della sostenibilità, in particolare del cambiamento climatico, della perdita di biodiversità, del cambiamento di terreno e dello stress idrico.

• Solida comprensione della gestione patrimoniale e patrimoniale, comprese le classi di asset (listed e unlisted), asset allocation e valutazione.

• Un background di ricerca applicato all'intersezione della sostenibilità e della finanza, in particolare per quanto riguarda la valutazione, l'allocazione degli asset, la costruzione del portafoglio e l'analisi delle prestazioni.

• Forti competenze quantitative, tra cui statistiche e analisi dei dati.

• Capacità di codifica avanzata, in particolare in Python.

• Adattabile, proattivo e self-driven, con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, costruendo efficaci relazioni collaborative tra le squadre.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale, con la capacità di trasmettere concetti complessi a diversi pubblico in modo chiaro e conciso.

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 700 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units and include the Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Risk, Tax and Sustainability Office departments.

Based in Geneva, you will join the Group Sustainability Office (GSO), which supports the advancement of Pictet's sustainability strategy across the firm. You will collaborate closely with members of the research team, the wider GSO team and external academics to develop evidence-based insights on sustainability-related issues.

Your role

In this role, you will drive empirical research on sustainability topics and their interlinkages with finance, initially focusing on environmental resilience. Your work will help shape and support the continued development of Pictet’s long-term sustainability ambitions.

You will be in charge of:

• Leading or contributing to research projects of strategic importance to the Group Sustainability Office in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external academics, including the publication of research findings.

• Contributing to the design of research methodologies and performing empirical analyses.

• Translating complex sustainability and financial topics into clear, actionable insights for a broad range of stakeholders, including investment, management, risk and sales teams.

• Supporting the GSO team with ad hoc initiatives and projects.

Your profile

• Master's degree in sustainability, finance, economics or a related field; PhD considered a strong asset.

• Strong knowledge of sustainability topics, particularly climate change, biodiversity loss, land-use change and water stress.

• Solid understanding of asset and wealth management, including asset classes (listed and unlisted), asset allocation and valuation.

• An applied research background at the intersection of sustainability and finance, especially as they relate to valuation, asset allocation, portfolio construction and performance analysis.

• Strong quantitative skills, including statistics and data analysis.

• Advanced coding skills, particularly in Python.

• Adaptable, proactive and self-driven, with the ability to work independently while building effective collaborative relationships across teams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences in a clear and concise manner.

• Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.

Ces fonctions sont exercées par des spécialistes spécialisés dans toutes les unités opérationnelles et comprennent les services des communications, de la conformité, des finances, des ressources humaines, de la sécurité de l'information, de la vérification interne, des services juridiques, du risque, de la fiscalité et de la durabilité.

Basé à Genève, vous rejoindrez le Group Sustainability Office (GSO), qui soutient l'avancement de la stratégie de durabilité de Pictet dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les membres de l'équipe de recherche, l'équipe élargie de l'OSG et des universitaires externes afin d'élaborer des idées fondées sur des données probantes sur les questions liées à la durabilité.

Votre rôle

Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des recherches empiriques sur des sujets liés à la durabilité et leurs liens avec la finance, en se concentrant d'abord sur la résilience environnementale. Votre travail aidera à façonner et à soutenir le développement continu des ambitions de durabilité à long terme de Pictet.

Vous serez en charge de:

• Diriger ou contribuer à des projets de recherche d'importance stratégique pour le Bureau de la durabilité du groupe en collaboration avec des intervenants internes et des universitaires externes, y compris la publication des résultats de la recherche.

• Contribuer à la conception de méthodologies de recherche et à la réalisation d'analyses empiriques.

• Traduire des sujets financiers et de durabilité complexes en idées claires et réalisables pour un large éventail d'intervenants, y compris des équipes d'investissement, de gestion, de risque et de vente.

• Soutenir l'équipe d'OSG par des initiatives et des projets ponctuels.

Votre profil

• Maîtrise en durabilité, finance, économie ou domaine connexe; doctorat considéré comme un atout solide.

• Connaissance approfondie des questions de durabilité, en particulier les changements climatiques, la perte de biodiversité, le changement d'affectation des terres et le stress hydrique.

• Une bonne compréhension de la gestion des actifs et du patrimoine, y compris les classes d'actifs (inscrites et non cotées), la répartition et l'évaluation des actifs.

• Un contexte de recherche appliquée à l'intersection de la durabilité et de la finance, notamment en ce qui concerne l'évaluation, la répartition des actifs, la construction de portefeuilles et l'analyse des performances.

• Des compétences quantitatives élevées, y compris des statistiques et des analyses de données.

• Compétences de codage avancées, particulièrement en Python.

• Adaptable, proactif et autonome, avec la capacité de travailler de façon indépendante tout en établissant des relations de collaboration efficaces entre les équipes.

• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale, avec la capacité de transmettre des concepts complexes à divers auditoires de façon claire et concise.

• Excellente maîtrise de l'anglais, écrit et parlé.

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5,400 people.

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 220 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

You will be joining Pictet Wealth Management Geneva and will be part of the Client Business Compliance (CBC) Monitoring team, based in Geneva.

Your role

As a member of the CBC Monitoring Team, your mission is to support the fight against money laundering and the financing of terrorism, in accordance with regulations such as AMLA, OBA-FINMA and CDB20.
You will perform the various activities carried out by the team, including, among others, transaction monitoring, client screening, correspondent banks’ requests and payment filtering.
Depending on operational needs, you may be asked to assist with other compliance-related activities. You will be entrusted with the following responsibilities :

• Transaction monitoring: Reviewing and analyzing client transactions to detect suspicious or unusual activity.

• Client screening: Conducting due diligence checks on clients to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.

• Correspondent banks’ requests: Managing and responding to requests from correspondent banks, particularly those related to sanctions and other compliance matters.

• Payment filtering: Screening payments to identify and block transactions that may involve sanctioned individuals, entities or jurisdictions.

• Carrying out and following up on all necessary clarification processes to resolve alerts or issues identified during monitoring activities.

• Ensuring frequent interactions with the Front Office, providing guidance and acting as an advisor on compliance matters.

• Interacting with various internal stakeholders and delivering presentations to the AML Committees as required.

• Taking charge of ad hoc projects related to the team’s activities, under the supervision of the Team Manager.

Your profile

• Minimum 5 years’ experience in a similar compliance position within private banking in Switzerland

• Master’s degree required; a Certificate in Compliance Management is an asset

• Strong interest in regulatory issues and the AML field; very good knowledge of AMLA, OBA-FINMA, the Swiss banks’ code of conduct and related case law

• Excellent command of French and English (oral and written); additional languages are a plus

• Proficient in standard IT tools, including banking software and MS Office

• Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving skills

• Flexible, versatile and conscientious; able to communicate precisely and distil important information

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5300 people. Pictet Asset Management manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service.

Your role

As key member of the Pictet Asset Management (PAM) Asia Equity Special Situations team, this role supports the Lead Portfolio Manager by conducting investment research across Asia-Pacific equity markets, with a focus on identifying liquid, event-driven trading opportunities.

Responsibilities

• Build and maintain proprietary financial models (including LBO, DCF, NAV, relative value comparables and merger arbitrage spread analyses) and clearly articulate trading ideas to internal stakeholders.

• Proactively monitor announced corporate events and quantify key risk factors, risk/reward profiles and market‑implied expectations, updating assumptions in a timely and rigorous manner.

• Maintain active dialogue with sell-side analysts, meet company management teams and participate in relevant industry conferences.

• Contribute to portfolio risk monitoring and help implement a robust framework to mitigate factor risks across sub‑strategies.

• Proven experience in Asian equity markets, with a solid understanding of M&A and equity capital markets; index rebalance expertise is a plus.

• Familiarity with Asia-Pacific market regulations, including Japan and Australia.

• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail; results‑oriented, driven and a collaborative team player with excellent interpersonal and written communication skills.

• Strong knowledge of Bloomberg and Excel, including VBA; exposure to Python is an advantage.

The successful candidate is versatile, self‑motivated, detail‑oriented and highly diligent. You will also be able to build and maintain effective working relationships with key business stakeholders.

Unisciti alla nostra sede europea di Bank Pictet & Cie (Europa) AG (BPAG) a Francoforte sul Meno in quanto stiamo cercando una gestione motivata del rischio finanziario degli studenti di lavoro (m/f/d) per sostenere le nostre iniziative strategiche e il business quotidiano.

BPAG è un istituto finanziario leader con una forte presenza in tutta Europa, sedi operative in Lussemburgo, Spagna, Monaco, Francia, Italia e Regno Unito. Questa è un'occasione emozionante per contribuire a progetti d'impatto all'interno di un ambiente collaborativo e internazionale nel cuore del nostro ufficio di Francoforte.

Se siete appassionati di Financial Risk Management e desiderosi di fare la differenza in una prestigiosa organizzazione paneuropea, non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione.

Il tuo ruolo

Scopri e supporta/contribuisci a:

• Esecuzione e automazione dei processi di controllo relativi alle diverse attività della Banca.

• Rischio finanziario e non finanziario modellazione e test di stress.

• Miglioramento e automazione della segnalazione dei rischi.

• Analizzare su nuove metriche di rischio, nuovi prodotti/servizi, miglioramenti della metodologia di rischio e -implementazioni.

Il tuo profilo

• Senior BSc o uno studente di MSc in un campo di studio preferibilmente quantitativo, ad esempio, economia quantitativa, finanza quantitativa / gestione del rischio, tecnologia finanziaria, scienza applicata dei dati, analisi di business computazionale, o equivalente.

• Forte capacità di codifica (ad esempio Python, VBA).

• Ottima conoscenza della suite Microsoft Office.

• La fluidità in tedesco o francese vicino all'inglese, sarebbe un vantaggio.

• Forte capacità analitiche e di comunicazione.

• Problema-solving mentalità e focalizzato sul lavoro di squadra e la collaborazione.

• Affidabile e affidabile.

• Ti piace lavorare in un ambiente multiculturale e multilingue.

Nota

A Pictet, troverete più di una semplice posizione, scoprirete un'occasione unica per contribuire a un'importante banca privata rinomata per la sua tradizione di indipendenza, pensiero a lungo termine, partnership, responsabilità e spirito imprenditoriale.

Vi invitiamo a unirvi al nostro team impegnato e collaborativo e non esitate ad accogliervi a Pictet.

Diversità e inclusione

Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione sul posto di lavoro.

Your team

Join our European headquarters of Bank Pictet & Cie (Europe) AG (BPAG) in Frankfurt am Main as we are seeking a motivated Working Student Financial Risk Management (m/f/d) to support our strategic initiatives and daily business.

BPAG is a leading financial institution with a strong presence across Europe, operating branches in Luxembourg, Spain, Monaco, France, Italy and the UK. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to impactful projects within a collaborative, international environment at the heart of our Frankfurt office.

If you are passionate about Financial Risk Management and eager to make a difference in a prestigious, pan-European organization, we look forward to your application.

Your role

Learn about and support/contribute to:

• Execution and automation of control processes related to the Bank’s different activities.

• Financial and non-financial risk modelling and stress testing.

• Enhancement and automation of risk reporting.

• Analyse on new risk metrics, new products/services, risk methodology enhancements and -implementations.

Your profile

• Senior BSc or a MSc student in a preferably quantitative field of study e.g., Quantitative Economics, Quantitative Finance/Risk Management, Financial Technology, Applied Data Science, Computational Business Analytics, or equivalent.

• Strong coding skills (e.g. Python, VBA).

• Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office suite.

• Fluency in German or French next to English, would be a plus.

• Strong analytical and communication skills.

• Problem-solving mind-set and focussed on teamwork and collaboration.

• Trustworthy and reliable.

• You enjoy working in a multi-cultural and multi-lingual environment.

Note

At Pictet, you will find more than just a position—you will discover a unique opportunity to contribute to a distinguished private bank renowned for its tradition of independence, long-term thinking, partnership, responsibility and entrepreneurial spirit.

We invite you to join our engaged and collaborative team and look forward to welcoming you to Pictet.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.
