BPAG ist ein führendes Finanzinstitut mit einer starken Präsenz in ganz Europa mit Niederlassungen in Luxemburg, Spanien, Monaco, Frankreich, Italien und Großbritannien. Dies ist eine aufregende Gelegenheit, zu wirkungsvollen Projekten in einem kollaborativen, internationalen Umfeld im Herzen unseres Frankfurter Büros beizutragen.

Wenn Sie sich für das Finanzrisikomanagement begeistern und in einer renommierten, paneuropäischen Organisation etwas bewegen möchten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Deine Rolle

Informieren Sie sich und unterstützen Sie / tragen Sie dazu bei:

• Durchführung und Automatisierung von Kontrollprozessen im Zusammenhang mit den verschiedenen Aktivitäten der Bank.

• Finanzielle und nichtfinanzielle Risikomodellierung und Stresstests.

• Verbesserung und Automatisierung der Risikoberichterstattung.

• Analyse neuer Risikometriken, neuer Produkte / Dienstleistungen, Verbesserungen der Risikomethodik und -implementierungen.

Dein Profil

• Senior BSc oder ein MSc-Student in einem vorzugsweise quantitativen Studienbereich z.B. Quantitative Economics, Quantitative Finance / Risk Management, Financial Technology, Applied Data Science, Computational Business Analytics oder gleichwertig.

• Starke Programmierkenntnisse (z. B. Python, VBA).

• Ausgezeichnete Kenntnisse der Microsoft Office Suite.

• Fließend in Deutsch oder Französisch neben Englisch, wäre ein Plus.

• Starke Analyse- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Problemlösung Mind-Set und konzentriert sich auf Teamarbeit und Zusammenarbeit.

• Vertrauenswürdig und zuverlässig.

• Sie arbeiten gerne in einem multikulturellen und mehrsprachigen Umfeld.

Anmerkung:

Bei Pictet finden Sie mehr als nur eine Position - Sie werden eine einzigartige Gelegenheit entdecken, zu einer angesehenen Privatbank beizutragen, die für ihre Tradition der Unabhängigkeit, des langfristigen Denkens, der Partnerschaft, der Verantwortung und des Unternehmergeistes bekannt ist.

Wir laden Sie ein, sich unserem engagierten und kooperativen Team anzuschließen und freuen uns darauf, Sie bei Pictet willkommen zu heißen.

Pictet ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit und engagiert sich für die Schaffung eines vielfältigen Umfelds. Wir respektieren alle Menschen und suchen ihre Einbeziehung in den Arbeitsplatz.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra

Il Gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali asset manager indipendenti al mondo. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo è rappresentato in 30 sedi in centri finanziari in tutto il mondo, e attualmente impiega oltre 5200 persone. Pictet è presente dal 1989 a Lussemburgo, dove occupa oltre 700 persone.

Pictet Asset Services fornisce la custodia, i servizi di fondo e le soluzioni di trading per gli asset manager esterni, i gestori di fondi e i clienti istituzionali. Gestiamo ogni aspetto della catena del valore di manutenzione degli asset e la nostra gamma di soluzioni su misura includono analisi di valore, supporto strategia di trading e interfacce front-end digitali progettate per fornire un'esperienza clienti senza rivali.

In qualità di stagista all'interno del reparto Servizi di Pictet, supporterai i team di Gestione relazioni cliente (CRO/CRM) nelle loro attività quotidiane. Questo stage vi permetterà di sviluppare competenze operative, regolamentari e interpersonali, contribuendo alla qualità del servizio clienti.

• Data di inizio: agosto/settembre

• Durata: 12 mesi

• Tasso di occupazione: part-time

• Prerequisito: un accordo di tirocinio tripartito firmato con la vostra scuola

Il tuo ruolo

• Fornire assistenza operativa quotidiana ai team nella gestione dei file client: preparazione, verifica e follow-up dei documenti necessari per l'apertura, la modifica o la chiusura dell'account.

• Assistere nella gestione delle operazioni di routine: verifica della firma, esecuzione e monitoraggio delle transazioni (ordini, pagamenti, fondi e trasferimenti di asset), gestione dei flussi in entrata/uscita, coordinamento con le controparti e allerta in caso di blocchi.

• Partecipa alla preparazione e all'aggiornamento dei file client, garantendo la conformità e la completezza delle informazioni dei documenti di supporto.

• Sostenere i team nella gestione delle richieste dei clienti, nell'elaborazione di query e nella risoluzione di semplici incidenti, garantendo un rigoroso follow-up e una comunicazione efficace.

• Contribuisci a verificare l'accuratezza delle transazioni e la qualità dei dati inseriti negli strumenti interni.

• Agire come punto di contatto per compiti amministrativi e logistici relativi alla gestione dei rapporti con i clienti.

Il tuo profilo

Esperienza richiesta: :

• Attualmente perseguire una laurea in finanza, amministrazione aziendale o economia.

• Prima esperienza (internship) in un ruolo di gestione delle relazioni con i clienti all'interno del settore dei servizi finanziari, in modo idea in private banking o gestione della ricchezza

Morbide competenze:

• Attenzione ai dettagli e alle competenze organizzative

• Capacità di gestire più attività simultaneamente

• Forte capacità interpersonali e una mentalità orientata al team

• Approccio proattivo e orientato alla soluzione

Capacità linguistiche:

• Francese: livello fluente

• Inglese: buona conoscenza (scritto e parlato)

Nota

Non accetteremo alcun CV da agenzie.

Ai sensi delle disposizioni della legge lussemburghese del 23 luglio 2016 che modifica la legge del 29 marzo 2013, i candidati possono essere tenuti a fornire un estratto dal loro registro penale. Questo documento, rilasciato dalle autorità, non deve essere più vecchio di tre mesi. Tale documento sarà richiesto con l'obiettivo di effettuare un controllo del carattere sui candidati, tenendo presente l'area di attività del nostro stabilimento e, più in particolare, i compiti descritti nella descrizione del lavoro.

Modi flessibili e moderni di lavoro

In qualità di datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo il benessere dei nostri dipendenti attraverso una serie di modalità di lavoro flessibili, che vanno da una politica di lavoro-da-casa per funzioni ammissibili a opportunità di congedo part-time annualizzato e congedo parentale prolungato.

Diversità e inclusione

Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione sul posto di lavoro.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience.

As an intern within the Pictet Asset Services department, you will support the Client Relationship Management (CRO/CRM) teams in their daily activities. This internship will allow you to develop operational, regulatory, and interpersonal skills while contributing to the quality of client service.

• Start date: August/September

• Duration: 12 months

• Employment rate: part-time

• Prerequisite: a tripartite internship agreement signed with your school

Your role

• Provide daily operational support to the teams in managing client files: preparation, verification, and follow-up of documents required for account opening, modification, or closure.

• Assist in the management of routine operations: signature verification, execution and monitoring of transactions (orders, payments, fund and asset transfers), management of incoming/outgoing flows, coordination with counterparties, and alerting in case of blockages.

• Participate in the preparation and updating of client files, ensuring information compliance and completeness of supporting documents.

• Support the teams in handling client requests, processing queries, and resolving simple incidents, ensuring rigorous follow-up and effective communication.

• Contribute to verifying the accuracy of transactions and the quality of data entered into internal tools.

• Act as a point of contact for administrative and logistical tasks related to client relationship management.

Your profile

Requested experience: :

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration or Economics.

• First experience (internship) in a client relationship management role within the financial services industry, idealy in private banking or wealth management

Soft skills:

• Attention to detail and organizational skills

• Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

• Strong interpersonal skills and a team-oriented mindset

• Proactive and solution-oriented approach

Language skills:

• French: fluent level

• English: good knowledge (written and spoken)

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Dein Team

Die Pictet Group ist einer der weltweit führenden unabhängigen Vermögensverwalter. Die 1805 gegründete Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Genf, Schweiz, ist in 30 Büros in Finanzzentren weltweit vertreten und beschäftigt derzeit über 5200 Mitarbeiter. Pictet ist seit 1989 in Luxemburg präsent und beschäftigt dort über 700 Mitarbeiter.

Pictet Asset Services bietet Depot-, Fondsdienstleistungen und Handelslösungen für externe Vermögensverwalter, Fondsmanager und institutionelle Kunden. Wir verwalten jeden Aspekt der Wertschöpfungskette des Asset Service und unser Sortiment an maßgeschneiderten Lösungen umfasst wertschöpfende Analysen, Unterstützung der Handelsstrategie und digitale Front-End-Schnittstellen, die ein konkurrenzloses Kundenerlebnis bieten.

Als Praktikant in der Abteilung Pictet Asset Services unterstützen Sie die Client Relationship Management (CRO/CRM) Teams bei ihren täglichen Aktivitäten. Dieses Praktikum ermöglicht es Ihnen, operative, regulatorische und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln und gleichzeitig zur Qualität des Kundendienstes beizutragen.

• Startdatum: August/September

• Dauer: 12 Monate

• Beschäftigungsquote: Teilzeit

• Voraussetzung: ein dreigliedriger Praktikumsvertrag mit Ihrer Schule unterzeichnet

Deine Rolle

• Tägliche operative Unterstützung der Teams bei der Verwaltung von Kundendateien: Vorbereitung, Verifizierung und Nachverfolgung von Dokumenten, die für die Eröffnung, Änderung oder Schließung von Konten erforderlich sind.

• Unterstützung bei der Verwaltung von Routineoperationen: Überprüfung der Signatur, Ausführung und Überwachung von Transaktionen (Aufträge, Zahlungen, Überweisungen von Geldern und Vermögenswerten), Management eingehender/ausgehender Stromflüsse, Koordinierung mit Gegenparteien und Alarmierung im Falle von Blockaden.

• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Vorbereitung und Aktualisierung von Kundendateien, um die Einhaltung der Informationen und die Vollständigkeit der unterstützenden Dokumente zu gewährleisten.

• Unterstützen Sie die Teams bei der Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen, der Bearbeitung von Anfragen und der Lösung einfacher Vorfälle, um eine strenge Nachverfolgung und effektive Kommunikation zu gewährleisten.

• Beitrag zur Überprüfung der Genauigkeit von Transaktionen und der Qualität der in interne Tools eingegebenen Daten.

• Handeln Sie als Ansprechpartner für administrative und logistische Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Kundenbeziehungsmanagement.

Dein Profil

Geforderte Erfahrung: :

• Derzeit verfolgt einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Finanzen, Betriebswirtschaft oder Wirtschaft.

• Erste Erfahrung (Praktikum) in einer Client Relationship Management Rolle in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche, vor allem im Private Banking oder Wealth Management

Soft Skills:

• Aufmerksamkeit für Details und organisatorische Fähigkeiten

• Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig zu verwalten

• Starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und eine teamorientierte Denkweise

• Proaktiver und lösungsorientierter Ansatz

Sprachkenntnisse:

• Französisch: fließend

• Englisch: gute Kenntnisse (geschrieben und gesprochen)

Anmerkung:

Wir werden keine Lebensläufe von Agenturen akzeptieren.

Gemäß den Bestimmungen des luxemburgischen Gesetzes vom 23. Juli 2016 zur Änderung des Gesetzes vom 29. März 2013 kann von Bewerbern verlangt werden, einen Auszug aus ihrem Strafregister vorzulegen. Dieses von den Behörden ausgestellte Dokument darf nicht älter als drei Monate sein. Ein solches Dokument wird mit dem Ziel angefordert, eine Charakterprüfung der Kandidaten unter Berücksichtigung des Tätigkeitsbereichs unserer Einrichtung und insbesondere der in der Stellenbeschreibung beschriebenen Aufgaben durchzuführen.

Flexible und moderne Arbeitsweisen

Als verantwortungsbewusster und unterstützender Arbeitgeber fördern wir das Wohlergehen unserer Mitarbeiter durch eine Reihe flexibler Arbeitsvereinbarungen, die von einer Work-from-Home-Politik für förderfähige Funktionen bis hin zu Möglichkeiten für einen annualisierten Teilzeiturlaub und einen verlängerten Elternurlaub reichen.

Pictet ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit und engagiert sich für die Schaffung eines vielfältigen Umfelds. Wir respektieren alle Menschen und suchen ihre Einbeziehung in den Arbeitsplatz.

Votre équipe

Le groupe Pictet est l'un des leaders mondiaux des gestionnaires de patrimoine et d'actifs indépendants. Fondé en 1805 et ayant son siège social à Genève, le Groupe est représenté dans 30 bureaux dans les centres financiers du monde entier et emploie actuellement plus de 5200 personnes. Pictet est présent depuis 1989 au Luxembourg, où il emploie plus de 700 personnes.

Pictet Asset Services fournit des services de garde, des services de fonds et des solutions de négociation aux gestionnaires d'actifs externes, aux gestionnaires de fonds et aux clients institutionnels. Nous gérons tous les aspects de la chaîne de valeur de l'entretien des actifs et notre gamme de solutions sur mesure comprend l'analyse de la valeur ajoutée, le soutien de la stratégie de négociation et les interfaces front-end numériques conçues pour fournir une expérience client inégalée.

En tant que stagiaire au sein du département Pictet Asset Services, vous soutiendrez les équipes de gestion de la relation client (CRO/CRM) dans leurs activités quotidiennes. Ce stage vous permettra de développer des compétences opérationnelles, réglementaires et interpersonnelles tout en contribuant à la qualité du service à la clientèle.

• Date de début: août/septembre

• Durée: 12 mois

• Taux d'emploi: temps partiel

• Préalable : un accord de stage tripartite signé avec votre école

Votre rôle

• Fournir un soutien opérationnel quotidien aux équipes pour la gestion des dossiers des clients : préparation, vérification et suivi des documents requis pour l'ouverture, la modification ou la clôture des comptes.

• Aider à la gestion des opérations courantes: vérification de la signature, exécution et suivi des transactions (ordres, paiements, transferts de fonds et d'actifs), gestion des flux entrants/sorties, coordination avec les contreparties et alerte en cas de blocage.

• Participer à la préparation et à la mise à jour des dossiers des clients, en assurant la conformité des renseignements et l'exhaustivité des documents à l'appui.

• Aider les équipes à traiter les demandes des clients, à traiter les demandes et à résoudre les incidents simples, en assurant un suivi rigoureux et une communication efficace.

• Contribuer à vérifier l'exactitude des transactions et la qualité des données saisies dans les outils internes.

• Agir comme point de contact pour les tâches administratives et logistiques liées à la gestion de la relation client.

Votre profil

Expérience demandée :

• Actuellement, il est titulaire d'un baccalauréat en finance, administration des affaires ou économie.

• Première expérience (internat) dans un rôle de gestion de la relation client dans le secteur des services financiers, idéenellement dans la banque privée ou la gestion de patrimoine

Compétences douces :

• Attention aux détails et aux compétences organisationnelles

• Capacité à gérer simultanément plusieurs tâches

• Fortes aptitudes interpersonnelles et un esprit d'équipe

• Approche proactive et axée sur la solution

Compétences linguistiques :

• Français: niveau de connaissance

• Anglais : bonne connaissance (écrite et parlée)

Remarque

Nous n'accepterons aucun CV des agences.

Conformément aux dispositions de la loi luxembourgeoise du 23 juillet 2016 modifiant la loi du 29 mars 2013, les candidats peuvent être tenus de fournir un extrait de leur casier judiciaire. Ce document, délivré par les autorités, ne doit pas dépasser trois mois. responsabilità

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Pictet has been present in Hong Kong for more than 25 years where it employs more than 200 people.

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

Main Duties & Responsibilities
Mission
• Deliver proactive, actionable FX & Precious Metals advice to Investment Specialists, Relationship Managers and clients, aligned with the House view and market opportunities.
• Create and disseminate high-quality investment content and trade ideas across all internal and external channels.
• Identify business opportunities and manage risk through systematic analysis of client activity and portfolio exposures.
• Drive asset class development by collaborating on cross-asset projects, enhancing tools, and ensuring robust compliance and risk management.

Responsibilities
• Proactively advise internal clients (relationship managers and investment specialists) and selected active clients on their FX and PM trading, investment and hedging needs.
• Create timely investment advice in line with the House view and taking advantage of prevailing market conditions.
• Create and distribute FX & PM communications (publications, broadcasts ideas …) through all available medias and channel (intranet, chat rooms, conference calls, investment meetings, one-on-one meetings …)
• Analyze the book of business for opportunities and risk management.
• Support RMs in monitoring FX margin positions and assist RMs to explain the situation in case there are margin calls.
• Collaborate with Fixed Income, Equities, and Structured Product specialists across Asia and Geneva to deliver cross-asset solutions and drive business synergies.
• Contribute to the development of the asset class through project work on tools, systems, risk framework, training material and marketing documents.
• Support the development of structured products across asset classes.
• Ensure optimal compliance and risk management that takes account of all relevant local laws, regulatory requirements, in-house directives and procedures, as well as possessing adequate knowledge to apply these effectively and ensure fair treatment of all clients.

Your role

Your profile

• Excellent technical knowledge of Derivatives and Structured Products across asset classes.
• Excellent technical knowledge of the main drivers of asset classes.
• In-depth understanding of the private banking and FX value chain, as well as client segments.
• Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written, ability to give a short and convincing pitch. Excellent public-speaking and presentation skills.
• Very good grasp of portfolio construction, investment processes and risk management approaches.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Resilient, proactive, self-driven and results oriented.
• Very strong team spirit and ability to partner with other teams.
• Graduate degree in Economics, Business, Engineering or a similar subject.
• Ideally a postgraduate degree such as a Master’s, MBA, CIIA or CFA.
• Solid experience in FX&PM Advisory for 10-15 years, in a client-facing role.

• Soutenir le développement de produits structurés selon les classes d'actifs.

Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people.

Your role

Pictet Asset Management (Hong Kong) Limited is seeking to recruit a ManCo Oversight & Product Management Officer to work in the ManCo Oversight & Product Management - HKG team.

• Oversee and manage a broad range of finance and management company (MANCO) oversight duties to ensure operational excellence and regulatory compliance.

• Provide comprehensive support for fund operations, including Net Asset Value (NAV) calculation, validation, and the review of financial and investor reports.

• Conduct thorough reviews of financial statements and coordinate audit processes with internal teams and external auditors.

• Prepare and submit management and regulatory reports in accordance with relevant standards and deadlines.

• Act as a liaison between the company, service providers, and auditors to facilitate smooth communication and resolve issues efficiently.

• Address and resolve inquiries from both internal stakeholders and external parties, ensuring timely and accurate responses.

• Drive process improvements through automation initiatives, participate in group-wide projects, and handle ad hoc assignments as required.

Your profile

• Solid working knowledge of SFC-authorized funds; experience with MRF (Mutual Recognition of Funds) and QDLP (Qualified Domestic Limited Partnership) schemes is highly advantageous.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail and the ability to work effectively under tight deadlines.

• Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

• Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, in English and Mandarin.

La tua squadra

Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) si avvale di una tradizione bancaria svizzera di oltre duecento anni e di competenze in materia di investimenti internazionali. Pictet, gruppo posseduto e gestito da partner, offre una gamma completa di servizi finanziari per famiglie e privati ​​con patrimoni elevati, comprese soluzioni di gestione discrezionale e di consulenza sugli investimenti, nonché servizi di family office.

All'interno del dipartimento Risk & Control Functions di PWM, in qualità di Business Compliance Manager, analizzerai tutti i nuovi file di apertura dei conti cliente.

Il tuo ruolo

- Analizzare le pratiche relative alle aperture di conto, sia a livello materiale (PEP, Close to PEP, Alto Rischio, Medio Rischio e Basso Rischio) che su aspetti formali e fiscali (FATCA, CRS, ecc.).
- Redigere documenti riepilogativi relativi alle richieste di apertura conto e presentarli alle varie autorità della Banca.
- Consigliare i gestori, in particolare sul processo di apertura del conto.
- Garantire il rispetto delle normative (AML, OBA-FINMA, CDB), in particolare nella lotta al riciclaggio di denaro e al finanziamento del terrorismo (AML).

Il tuo profilo

- Esperienza di almeno 5 anni in una posizione simile in una banca privata in Svizzera.
- Formazione universitaria o bancaria; un certificato nella gestione della conformità è una risorsa.
- Forte interesse per gli aspetti normativi, in particolare in ambito AML. Ottima conoscenza della LRD, dell'OBA-FINMA e della Convenzione sulla diligenza bancaria, nonché della relativa giurisprudenza.
- Padronanza degli strumenti IT comuni, inclusi il software bancario Avaloq e MS Office.

• Support assistance with administrative tasks when required

• Ensure a close follow-up of all your tasks

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra

Le funzioni aziendali includono le attività non bancarie del Gruppo e impiega oltre 600 persone. Queste funzioni sono svolte da specialisti con competenze in tutte le unità aziendali, e includono le comunicazioni, conformità, finanza, risorse umane, sicurezza dell'informazione, controllo interno, legale, rischio, progetti strategici e fiscali.

Segnalando al responsabile delle operazioni di sviluppo di apprendimento e talento, lavorerai per l'Accademia Pictet, nel dipartimento Risorse Umane. Il team supporta lo sviluppo dei dipendenti del Gruppo e della cultura aziendale nei nostri uffici in tutto il mondo valutando le esigenze e implementando soluzioni di apprendimento per soddisfarle.

Il tuo ruolo

Fornirete supporto operativo e amministrativo per i programmi di formazione e le iniziative all’interno della Pictet Academy e della comunità di apprendimento e sviluppo dei talenti del Gruppo (LTD). Agendo come punto chiave di contatto per le attività legate all'apprendimento, si assicurerà la fornitura regolare di programmi di apprendimento, supporto delle parti interessate, amministrazione LMS, reporting e gestione dei costi.

Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di contribuire alla fornitura di soluzioni di apprendimento in tutto il Gruppo, lavorando a stretto contatto con una vasta rete di stakeholder interni e partner esterni.

Operazioni, amministrazione e reporting
• Amministrare il SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management System (LMS), tra cui la creazione di corsi e classi, la gestione delle iscrizioni, il supporto degli studenti e l'amministrazione di sistema.
• Agire come co-amministratore LMS, fornendo supporto di prima linea agli utenti, problemi di risoluzione dei problemi e garantendo un'esperienza di apprendimento positiva.
• Agire come punto chiave di contatto per le richieste di apprendimento e le richieste amministrative, garantendo un alto livello di servizio agli stakeholder interni.
• Sostenere i gestori LTD con pianificazione del corso, pianificazione e coordinamento.
• Esecuzione dei piani di comunicazione del programma di formazione e approfondimento delle valutazioni e delle valutazioni.
• Gestione della logistica della formazione, comprese le prenotazioni in camera, le modalità di catering e la manutenzione dei file condivisi su SharePoint.
• Produrre e mantenere rapporti di formazione, dashboard e metriche operative.
• Fornire supporto tecnico agli utenti di piattaforme di apprendimento e collaborazione, tra cui Klaxoon, Easygenerator e DataCamp.

Fatturazione e gestione dei costi
• Gestire l'elaborazione end-to-end delle fatture, tra cui raccolta, revisione, codifica e presentazione al Dipartimento Contabilità.
• Monitoraggio dello stato della fattura e dei pagamenti tramite ESKER e successiva su fatture in sospeso con i fornitori.
• Produrre stime dei costi e lisciviazione con fornitori di formazione esterni e fornitori.
• Collaborando nel processo di revisione della fattura per tutte le spese relative alla Pictet Academy e verificando la segnalazione SAP.
• Contribuire a recensioni trimestrali di bilancio e attività di costo-tracking.

Il tuo profilo

• Almeno tre anni di esperienza in un supporto operativo, amministrazione HR, amministrazione di apprendimento o ruolo simile.
• È necessaria un'esperienza pratica che amministra un sistema di gestione dell'apprendimento (LMS).
• Proficienza avanzata in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, tabelle pivot, convalida dei dati e reporting).
• Esperienza precedente in Learning & Talent Development, Training Administration o HR Operations sarebbe un bene forte.
• Esperienza comprovata nel fornire un elevato standard di assistenza e supporto per le parti interessate.
• Forte capacità organizzative e di coordinamento, con la capacità di gestire in modo efficace più priorità.
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, priorità richieste concorrenti e fornire risultati accurati in un ambiente veloce.
• Esperienza nella gestione delle fatture, monitoraggio del budget e stima dei costi.
• Forte capacità analitiche e ottima attenzione ai dettagli.
• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder.
• Team-oriented, proattivo e orientato al servizio.
• Esperienza con strumenti di reportistica e analisi dei dati.
• Esperienza con sistemi aziendali e piattaforme di apprendimento digitale. La conoscenza di SAP SuccessFactors Learning, JIRA, ESKER e SharePoint sarebbe un forte vantaggio.
• Fluency scritto e parlato in francese e inglese.
• Residente in Svizzera.

Il candidato di successo sarà agile, versatile e altamente organizzato per soddisfare le scadenze, così come avere buone capacità di problem solving. Siete desiderosi di mettere la vostra esperienza a buon uso in un team che apprezzerà la vostra gamma di competenze e approccio proattivo.

Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include the Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Risk, Strategy & Projects, and Tax departments.

Reporting to the Learning & Talent Development Operations Manager, you will be working for the Pictet Academy, in the Human Resources department. The team supports the development of the Group’s employees and corporate culture at our offices around the world by assessing needs and implementing learning solutions to meet them.

Your role

You will provide operational and administrative support for training programmes and initiatives within the Pictet Academy and the Group’s Learning & Talent Development (LTD) community. Acting as a key point of contact for learning-related activities, you will ensure the smooth delivery of learning programmes, stakeholder support, LMS administration, reporting and cost management.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the delivery of learning solutions across the Group while working closely with a diverse network of internal stakeholders and external partners.

Operations, administration and reporting
• Administrating the SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management System (LMS), including course and class creation, enrolment management, learner support and system administration.
• Acting as LMS co-administrator, providing first-line support to users, troubleshooting issues and ensuring a positive learning experience.
• Acting as a key point of contact for learning-related enquiries and administrative requests, ensuring a high level of service to internal stakeholders.
• Supporting LTD managers with course planning, scheduling and coordination.
• Executing training programme communication plans and following up on assessments and evaluations.
• Managing training logistics, including room bookings, catering arrangements and maintenance of shared files on SharePoint.
• Producing and maintaining training reports, dashboards and operational metrics.
• Providing technical support to users of learning and collaboration platforms, including Klaxoon, Easygenerator and DataCamp.

Invoicing and cost management
• Managing the end-to-end processing of invoices, including collection, review, coding and submission to the Accounting Department.
• Monitoring invoice status and payments through ESKER and following up on outstanding invoices with suppliers.
• Producing cost estimates and liaising with external training providers and vendors.
• Collaborating in the invoice review process for all Pictet Academy-related expenditures and verifying SAP reporting.
• Contributing to quarterly budget reviews and cost-tracking activities.

Your profile

• At least three years’ experience in an operational support, HR administration, learning administration or similar role.
• Hands-on experience administering a Learning Management System (LMS) is required.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, data validation and reporting).
• Previous experience in Learning & Talent Development, Training Administration or HR Operations would be a strong asset.
• Proven experience in delivering a high standard of customer-focused service and stakeholder support.
• Strong organisational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
• Ability to work independently, prioritise competing demands and deliver accurate results in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience in invoice management, budget tracking and cost estimation.
• Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Team-oriented, proactive and service-minded.
• Experience with reporting and data analysis tools.
• Experience with enterprise systems and digital learning platforms. Knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors Learning, JIRA, ESKER and SharePoint would be a strong advantage.
• Written and spoken fluency in French and English.
• Resident in Switzerland.

The successful candidate will be agile, versatile, and highly organised to meet deadlines, as well as having good problem-solving skills. You are keen to put your experience to good use in a team that will appreciate your range of skills and proactive approach.

Sie bieten operative und administrative Unterstützung für Schulungsprogramme und -initiativen innerhalb der Pictet Academy und der Learning & Talent Development (LTD) -Community der Gruppe. Als wichtiger Ansprechpartner für lernbezogene Aktivitäten sorgen Sie für die reibungslose Bereitstellung von Lernprogrammen, Stakeholder-Unterstützung, LMS-Administration, Reporting und Kostenmanagement.

Diese Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit, zur Bereitstellung von Lernlösungen in der gesamten Gruppe beizutragen und gleichzeitig eng mit einem vielfältigen Netzwerk von internen Stakeholdern und externen Partnern zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Verwaltung des SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management Systems (LMS), einschließlich Kurs- und Klassenerstellung, Einschreibungsmanagement, Lernunterstützung und Systemadministration.
• Funktioniert als LMS-Co-Administrator, bietet First-Line-Support für Benutzer, Fehlersuche und sorgt für eine positive Lernerfahrung.
• Als zentrale Anlaufstelle für lernbezogene Anfragen und administrative Anfragen, um ein hohes Maß an Service für interne Stakeholder zu gewährleisten.

• Bereitstellung technischer Unterstützung für Nutzer von Lern- und Kollaborationsplattformen, einschließlich Klaxoon, Easygenerator und DataCamp.

Rechnungsstellung und Kostenmanagement
• Verwaltung der End-to-End-Verarbeitung von Rechnungen, einschließlich Sammlung, Überprüfung, Codierung und Übermittlung an die Buchhaltungsabteilung.
• Überwachung des Rechnungsstatus und der Zahlungen über ESKER und Nachverfolgung ausstehender Rechnungen bei Lieferanten.

• Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in einer operativen Unterstützung, HR-Administration, Lernadministration oder einer ähnlichen Rolle.

• Erweiterte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot-Tabellen, Datenvalidierung und Reporting).
• Frühere Erfahrungen in Learning & Talent Development, Training Administration oder HR Operations wären ein starker Vorteil.
• Bewährte Erfahrung in der Bereitstellung eines hohen Standards an kundenorientiertem Service und Stakeholder-Support.
• Starke Organisations- und Koordinationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten effektiv zu verwalten.
• Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten, konkurrierende Anforderungen zu priorisieren und genaue Ergebnisse in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu liefern.
• Erfahrung im Rechnungsmanagement, Budget-Tracking und Kostenschätzung.
• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und ausgezeichnete Liebe zum Detail.
• Hervorragende Kommunikation und Stakeholder Management Fähigkeiten.

• Erfahrung mit Reporting- und Datenanalyse-Tools.

Your team

Pictet North America Advisors SA provides investment services to private clients. Founded in 2007, the SEC-registered company devises portfolio diversification strategies for clients based in the US and Canada.

We are hiring a Senior Global Equity Portfolio Manager to strengthen the Portfolio Management team of its Geneva-based affiliate, Pictet North America Advisors, an SEC-registered independent financial advisor.

In this role, you will manage global equity mandates across different strategies, shaping differentiated portfolios for North American private clients and contributing to the ongoing development of our investment offering.

Your role

You will :

• Manage single-line equity mandates on behalf of private clients.

• Generate investment ideas and conduct fundamental bottom-up research.

• Select securities and construct portfolios.

• Provide clients with portfolio management updates and performance reports.

• Contribute actively to day-to-day portfolio management and trading activities

Your profile

• Master’s degree in Finance, or a qualification deemed equivalent.

• Postgraduate CIIA/CFA qualification, or equivalent.

• Adhere to the highest standards of integrity, show a strong team spirit and a genuine passion for securities analysis and investment management.

• Up to 10 years’ proven investment research experience, and keen to analyse diverse business models with a long-term perspective.

Il tuo ruolo

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

The main objective of this position is to perform in-depth analysis and checks on all types of investments in funds managed by FundPartner Solutions (FPS). The Valuer will play a key role in establishing and verifying valuation procedures, with a particular focus on Hedge Funds and Private Assets. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical skills, rigor, and a collaborative team spirit to analyze Audited Financial Statements and ensure the highest standards of accuracy and compliance.

• Back Testing Reporting: Present back testing reports to Conducting Officers or Boards as required, demonstrating the ability to clearly communicate findings and recommendations.

Your profile

• Master's degree in Economics or Finance

• Fluent in french and english

• 3 to 5 years experience in valuation, pricing, or corporate action, with a strong focus on analyzing Audited Financial Statements of Hedge Funds and Private Assets.

Experience in the audit of alternative funds (Hedge Funds or Private Assets) is also considered a strong asset.

• High level of rigor and organizational skills.

• Excellent problem-solving abilities.

• Strong team spirit and ability to collaborate effectively.

• Ability to present complex information clearly to senior management, Conducting Officers, or Boards, including back testing reports.

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Organisation & Digital, Risk and Tax departments.

Your role

• Ensure compliance of the AML Governance requirements (draft the Fund’s AML Documents; manage the Market Entry Forms; ensure the accuracy of RBE filings; cause the Fund to be registered with the AED, CSSF, or Go AML as the case may be).

• Participate to the acceptance process of new business relationships (ie Distributors, Investment Managers, Investors).

• Monitor, control and verify the compliance of the AML policy on a regular basis.

• Review escalations performed by the Service providers, and potentially implement the required actions in relation to submit SARs and STRs.

• Regularly report to the Funds’ Board of Directors on AML risks, and participate to the Board of Directors’ meetings to present the results of the RC controls.

• Report internally on the activity of the team and key AML risks identified, regarding the overall framework and particular products, to participate to the improvement of the internal control system from an AML perspective, and periodically participate to the Company’s Executive Committee to present the results of these controls.

• Act as the privileged contact person with the Luxembourg authorities, and all Funds’ relationships with regards to the AML questions.

• Assist the Funds Board of Directors in responding to any AML question raised by the Funds’ external auditors.

• Participate to the AML Regulatory Watch of the Company

• Work in close relationship with the different risk and compliance lines of defense (L1, L1 Risk and Compliance, L2 Compliance and internal audit).

Your profile

Requested experience:

• University degree in Economics or Finance

• 5 to 10 years’ experience in the area of Compliance (Corporate and/or AML), internal / external audit experience

Technical skills:

• At ease using computer systems and new technologies as well as an interest in these areas.

• Good knowledge of European and Luxembourg legislation (mandatory).

• Knowledge of the full remit of compliance competencies with a comprehensive understanding of the various roles in the investment fund industry, and more particularly of the operating mechanisms of a management company, but also of a custodian bank, transfer agent, fund administration and the related regulatory framework, will be considered as an asset.

Soft skills:

• Discretion, rigour, dependability and organisational skills

• Analytical skills (investigative mindset), sense of proportionality (risk-based approach) and sound critical thinking (professional judgement)

• Writing and communication skills, sense of diplomacy

• Team spirit (solidarity)

• Tech savvy profile

Language skills:

• French: fluent

• English: fluent

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

• Bequem mit Computersystemen und neuen Technologien sowie Interesse an diesen Bereichen.

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Pictet has been present in Hong Kong for 40 years where it employs around 200 people.

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

Your role

Mission

To lead the Business Risk and Compliance Management Team (“BRCM”), executing strategic initiatives while bridging operational execution with independent risk and compliance oversight.
To bridge the gap between business and independent risk management through advisory and day-to-day controls.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership

• Lead and supervise the operations of the BRCM team, ensuring an effective first line of defense control environment for Wealth Management.

• Support Management in fostering a strong risk awareness culture.

• Represent BRCM in governance committees for local and global initiatives and projects.

• Provide regular reports to Senior Management and Group PWM Risk and Compliance Management on BRCM activities and risk-related matters.

Oversight and Operational Excellence

• Monitor both anti-money laundering and non-anti-money laundering risks, advising Senior Management on enhancements to risk controls.

• Offer guidance to the front office on matters related to anti-money laundering and other compliance issues.

• Identify all types of risks, including compliance risks; design frameworks and implement mitigation measures for Wealth Management.

• Oversee and continuously improve the efficiency of the BRCM team across all business risk and compliance processes.

• Supervise the resolution of relevant audits and inspections.

• Provide support and feedback on New Product Services (NPS), ensuring that all business risk and compliance considerations are appropriately addressed.

• Perform any other duties as assigned.

Strategic Stakeholder Management

• Build and maintain proactive, constructive relationships with business and functional stakeholders.

• Collaborate with business lines and support function leadership to ensure risk considerations are integrated into business strategy and execution.

Your profile

• University degree.

• Professional certifications in Financial Crime or AML are advantageous.

• Minimum of 15 years’ experience in anti-money laundering and non-anti-money laundering matters, preferably within Wealth Management.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently conduct in-depth analysis on compliance matters.

• Self-starter with a solution-oriented mindset.

• Well-organized and detail oriented.

• Effective team leader and player.

• Good presentation skills.

• Proficient in common IT applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

• Good working knowledge of both English and Chinese.

Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà dei partner offre un'offerta completa per persone e famiglie ricche, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consultive e servizi di ufficio familiare. Stiamo cercando un diligente e intuitivo Buy-Side Analyst per aderire al nostro team di ricerca. Condurrai ricerche fondamentali approfondite sulle aziende di tutti i mercati sviluppati, con particolare attenzione ai settori dei consumatori, svilupperai modelli finanziari completi e fornirai raccomandazioni di investimento ad alta concorrenza agli stakeholder interni, in particolare ai gestori di portafoglio e ai consulenti. Il tuo ruolo
• Ricerca di base: Eseguire ricerche approfondite in aziende, industrie e tendenze macroeconomiche per identificare valori mobiliari errati.
• Modellazione finanziaria: costruire e mantenere modelli finanziari complessi e dinamici per prevedere guadagni e rendimenti futuri.
• Raccomandazioni di investimento: Autori di investimento memos e fornire raccomandazioni attuabili a Pictet Wealth Management.
• Due diligence: Conduct management interviste, partecipare conferenze del settore, e interagire con gli analisti del settore per raccogliere informazioni proprietarie.

Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The partner-owned financial services group provides a comprehensive offering for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

We are seeking a diligent and insightful Buy-Side Analyst to join our Research team. You will conduct in-depth fundamental research on companies across developed markets, with a particular focus on consumer sectors, develop comprehensive financial models, and deliver high-conviction investment recommendations to internal stakeholders, especially portfolio managers and advisors.

Your role

• Fundamental research: Perform deep-dive research into companies, industries, and macroeconomic trends to identify mispriced securities.
• Financial modeling: Build and maintain complex, dynamic financial models to forecast future earnings and returns.
• Investment recommendations: Author investment memos and deliver actionable recommendations to Pictet Wealth Management.
• Due diligence: Conduct management interviews, attend industry conferences, and interact with sell-side analysts to gather proprietary insights.
• AI-augmented research: Design and apply AI-driven tools and workflows to accelerate idea generation, enhance pattern detection, and increase the agility and scalability of fundamental research.

Your profile

• University degree: Master’s degree or a postgraduate qualification such as a CFA.
• At least 6 years of equity research experience on the buy side or sell side, ideally with multi-sector coverage; prior exposure to an Anglo-Saxon firm is a strong plus.
• Excellent command of written and spoken English (native or equivalent), and fluent or better command of written and spoken French.
• Strong fundamental equity research capabilities with excellent quantitative and qualitative skills, and a first-principles-based approach to analysis and communication.
• Outstanding written communication skills through investment memos and research notes, and excellent presentation skills to convey complex ideas clearly and convincingly.
• Complete proficiency in Bloomberg and Microsoft tools.
• Confident and effective user of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and similar applications, to enhance research productivity, insight generation and workflow efficiency.
• Independent-minded, intuitive, self-starter personality with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
• Strong focus on delivering high-quality, actionable outputs and meeting results-based expectations in a demanding investment environment.
• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

Ref: BSA/AJ/MJ

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Segnalando al responsabile dei servizi di reporting, si agirà come esperto di materia per i miglioramenti dei processi trasversali, collaborando con team interfunzionali per ottimizzare i processi end-to-end e fornire soluzioni di reporting client di prima classe.

Il tuo ruolo

• Controllare, documentare e ottimizzare i processi trasversali relativi alla reportistica del cliente, comprese le dichiarazioni del portafoglio, i consigli sulle transazioni e le relazioni di analisi delle prestazioni.

• Collabora con product manager, architetti d'impresa e stakeholder aziendali per allinearsi ai confini di processo, dipendenze e miglioramenti strategici.
• Condurre analisi approfondite di incidenti complessi e critici, supportando una risoluzione efficace e la condivisione delle conoscenze tra le squadre.
• Assicurare la documentazione aggiornata di regole e processi aziendali e promuovere la consapevolezza e l'allineamento dei processi in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Valuta l'impatto dei nuovi prodotti sui processi esistenti e partecipa al test di accettazione dell'utente (UAT) per garantire l'integrità del processo.
• Servire come punto di contatto principale per query e incidenti legati al processo, fornendo una guida esperta e un supporto alle parti interessate.

Il tuo profilo

Votre équipe

Les opérations assurent un traitement sûr et efficace des transactions bancaires et des fonds d'investissement de Pictet. Nos équipes s'assurent que toutes les activités suivent les règlements et gèrent les risques.
En développant et en maintenant une infrastructure moderne et robuste, nous garantissons des services fiables et de haute qualité pour la gestion de patrimoine, la gestion d'actifs et les clients immobiliers de Pictet.

En tant que gestionnaire des processus opérationnels (GPA) au sein des Services de rapport, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l'efficacité et l'excellence des opérations de rapport des clients. Relevant du Chef des Services de reporting, vous agirez en tant qu'expert en matière d'améliorations transversales des processus, en collaborant avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour optimiser les processus de bout en bout et fournir les meilleures solutions de reporting client.

Votre rôle

• Superviser, documenter et optimiser les processus transversaux liés à la déclaration des clients, y compris les énoncés de portefeuille, les conseils sur les transactions et les rapports d'analyse du rendement.
• Identifier et analyser les points de douleur et les domaines à améliorer, quantifier les gains de productivité attendus et améliorer l'expérience utilisateur.
• Collaborer avec les gestionnaires de produits, les architectes d'entreprise et les intervenants commerciaux afin de s'aligner sur les limites des processus, les dépendances et les améliorations stratégiques.
• Effectuer une analyse approfondie des incidents complexes et critiques, en appuyant la résolution efficace et le partage des connaissances entre les équipes.
• Assurer la documentation à jour des règles et des processus opérationnels et promouvoir la sensibilisation et l'harmonisation des processus dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Évaluer l'impact des lancements de nouveaux produits sur les processus existants et participer aux essais d'acceptation par les utilisateurs afin d'assurer l'intégrité des processus.
• Servir de point de contact principal pour les questions et incidents liés aux processus, en fournissant des conseils d'experts et un soutien aux parties prenantes.

Votre profil

• Diplôme universitaire en affaires, finances, génie, systèmes d'information, ou un domaine connexe.
• Expérience éprouvée dans l'optimisation des processus, l'analyse d'affaires ou la gestion de projets au sein des entreprises bancaires ou de services professionnels.
• De solides compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes, avec la capacité de gérer des projets complexes et interfonctionnels.
• Excellente capacité de communication et de gestion des intervenants, avec une mentalité collaborative et axée sur le client, axée sur le travail d'équipe et l'établissement de relations.
• La connaissance des processus de rapport des clients, des exigences réglementaires et des outils numériques est très appréciée.
• Compétence en anglais; l'allemand est un atout.
• Domicile en Suisse
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
• Possibilité de façonner et d'optimiser les processus clés dans un environnement bancaire international dynamique.
• Exposition aux projets stratégiques et collaboration interfonctionnelle avec les intervenants supérieurs.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) è un leader di asset manager di investimento alternativo che fa parte del Gruppo Pictet, con un focus su private equity, immobili, private credit and hedge fund. Pictet Group ha attualmente più di 50 miliardi di euro di AUM in alternative e più di 25 miliardi di euro di private equity AUM. Pictet ha lanciato il suo primo fondo di private equity diretto nel 2023, con un focus sugli investimenti di buyout europei di mercato medio, aumentando oltre €430m.
Poiché il fondo è ora in distribuzione attiva, stiamo cercando di espandere la nostra capacità di origine e assumere un Professionista di Originazione dedicato al mercato medio inferiore DACH.
Sarete parte di un team di 13 professionisti dedicati al fondo di private equity diretto. Il team investe principalmente in tutto il Regno Unito e DACH in aziende fondatrici nei servizi e nell'istruzione B2B.
Il vostro ruolo sarà basato su Zurigo con frequenti viaggi attraverso DACH e Londra, dove il fondo è basato.

Il tuo ruolo

In qualità di membro chiave del team di private equity diretto, sarai responsabile della generazione di una pipeline coerente e di alta qualità di opportunità di acquisizione proprietarie nel mercato inferiore DACH (EBITDA da 2 a 10 milioni di euro, aziende gestite dal proprietario). Il ruolo combina l'accesso diretto del fondatore e la copertura del consulente finanziario aziendale che supporta le priorità di investimento tematiche del team, e lo sviluppo di un moderno stack di tecnologia di origine. Le tue responsabilità includono:

• Origine diretta:

• Condurre la mappatura strutturata delle aziende all'interno di sottosettori allineati alle priorità tematiche del fondo;

• Eseguire la formazione multicanale strutturata per le imprese fondatrici;

• Viaggiare attraverso DACH per soddisfare gli imprenditori, qualificare le opportunità contro i criteri di investimento e nutrire le prospettive a lungo termine attraverso la gestione strutturata dei rapporti CRM;

• Valutare e distribuire nuovi strumenti di origine per scalare il bordo di sourcing dell'azienda.

• Consigliere e copertura intermedia:

• Costruire e mantenere un dialogo attivo con i consulenti regionali, le boutique di finanza aziendale e i contabili che consigliano le aziende gestite dal proprietario all'uscita;

• Viaggiare regolarmente attraverso DACH per incontrare i consulenti e posizionare il fondo in modo coerente per assicurarsi che sia il massimo della mente per i prossimi mandati di vendita.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea universitaria da un'istituzione forte; soggetto di laurea è secondario guidare, giudizio e istinto di origine.

• Tedesco madrelingua / lingua e forte fluenza inglese.

• 7-10 anni di esperienza lavorativa totale tra cui 2-5 anni in un ruolo incentrato sul contatto diretto e regolare con i proprietari di affari e i decisori senior nel Regno Unito - origine, sviluppo aziendale o freddo-outreach esperienza è essenziale.

• L'esperienza di origine in una società di private equity o in media consulenza di finanza aziendale è fortemente preferita; sfondi alternativi saranno considerati dove sono presenti forti attributi personali e l'esperienza di origine.

• Visibile energia di origine: un auto-starter risorse e resiliente con alti livelli di attività, confortevole con approcci freddi, il telefono e regolare viaggio DACH.

• Genuine persone: costruisce il rapporto naturalmente con i fondatori di aziende gestite dal proprietario, dimostrando maturità e giudizio commerciale, e guadagna fiducia rapidamente con gli intermediari.

• Fluente nella tecnologia di origine moderna (CRM, strumenti AI e piattaforme di outreach), attivamente curioso di implementare nuovi strumenti per scalare la sourcing proprietaria.

Al di là delle competenze professionali, il candidato ideale dovrebbe dimostrare la fame e il trambusto intelligente - alto rendimento abbinato a priorità acuta - accanto al giudizio commerciale, l'integrità nel trattare il fondatore sensibile e le conversazioni dei consulenti, e un approccio pragmatico per risolvere i problemi.

Come candidato scelto, avrete l'opportunità unica di unire una delle principali istituzioni finanziarie private del mondo. Sarete incorporati in un ambizioso team di investimenti diretti, lavorando in un ambiente dinamico "start-up" e approfittando del supporto di esperti professionisti senior all'interno del team PAA e del più ampio Gruppo Pictet.

Nota

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment asset manager that is part of the Pictet Group, with a focus on private equity, real estate, private credit and hedge funds. Pictet Group currently has more than €50bn of AUM in alternatives and more than €25bn of private equity AUM. Pictet launched its first direct private equity fund in 2023, with a focus on mid-market European buyout investments, raising over €430m.
As the fund is now in active deployment, we are looking to expand our origination capability and hire an Origination Professional dedicated to the DACH lower mid-market.
You will be part of a team of 13 professionals dedicated to the direct private equity fund. The team invests primarily across the UK and DACH in founder-led businesses in B2B services and education.
Your role will be based out of Zurich with frequent travel across DACH and London, where the fund is based.

Your role

As a key member of the direct private equity team, you will be responsible for generating a consistent, high-quality pipeline of proprietary acquisition opportunities in the DACH lower mid-market (€2–10m EBITDA, owner-managed businesses). The role combines direct founder outreach as well as corporate finance adviser coverage supporting the team’s thematic investment priorities, and the development of a modern origination tech stack. Your responsibilities will include:

• Direct Origination:

• Conduct structured mapping of companies within sub-sectors aligned to the fund's thematic priorities;

• Run structured multi-channel outreach to founder-led businesses;

• Travel across DACH to meet entrepreneurs, qualify opportunities against investment criteria, and nurture longer-term prospects through structured CRM-driven relationship management;

• Evaluate and deploy new origination tools to scale the firm's sourcing edge.

• Adviser & Intermediary Coverage:

• Build and maintain active dialogue with regional advisers, corporate finance boutiques and accountants who advise owner-managed businesses on exit;

• Travel regularly across DACH to meet advisers and position the fund consistently to ensure it is top of mind for upcoming sale mandates.

Your profile

• University degree from a strong institution; degree subject is secondary to drive, judgement and origination instinct.

• German native / mother tongue and strong English fluency.

• 7-10 years total work experience including 2-5 years in a role centred on direct, regular contact with business owners and senior decision-makers in the UK - origination, business development or cold-outreach experience is essential.

• Origination experience at a private equity firm or in mid-market corporate finance advisory is strongly preferred; alternative backgrounds will be considered where strong personal attributes and origination experience are present.

• Visible origination energy: a resourceful and resilient self-starter with high activity levels, comfortable with cold approaches, the phone, and regular DACH travel.

• Genuine people person: builds rapport naturally with founders of owner-managed businesses, demonstrating maturity and commercial judgement, and earns trust quickly with intermediaries.

• Fluent in modern origination technology (CRM, AI tools and outreach platforms), actively curious about deploying new tools to scale proprietary sourcing.

Beyond professional skills, the ideal candidate should demonstrate hunger and smart hustle - high output paired with sharp prioritisation - alongside commercial judgement, integrity in handling sensitive founder and adviser conversations, and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.

As the chosen candidate, you'll have the unique opportunity to join one of the world's leading private financial institutions. You'll be embedded in an ambitious direct investments team, working in a dynamic "start-up" environment while benefiting from the support of experienced senior professionals within the PAA team and the broader Pictet Group.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Dein Team

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) ist ein führender alternativer Investment-Asset-Manager, der Teil der Pictet-Gruppe ist und sich auf Private Equity, Immobilien, private Kredite und Hedgefonds konzentriert. Die Pictet Group verfügt derzeit über mehr als 50 Mrd. € AUM an Alternativen und über mehr als 25 Mrd. € Private Equity AUM. Pictet startete seinen ersten direkten Private-Equity-Fonds im Jahr 2023 mit einem Fokus auf mittelständische europäische Buyout-Investitionen und erzielte über 430 Millionen Euro.
Da sich der Fonds nun im aktiven Einsatz befindet, wollen wir unsere Origination-Kapazität erweitern und einen Origination Professional einstellen, der sich dem unteren Mittelstand von DACH widmet.
Sie werden Teil eines Teams von 13 Fachleuten sein, die sich dem direkten Private-Equity-Fonds widmen. Das Team investiert hauptsächlich in Großbritannien und DACH in gründergeführte Unternehmen in B2B-Dienstleistungen und Bildung.
Ihre Rolle wird aus Zürich mit häufigen Reisen über DACH und London, wo der Fonds basiert.

Deine Rolle

Als wichtiges Mitglied des Direkt-Private-Equity-Teams sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, eine konsistente, qualitativ hochwertige Pipeline von eigenen Akquisitionsmöglichkeiten im unteren DACH-Mittelstand zu generieren (2-10 Mio. € EBITDA, inhabergeführte Unternehmen). Die Rolle kombiniert direkte Gründer-Outreach sowie Corporate Finance Advisor-Abdeckung, die die thematischen Investitionsprioritäten des Teams unterstützt, und die Entwicklung eines modernen Origination-Tech-Stacks. Ihre Aufgaben umfassen:

• Direktursprung:

• Durchführung einer strukturierten Zuordnung von Unternehmen innerhalb von Teilsektoren, die auf die thematischen Prioritäten des Fonds ausgerichtet sind;

• Führen Sie strukturierte Multi-Channel-Outreachs für von Gründern geführte Unternehmen durch;

• Reisen Sie durch DACH, um Unternehmer zu treffen, Chancen anhand von Anlagekriterien zu qualifizieren und langfristige Perspektiven durch strukturiertes CRM-gesteuertes Beziehungsmanagement zu fördern;

• Bewerten und implementieren Sie neue Origination-Tools, um den Sourcing-Vorsprung des Unternehmens zu skalieren.

• Berater & Vermittler Coverage:

• Aufbau und Pflege eines aktiven Dialogs mit regionalen Beratern, Corporate Finance Boutiquen und Wirtschaftsprüfern, die inhabergeführte Unternehmen beim Ausstieg beraten;

• Reisen Sie regelmäßig durch DACH, um Berater zu treffen und den Fonds konsequent zu positionieren, um sicherzustellen, dass er bei bevorstehenden Verkaufsmandaten im Vordergrund steht.

Dein Profil

• Universitätsabschluss von einer starken Institution; Grad Thema ist sekundär zu Antrieb, Urteil und Ursprung Instinkt.

• Deutsche Muttersprache und starkes Englisch fließend.

• 7-10 Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon 2-5 Jahre in einer Rolle, die sich auf den direkten, regelmäßigen Kontakt mit Geschäftsinhabern und leitenden Entscheidungsträgern in Großbritannien konzentriert - Entstehung, Geschäftsentwicklung oder Cold-Outreach-Erfahrung sind unerlässlich.

• Originationserfahrung bei einer Private-Equity-Firma oder in der mittelständischen Unternehmensfinanzierungsberatung wird stark bevorzugt; alternative Hintergründe werden in Betracht gezogen, wenn starke persönliche Eigenschaften und Originationserfahrung vorhanden sind.

• Sichtbare Entstehungsenergie: ein einfallsreicher und belastbarer Selbststarter mit hoher Aktivität, komfortabel mit kalten Ansätzen, dem Telefon und regelmäßigen DACH-Reisen.

• Echte Menschen Person: baut eine natürliche Beziehung zu Gründern von inhabergeführten Unternehmen auf, zeigt Reife und kaufmännisches Urteilsvermögen und verdient schnell Vertrauen bei Vermittlern.

• Fließend in moderner Origination-Technologie (CRM, KI-Tools und Outreach-Plattformen), aktiv neugierig auf den Einsatz neuer Tools zur Skalierung proprietärer Sourcing.

Über die beruflichen Fähigkeiten hinaus sollte der ideale Kandidat Hunger und kluge Hektik zeigen - hohe Leistung gepaart mit scharfer Priorisierung - neben kommerziellem Urteilsvermögen, Integrität im Umgang mit sensiblen Gründer- und Beratergesprächen und einem pragmatischen Ansatz zur Problemlösung.

Als gewählter Kandidat haben Sie die einmalige Gelegenheit, einer der weltweit führenden privaten Finanzinstitute beizutreten. Sie sind in ein ehrgeiziges Direktinvestitionsteam eingebettet, das in einem dynamischen Start-up-Umfeld arbeitet und gleichzeitig von der Unterstützung erfahrener Führungskräfte innerhalb des PAA-Teams und der Pictet-Gruppe profitiert.

Votre équipe

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) est un gestionnaire d'actifs d'investissement de premier plan qui fait partie du groupe Pictet, en mettant l'accent sur les capitaux propres, l'immobilier, le crédit privé et les fonds spéculatifs. Pictet Group dispose actuellement de plus de 50 milliards d'AUM en alternatives et de plus de 25 milliards d'AUM en capitaux propres. Pictet a lancé son premier fonds de capital-investissement direct en 2023, en mettant l'accent sur les investissements de rachat à moyen terme en Europe, ce qui a permis de lever plus de 430 millions d'euros.
Comme le fonds est maintenant en déploiement actif, nous cherchons à développer notre capacité d'origine et à embaucher un professionnel d'origine dédié à la DACH inférieure du milieu du marché.
Vous ferez partie d'une équipe de 13 professionnels dédiée au fonds de capital-investissement direct. L'équipe investit principalement à travers le Royaume-Uni et DACH dans des entreprises dirigées par un fondateur dans les services B2B et l'éducation.
Votre rôle sera basé à Zurich avec des voyages fréquents à travers DACH et Londres, où le fonds est basé.

Votre rôle

En tant que membre clé de l'équipe de capital-investissement direct, vous serez responsable de la création d'un pipeline cohérent et de haute qualité d'opportunités d'acquisitions propriétaires dans le centre du marché de DACH (2-10 millions d'euros EBITDA, entreprises gérées par le propriétaire). Ce rôle combine la sensibilisation directe des fondateurs ainsi que la couverture des conseillers en finance d'entreprise soutenant les priorités d'investissement thématiques de l'équipe, et le développement d'une pile technologique d'origine moderne. Vos responsabilités comprendront :

• Origine directe:

• effectuer une cartographie structurée des entreprises au sein des sous-secteurs alignés sur les priorités thématiques du fonds;

• Exécuter des activités de sensibilisation multicanaux structurées aux entreprises dirigées par des fondateurs;

• Voyage à travers le DACH pour rencontrer les entrepreneurs, qualifier les opportunités par rapport aux critères d'investissement, et nourrir des perspectives à plus long terme par une gestion structurée des relations axée sur la CRM;

• Évaluer et déployer de nouveaux outils d'origine afin d'élargir l'approvisionnement de l'entreprise.

• Conseiller et intermédiaire Couverture :

• Établir et maintenir un dialogue actif avec les conseillers régionaux, les boutiques de financement d'entreprise et les comptables qui conseillent les entreprises gérées par leur propriétaire à la sortie;

• Voyagez régulièrement à travers le DACH pour rencontrer des conseillers et positionner le fonds de façon cohérente afin de s'assurer qu'il est haut de l'esprit pour les mandats de vente à venir.

Votre profil

• Diplôme universitaire d'une institution forte; sujet de diplôme est secondaire à la conduite, le jugement et l'instinct d'origine.

• Langue maternelle allemande et forte maîtrise de l'anglais.

• 7-10 ans d'expérience professionnelle totale, y compris 2-5 ans dans un rôle axé sur des contacts directs et réguliers avec les propriétaires d'entreprises et les décideurs supérieurs au Royaume-Uni - origine, développement d'entreprises ou expérience de sortie à froid est essentiel.

• L'expérience d'origine d'une entreprise de capital-investissement ou d'un conseil en finance d'entreprise au milieu du marché est fortement préférée; d'autres contextes seront considérés là où des attributs personnels et une expérience d'origine sont présents.

• Énergie d'origine visible : un auto-démarrage débrouillard et résilient avec des niveaux d'activité élevés, à l'aise avec les approches froides, le téléphone et les voyages réguliers DACH.

• Genuine person person: construit naturellement des rapports avec les fondateurs d'entreprises gérées par le propriétaire, démontrant la maturité et le jugement commercial, et gagne la confiance rapidement avec les intermédiaires.

• Fluent dans la technologie d'origine moderne (CRM, outils d'IA et plates-formes de sensibilisation), activement curieux de déployer de nouveaux outils pour élargir l'approvisionnement propriétaire.

Au-delà des compétences professionnelles, le candidat idéal devrait démontrer la faim et l'agitation intelligente - un rendement élevé associé à une hiérarchisation rigoureuse - ainsi que le jugement commercial, l'intégrité dans le traitement des conversations sensibles des fondateurs et des conseillers, et une approche pragmatique de la résolution des problèmes.

En tant que candidat choisi, vous aurez l'occasion unique de rejoindre l'une des principales institutions financières privées au monde. Vous serez intégré dans une équipe ambitieuse d'investissements directs, travaillant dans un environnement dynamique de démarrage tout en bénéficiant du soutien de professionnels expérimentés au sein de l'équipe de l'AAP et du groupe Pictet.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra Pictet Wealth Management combina oltre 200 anni di patrimonio bancario svizzero con competenze di investimento globali. Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà dei partner fornisce una gamma completa di supporto per persone e famiglie ricche, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consultive, nonché servizi per l'ufficio di famiglia. PWM Digital Solutions – Gli investimenti svolgono un ruolo centrale nella trasformazione della Wealth Management. Entro PWM Operazioni & IT, combiniamo competenze di business e tecnologia per costruire la piattaforma di investimento di domani - scalabile, data-driven e focalizzato sul valore del cliente. Ti unirai a un team ad alto impatto, modellando processi di investimento end-to-end in tutto il Front Office: Piattaforma di investimento, Trading, Compliance e Operazioni. Ti riferirai al Capo di PWM Digital Solutions – Investimenti e lavori in stretto contatto con Product Manager e Business Analysts. Il tuo ruolo Questo ruolo offre un'opportunità unica per prendere la proprietà e trasformare i processi chiave di investimento , con una forte attenzione al rischio, alle prestazioni, alla valutazione e alle capacità di calcolo avanzate. Potrai lavorare al cuore della catena del valore di investimento, assicurando che i processi e i flussi di dati consentono analisi robuste, esecuzione efficiente e migliori decisioni di investimento . Il vostro obiettivo funzionale chiave:
• Rischio e performance, valutazione, analisi scenari e simulazione
• Motori di calcolo (gestione rifiuti, ottimizzazione, consumo collaterale, ecc.) Il tuo impatto:
• Guidare la proprietà del processo end-to-end e processi di documento il ciclo di vita di investimento e oltre.
• Agire come esperto funzionale su temi di performance e rischio, valutazione e calcolo.
• Rafforzare i dati e i quadri di calcolo per garantire precisione e scalabilità.
• Collegare i team attraverso silos, tra cui il Front Office, la piattaforma di investimento, Trading, Compliance, IT & Operations.
• Trasformare la complessità in chiarezza, migliorare l'efficienza e l'esperienza dell'utente.
• Trasformare gli incidenti in miglioramenti duraturi lavorando con Product Manager, Business Analysts e team di supporto.
• Costruisci una conoscenza duratura e una trasparenza nei processi. Il tuo profilo
• Approssimativamente 10 anni di esperienza approfondita in:
• rischio e prestazioni
• valutazione, analisi scenari e simulazioni
• motori di calcolo, compresa la gestione dei contanti e l'ottimizzazione.
• Tech-savvy, con la capacità di lavorare su business e tecnologia (tra cui API e piattaforma dati).
• Esperienza comprovata nei processi di investimento in un ruolo trasversale.
• Forte mentalità analitica, con la capacità di semplificare argomenti complessi.
• Strutturato, autonomo e orientato alla consegna.
• La conoscenza della gestione collaterale sarebbe un vantaggio.
• Fluente in francese e inglese.
• Residente in Svizzera. Sei tu:
• entusiasta di portare rigore e scalabilità ai processi di investimento?
• stimolato da ambienti complessi e ruoli ad alto impatto?
• in grado di influenzare le squadre e abbattere silos?
