Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The partner-owned financial services group provides a comprehensive range of support for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions, as well as family office services.

PWM Digital Solutions – is at the heart of the Tech Wealth Management transformation.

Within PWM Operations & IT, we combine business and technology expertise to build the Tech tools for the investment platform of tomorrow — scalable, data-driven and focused on client value.

You will join a high-impact team , shaping how Tech improves the end-to-end investment platform processes across the Front Office: Investment Platform, Trading, Compliance and Operations.

You will report to the Head of PWM Digital Solutions – Investment and work in closely with Product Managers and Business Analysts.

Your role

This role offers a unique opportunity to support the tech transformation of the investment processes , with a strong focus on risk, performance, valuation and advanced calculation capabilities .

You will work at the heart of the investment value chain, ensuring that processes and data flows enable robust analytics, efficient execution and better investment decisions .

Your key functional focus:

• Risk and performance, valuation, scenario analysis and simulation

• Calculation engines (cash management, optimisation, collateral consumption, etc.)

Your impact:

• Be accountable to lead the resolution of complex tech & business process challenges, including Tech process documentation across the investment lifecycle and beyond.

• Act as a functional expert between Tech & Investment Platform for performance & risk, valuation, and calculation topics.

• Strengthen data and calculation frameworks to ensure accuracy and scalability.

• Connect teams across silos (Front, Investment Platform, Trading, Compliance, IT & Operations) – to build strong alignment & collaboration.

• Turn complexity into clarity , improving efficiency and user experience.

• Transform incidents into lasting improvements by identifying gaps and collaborating with Product Managers, Business Analysts & support teams.

• Enabling decision-making through clear process governance and stakeholder engagement.

• Build durable knowledge and transparency across tech teams, business experts & processes.

Your profile

• Approximately 10 years’ in-depth expertise in:

• Technology

• risk and performance

• valuation, scenario analysis and simulations

• calculation engines, including cash-management and optimisation.

• Tech-savvy, with ability to work across business and technology (including APIs and data platform).

• Proven experience in investment processes in a cross-functional role.

• Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to simplify complex topics.

• Structured, autonomous and delivery-focused.

• Knowledge of collateral management would be an advantage.

• Fluent in French and English.

• Resident in Switzerland.

Are you:

• Passionate about bringing rigour and scalability to investment processes with the help of technology

• Energised by complex environments and high-impact roles

• Able to influence across teams and break silos

• Focused on delivering concrete, measurable outcomes

• Willing to shape the future Tech operating model , not just maintain it

We are looking for a BPM who wants to go beyond process management — and actively shape how Tech investment capabilities are designed, scaled, and delivered with a collaborative approach.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

La tua squadra In qualità di Responsabile dell'Amministrazione del Fondo, gestisci la supervisione generale delle attività di gestione dei fondi di investimento svizzeri, garantendo la qualità, la conformità e l'efficienza dei processi. Sei il punto di ingresso per richieste operative e di governance relative ai fondi, coordinare le attività delegate e sostenere clienti interni ed esterni nella riflessione e nell'implementazione di nuovi fondi. Si gioca un ruolo chiave nella supervisione delle operazioni, compresa la valutazione dei beni illiquidi (Equità privata), e nell'evoluzione degli strumenti di controllo e dei metodi. Il tuo ruolo
• Superare il processo di calcolo del valore dell'inventario netto (NV), effettuare controlli adeguati e supervisione delle operazioni delegati.
• Assicurare la valutazione degli investimenti, compresi i beni alternativi, e supervisionare le attività preparatorie delegati
• Monitorare e convalidare le tasse, le tasse e i dividendi applicati ai fondi in conformità con i prospetti e i contratti.
• Preparare e rivedere le chiusure annuali e semestrali dei fondi, condurre una revisione critica dei conti, proporre modifiche necessarie.
• Organizzare e monitorare gli audit dei fondi (interni ed esterni), coordinare gli scambi con i revisori e rispondere alle loro richieste.
• Coordinare e convalidare l'emissione di rapporti normativi e finanziari, garantire la loro diffusione agli stakeholder (FINMA, clienti, CA).

• Monitorare le statistiche SNB e garantire la conformità dei dati trasmessi.
• Monitorare la tassazione dei fondi, monitorare i rendimenti e le richieste, partecipare al coordinamento con le autorità fiscali.
• Elaborare e monitorare i conti finanziari della società.
• Fornire supporto operativo ai vari servizi interni ed esterni all'azienda e monitorare le richieste dei clienti.
• Siate il punto di ingresso e di follow-up per tutte le richieste operative e di governance rivolte alla gestione dei fondi, sia da parte di clienti interni (Pictet) che di clienti esterni (fondi di terze parti)
• Sostenere i clienti nella riflessione e nella strutturazione di nuovi fondi, fornendo una visione di consulenza e competenze tecniche.
• Gli strumenti di pilota e di supporto e i progetti di automazione di controllo, propongono sviluppi per migliorare l'efficienza e la sicurezza dei processi.
• Contribuire al mantenimento della corporate governance e partecipare alla preparazione del reporting per i comitati di gestione e il Consiglio di Amministrazione. Il tuo profilo
• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, economia o formazione ritenuto equivalente.
• Esperienza confermata di almeno 8 anni nell'audit, nell'amministrazione dei fondi o in una posizione simile nel settore bancario/finanziario
• Esperienza nella gestione del team e nella conduzione di progetti di automazione o sviluppo di strumenti/processi.
• Forte conoscenza operativa e tecnica sui fondi (contabilità, tassazione, processo di calcolo NAV, prezzi, reporting, controllo interno).
• Buona comprensione delle normative svizzere e internazionali applicabili ai fondi (LPCC, LEFin, LSFin, ecc.).
• Mastery of French (lingua di lavoro), ottima conoscenza dell'inglese (scritto e orale), tedesco è un bene.

Your team As Head of Fund Administration, you manage the overall supervision of Swiss investment fund administration activities, ensuring the quality, compliance and efficiency of the processes. You are the point of entry for fund-related operational and governance requests, coordinate delegated activities, and support internal and external clients in the reflection and implementation of new funds. You play a key role in the supervision of operations, including the valuation of illiquid assets (Private Equity), and in the evolution of control tools and methods. Your role
• Supervise the process of calculating net inventory value (NV), carry out proper controls and supervision of delegated operations.
• Ensure valuation of investments, including alternative assets, and supervise delegated preparatory activities
• Monitor and validate fees, fees and dividends applied to funds in accordance with prospectuses and contracts.
• Prepare and review annual and semi-annual fund closures, conduct a critical review of accounts, propose necessary adjustments.
• Organize and monitor audits of funds (internal and external), coordinate exchanges with auditors, and respond to their requests.
• Coordinate and validate the issuance of regulatory and financial reports, ensure their dissemination to stakeholders (FINMA, clients, CA).
• Manage all current transactions at the level of funds under administration (in-kind contribution or exit, transfer agent flow, etc.)
• Monitor SNB statistics and ensure compliance of data transmitted.
• Monitor the taxation of funds, monitor returns and claims, participate in coordination with tax authorities.
• Process and monitor the financial accounts of the company.
• Provide operational support to the various internal and external services to the company and monitor client requests.
• Be the point of entry and follow-up for all operational and governance requests addressed to fund management, both by internal clients (Pictet) and external clients (third party funds)
• To support clients in the reflection and structuring of new funds, providing a consulting vision and technical expertise.
• Pilot and support tools and controls automation projects, propose developments to enhance process efficiency and security.
• Contribute to the maintenance of corporate governance and participate in the preparation of reporting for management committees and the Board of Directors. Your profile
• University degree in finance, accounting, economics or training deemed equivalent.
• Confirmed experience of at least 8 years in the audit, fund administration or similar position in the banking/financial sector
• Experience in team management and in conducting automation or tool/process development projects.
• Strong operational and technical knowledge on funds (accounting, taxation, NAV calculation process, pricing, reporting, internal control).
• Good understanding of Swiss and international regulations applicable to funds (LPCC, LEFin, LSFin, etc.).
• Mastery of French (working language), excellent knowledge of English (written and oral), German is an asset.
• Mastery of MS Office tools and fund management systems (Avaloq, Multifunds, etc. a plus).
• Rigor, precision, sense of organization and detail.
• Proactivity, autonomy, ability to solve problems and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
• Team spirit, ability to collaborate with different departments and to communicate with various interlocutors.
• Intellectual curiosity, learning capacity, initiative and customer orientation.
• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to settle there. Votre équipe

FundPartner Solutions (FPS) propose une gamme complète de services d’administration de fonds et de création de fonds sur mesure. Ses équipes de spécialistes apportent leurs compétences en matière de domiciliation, d’enregistrement et de gouvernance de fonds, ainsi que de gestion des risques et de contrôle du respect des directives de placement.

En tant que Responsable Fund Administration, vous pilotez la supervision globale des activités d’administration de fonds de placement de droit suisse, en assurant la qualité, la conformité et l’efficience des processus. Vous êtes le point d’entrée pour les demandes opérationnelles et de gouvernance liées aux fonds, coordonnez les activités déléguées, et accompagnez les clients internes et externes dans la réflexion et la mise en place de nouveaux fonds. Vous jouez un rôle clé dans la supervision des opérations, y compris la valorisation des actifs illiquides (Private Equity), et dans l’évolution des outils et méthodes de contrôle.

Votre rôle

• Superviser le processus de calcul de la valeur nette d’inventaire (VNI), procéder aux contrôles idoines et à la supervision des opérations déléguées.

• Assurer l’évaluation des placements y compris des actifs alternatifs et procéder à la supervision des activités préparatoires déléguées

• Contrôler et valider les commissions, frais et dividendes appliqués aux fonds, en conformité avec les prospectus et contrats.

• Préparer et revoir les clôtures annuelles et semestrielles des fonds, effectuer une revue critique des comptes, proposer les ajustements nécessaires.

• Organiser et suivre les audits des fonds (internes et externes), coordonner les échanges avec les auditeurs, répondre à leurs demandes.

• Coordonner et valider l’émission des rapports réglementaires et financiers, assurer leur diffusion auprès des parties prenantes (FINMA, clients, CA).

• Gérer toutes opérations courantes au niveau des fonds sous administration (apport ou sortie en nature, flux avec l’agent de transfert, etc)

• Assurer le suivi des statistiques BNS et veiller à la conformité des données transmises.

Per sostenere questa missione, il team Risk & Compliance – Operations identifica, valuta e mitiga i rischi operativi garantendo nel contempo la conformità alle politiche interne e alle normative applicabili. Per rafforzare il nostro team, stiamo cercando un Senior Risk & Compliance Manager con un forte background nel rischio operativo bancario e la conformità, e la capacità di condurre importanti iniziative di rischio attraverso operazioni bancarie. L'esperienza nella salvaguardia dei criptoasset, così come la competenza nella gestione dei dati, nell'analisi dei dati o nella scienza dei dati per l'ottimizzazione e la segnalazione dei processi, sarebbe un bene prezioso. • coordinare e contribuire al processo RCSA (Risk and Control Self-Assessment) per le operazioni bancarie.
• fornire supporto consultivo alla prima linea di difesa in materia di rischi operativi e gestire specifiche richieste di conformità operativa.
• guidare progetti di rischio chiave e piani di azione all'interno delle operazioni bancarie, assicurando la consegna tempestiva e l'escalation, se necessario.
• utilizzare le capacità di gestione dei dati e di analisi dei dati per migliorare il monitoraggio dei rischi, il reporting e i processi decisionali.
• per ricevere, registrare e monitorare gli incidenti operativi, e supervisionare l'analisi causa radice e il follow-up amministrativo.
• monitorare i piani di mitigazione dei rischi e degli incidenti e monitorare l'attuazione delle raccomandazioni di audit.
• preparare rapporti chiari e concisi sui rischi e presentazioni per gli organi di governance e le funzioni centrali.

• Almeno cinque o otto anni di esperienza rilevante nel rischio operativo, nel rispetto o nell’audit di un istituto bancario o finanziario di medie dimensioni o di grandi dimensioni.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

The Operations division is responsible for the secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment fund activities. To support this mission, the Risk & Compliance – Operations team identifies, assesses and mitigates operational risks while ensuring compliance with internal policies and applicable regulations.

To bolster our team, we are seeking a Senior Risk & Compliance Manager with a strong background in banking operational risk and compliance, and the ability to lead major risk initiatives across Banking Operations. Experience in safeguarding cryptoassets, as well as expertise in data management, data analysis or data science for process optimisation and reporting, would be a valuable asset.

Your role

• to support the identification and analysis of emerging operational risk trends.

• to periodically review operational risk appetite and tolerance, develop key risk indicators (KRIs) and monitor their effectiveness.

• to coordinate and contribute to the RCSA (Risk and Control Self-Assessment) process for Banking Operations.

• to provide advisory support to the first line of defence on operational risk matters and handle specific operational compliance requests.

• to drive key risk projects and action plans within Banking Operations, ensuring timely delivery and escalation where needed.

• to use data management and data analysis skills to enhance risk monitoring, reporting and decision-making processes.

• to receive, log and monitor operational incidents, and oversee root-cause analysis and administrative follow-up.

• to monitor risk and incident mitigation plans and track the implementation of audit recommendations.

• to prepare clear, concise risk reports and presentations for governance bodies and central functions.

• to promote a strong risk culture through training, workshops and awareness activities.

• to maintain regular contact with risk managers and compliance officers across business lines, divisions and Group entities abroad.

Your profile

• University degree in Finance, Business, Law or Economics, or professional qualification deemed equivalent.

• At least five to eight years’ relevant experience in operational risk, compliance or audit at a mid-sized or large bank or financial institution.

• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior management.

• Proven ability to lead projects successfully.

• Excellent analytical skills and keen attention to detail; proficiency in MS Office/Excel; knowledge of Tableau would be an asset.

• Sound knowledge of data management, data analysis or data science, and their application in process optimisation, risk reporting or automation, would be highly desirable.

• Fluency in French and English (spoken and written), with at least C1 level or equivalent in each language.

• Must be resident in Switzerland.

Ref. SRCM/CRO/AS

Your team The Pictet Group is a leading independent wealth and asset management firm operating globally. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group maintains operations in 30 offices across key financial centers worldwide, employing more than 4,600 professionals. Pictet has been present in Singapore for over 30 years, supported by a team exceeding 200 employees. We are seeking a diligent and insightful Buy-Side Analyst to join our Asia Equity Research team. You will be responsible for conducting in-depth fundamental research on companies across sectors in Asian markets, with a focus on industrial, energy, and consumer companies; developing comprehensive investment theses; and providing high-conviction investment recommendations to our internal stakeholders, in particular portfolio managers and advisors. Some expertise to the technology sector and its major companies would be beneficial. Your role
• Fundamental research: Perform deep-dive research into companies, industries, and macroeconomic trends to identify mispriced securities; initial focus on Industrial and Consumer companies.
• Financial modelling: Build and maintain complex, dynamic financial models to forecast future earnings and returns.
• Investment recommendations: Author investment memos and deliver actionable recommendations to Pictet Wealth Management.
• Due diligence: Conduct management interviews, attend industry conferences, and interact with sell-side analysts to gather proprietary insights.
• AI-augmented research: Design and apply AI-driven tools and workflows to accelerate idea generation, enhance pattern detection, and increase the agility and scalability of fundamental research. Your profile
• Experience: At least 6 years of equity research experience on the buy side or sell side, ideally with multi-sector coverage; prior exposure to a leading financial institution is a strong plus.
• Language skills: Excellent command of written and spoken English (native or equivalent) and fluent or better command of written and spoken Mandarin as the role requires frequent research and communication involving Chinese companies and Mandarin-language sources
• Research & Analytical Skills: Strong fundamental equity research capabilities with excellent quantitative (but non-quant) skills, and a first-principles-based approach to analysis and communication.
• Communication & Presentation Skills: Outstanding written communication skills (investment memos, research notes) and excellent presentation skills to convey complex ideas clearly and convincingly.
• IT & Tools proficiency: Complete proficiency in Bloomberg (terminal and Excel API), Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; solid working knowledge of VBA.
• AI proficiency: Confident and effective user of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude and similar applications) to enhance research productivity, insight generation and workflow efficiency.
• Personal qualities: Independent-minded, intuitive, self-starter personality with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, while being a team player.
• Results orientation: Strong focus on delivering high-quality, actionable outputs and meeting results-based expectations in a demanding investment environment. Your team

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment asset manager that is part of the Pictet Group, with a focus on private equity, real estate, infrastructure, private credit and hedge funds. Pictet Group currently has more than €50bn of AUM in alternatives and more than €25bn of private equity AUM.

Pictet launched its first direct private equity fund in 2023, with a focus on lower mid market European buyout investments, raising over €430m. The fund operates out of London and focuses on investments in founder and family owned companies in B2B Services and Education across the UK and the DACH regions.

Your role

As part of a team of 12 professionals, you will be responsible for Investor Relations. Your responsibilities will include:

• Building and maintaining working relationships with Pictet's Wealth Management (PWM) relationship managers and Asset Management (PAM) sales staff across the network, understanding their client books, distribution priorities, and the broader Pictet product shelf;

• Proactively identifying and developing relationships with Limited Partners (LPs) and co-investment prospects — leveraging existing relationships within Pictet to do so;
• Runing a regular engagement calendar of product briefings, market updates, Q&A sessions, and bilateral meetings with distribution partners and LPs;
• Managing LP relationships through the full fund cycle — from first meeting through commitment, onboarding, ongoing reporting, and re-ups;
• Knowing the portfolio in sufficient depth to hold detailed investor conversations on any company without requiring a member of the senior investment team to be present;
• Owning all investor-facing materials — pitch deck, DDQ, LP updates, fund profile — working closely with PAA Marketing and Communications to ensure quality, consistency, and alignment with PAA brand guidelines;
• Maintaining DealCloud as the primary record of LP relationships and pipeline; use AI tools (Claude, Copilot) in materials drafting, research, competitor tracking, and preparation.

Your profile

• Minimum 7 years' experience in investor relations, product specialist, or distribution within private equity, private credit, or private markets;
• Direct experience working with private banking or wealth management distribution channels and managing LP relationships through the full fund cycle;
• Financially literate — able to discuss fund performance, portfolio company financials, and return attribution with confidence;
• Experience with DealCloud or a comparable CRM platform will be preferred; strong written communication skills and the ability to produce clear, accurate investor-grade documents is required.
• Credible with senior counterparts — PWM bankers, institutional allocators, and private clients; builds rapport naturally, follows through consistently, and navigates a multi-boutique, multi-stakeholder environment effectively
• Genuinely passionate about private equity and the underlying investment strategy, with the ability to convey the investment story with conviction to clients and prospects; French language capability preferred but not required.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Votre équipe Le groupe Pictet est l'un des leaders mondiaux des gestionnaires de patrimoine et d'actifs indépendants. Fondé en 1805 et ayant son siège social à Genève, le Groupe est représenté dans 30 bureaux dans les centres financiers du monde entier et emploie actuellement plus de 5200 personnes. Pictet est présent depuis 1989 au Luxembourg, où il emploie plus de 700 personnes. FundPartner Solutions offre une gamme complète de services d'administration de fonds et de fonds de marques privées. L'équipe mondiale d'experts de l'industrie se spécialise dans la domiciliation des fonds, l'enregistrement et la gouvernance, ainsi que dans la conformité aux risques et les services de gestion des investissements. Les opérations assurent un traitement sûr et efficace des transactions bancaires et des fonds d'investissement de Pictet. Nos équipes s'assurent que toutes les activités suivent les règlements et gèrent les risques. En développant et en maintenant une infrastructure moderne et robuste, nous garantissons des services fiables et de haute qualité pour la gestion de patrimoine, la gestion d'actifs et les clients immobiliers de Pictet. Votre rôle
• En tant qu'agent de service à la clientèle (interne et externe), jouer un rôle actif dans la résolution des problèmes et répondre rapidement aux clients, en coordination avec d'autres ministères.
• Répondre à différentes demandes d'investisseurs et de clients pour garantir la prestation d'un service de qualité, qui répond aux exigences des clients haut de gamme.
• Fournir du soutien aux demandeurs internes (clients, gestionnaires de fonds et autres ministères).
• Participer activement à des projets d'amélioration planifiés ou en cours au sein de l'équipe du Service à la clientèle.
• En tant qu'intermédiaire privilégié pour les investisseurs et les clients, fournir une communication pour s'assurer que les commandes des clients sont enregistrées sans erreur et conformément aux clauses des différents prospectus et aux règlements en vigueur.
• Participer aux réunions de diligence raisonnable, aux examens des services et aux visites des clients au besoin. Votre profil
• Maîtrise en économie ou finance
• Fluent en français et anglais
• Mini 5 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire et/ou travaillant comme agent de transfert
• Connaissance approfondie de l'administration des fonds d'investissement.
• Une volonté de s'engager sur le long terme, travaillant dans un département en constante évolution.
• Résistant au stress, dynamique, rigoureux et faisant preuve d'initiative lors de la résolution des problèmes.
• Un esprit curieux avec la capacité de saisir de nouvelles choses rapidement.
• Un sens aigu du service à la clientèle et une volonté de trouver des solutions appropriées. • “Investment partnership” con i gestori di relazioni per offrire ai clienti di Pictet un’esperienza di investimento unica e un servizio.
• Fornire soluzioni di investimento ottimizzate ai clienti con un approccio di squadra.
• Crescere bene le attività in soluzioni gestionali e gestite. responsabilità

• Comunicare la strategia e le soluzioni della piattaforma di investimento per RM, clienti e prospettive.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con la piattaforma di investimento di Ginevra e Asia e sfruttare la piattaforma di prodotto della Banca.
• Fornire consigli e opinioni proattive su aziende o settori specifici per clienti commerciali sofisticati e attivi.
• In combinazione con RM, identificare e sviluppare nuove opportunità di business dalla base client esistente e contribuire a convertire le prospettive in clienti.
• Incontra clienti e prospettive insieme a RMs.
• Aiuta a determinare le esigenze dei clienti e preparare proposte di investimento su misura.
• Portafogli client di implementazione, monitoraggio e riequilibrio.
• Eseguire gli ordini commerciali e confermare l'esecuzione ai clienti, direttamente o tramite Client Relationship Officers.

• Laurea in Finanza materie correlate.

Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Pictet has been present in Hong Kong for 40 years where it employs around 200 people. Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services. Your role Mission
• “Investment partnership” with relationship managers to deliver Pictet’s clients a unique investment experience and service.
• Deliver optimized investment solutions to clients with a team approach.
• Profitably grow assets under management and managed solutions. Responsibilities
• Keep up to date with the financial markets, the Bank’s views, research and product offering across the whole firm (PWM, PAM and PAA).
• Communicate the investment platform strategy and solutions to RMs, clients and prospects.
• Work closely with the investment Platform in Geneva and Asia and leveraging on the Bank’s product platform.
• Provide pro-active advice and views on specific companies or sectors for sophisticated and active trading clients.
• In conjunction with RMs, identify and develop new business opportunities from the existing client base as well as helping convert prospects into clients.
• Meet clients and prospects together with RMs.
• Help determine clients’ needs and prepare tailor made investment proposals.
• Implement, monitor and rebalance client portfolios.
• Execute trade orders and confirm execution to clients, either directly or through Client Relationship Officers.
• Conduct risk suitability check and selling process for investment ideas initiated by investment specialist. Your profile
• Degree in Finance related subjects.
• 10 - 15 years of experience as investment specialist in multi-asset class advisory within the wealth management/private banking sector.
• Strong client-focused attitude with a proactive mindset.
• Independent, initiative driven, mature, credible and comfortable in dealing with key clients and senior RMs.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
• Strong sense of teamwork.
• Rigorous, organized, analytical, with an eye or detail.
• Fluent in English and Mandarin.
• Travelling to Mainland China and Taiwan for client meetings required. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 31 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5,000 people. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 25 years where it employs over 200 people. Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services. Your role We are seeking a highly motivated Financial Analyst to join our Asia 2 team as part of a unique, structured 4-year rotational programme designed to provide a comprehensive foundation in private banking and investment management. At the end of this programme, you will be equipped to take on the role of Private Banker, supported by a robust in-house network of specialists and an understanding of our business and clients. This permanent position offers a 48-month journey through three key areas of our Wealth Management business, allowing you to build expertise and develop a strong professional network:
• Year 1: Immersion with Client Relationship Officers to discover client relationship management and daily operations.
• Years 2 & 3: Integration within the Investment Platform to deepen your knowledge of investment and portfolio management, and to understand the needs of portfolio managers.
• Year 4: Gaining practical experience in high-level wealth management advisory through the management of an existing client portfolio. Throughout the programme, you will be mentored by a Senior Banker and will collaborate with professionals across the banking sector, support the implementation of wealth management strategies, and contribute to the delivery of tailored solutions for our clients. You will also have the opportunity to complete professional certifications, such as the CFA, and participate in ongoing training and development activities. Your profile
• Master’s or Bachelor's degree in Finance or Management with 3 to 5 years of professional experience.
• Enthusiasm, interpersonal skills, and a strong interest in client relations.
• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines.
• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
• Team player with a positive attitude, strong work ethic, and the ability to adapt quickly. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services. You will build “investment partnerships” with CRMs and fellow ISs to deliver clients a unique investment experience aligned to their needs and geographical specificities. You will also assist CRMs in their business development efforts by identifying and presenting the most suitable investment solutions available and activate non-managed accounts. Your role
• Communicating the investment platform’s strategy and solutions to CRMs, clients and prospects.
• In conjunction with the CRMs, identify and develop new business opportunities from the existing client base as well as taking part in new marketing initiatives to help convert prospects to clients.
• Help determine clients’ needs and prepare investment/advisory proposals and portfolio reviews.
• Execute trade orders and confirm execution to clients, either directly or through assistants.
• Develop, sell and retain discretionary mandates and seek to centralise their management.
• Oversee ‘advisory-type’ mandates, seeking to streamline positions and exposure and ensure they remain consistent with the bank’s overall investment strategy and policy.
• Maintain a strong compliance culture, ensuring optimal compliance and risk management by adhering to all relevant local laws, regulatory requirements, in-house directives and procedures. Acquire the appropriate knowledge to apply these effectively and ensure fair treatment of all clients, while at the same time adhering to the mission and core values of Pictet across all activities conducted with a high degree of professional competency and awareness. These entail:
• Full understanding of Pictet’s offering, policies and guidelines, attending relevant investment forums and presentations.
• An ability to present and defend the investment philosophy and mandate/product offering.
• Regular reviews of portfolios to monitor adherence to risk controls, compliance and client constraints.
• Investment of cash positions, review of client transactions and corporate actions.
• Full understanding of attribution of own portfolio performance.
• Developing appropriate marketing material for client communication.
• Knowledge of all available marketing documents and key resources within the Group. Your profile
• Bachelor’s degree and a post-graduate degree such as a Master’s, MBA, CIIA or CFA would be an advantage.
• At least ten years’ investment advisory/management experience; client-facing experience is a must.
• Fluency in Russian, English is required. French and Polish language skills are considered a plus in addition to the required languages.
• Excellent technical knowledge across asset classes, investment vehicles and the mandate/product offering.
• Excellent understanding of portfolio construction, investment processes and risk management approaches.
• IT-proficient, including knowledge of relevant software packages, on-line information systems, front-end management and order-placing systems (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Adobe, Bloomberg, Avaloq, Profolio, , etc.).
• Strong client-focused attitude and used to working under pressure.
• Excellent presentation skills.
• Proven team player but also able to work on one’s own.
• Cross asset class experience with solid knowledge of fixed income (EM and DM), derivatives, equities, and structured products.
• Solid understanding/experience in private equity and other alternative investments.
• Experience and understanding of thematic equities would be a strong advantage.
• Ability to explain complex concepts in simple terms. ref: IS/AJ/KZ Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. La tua squadra Pictet Tech progetta, integra e gestisce applicazioni software che vanno dai sistemi di gestione del portafoglio e piattaforme di trading alle soluzioni bancarie e aziendali. La divisione è responsabile di alcune delle innovazioni chiave del Gruppo, sostenendo le operazioni aziendali. Il team Cloud Platform gestisce la zona di atterraggio cloud di Pictet ed è il partner che i nostri team ingegneri si rivolgono a quando si costruiscono su di esso. Mentre l'adozione del cloud cresce attraverso la comunità ingegneristica di Pictet, il nostro obiettivo è quello di aiutare le squadre a muoversi più velocemente con meno attrito. Come Tech Lead in questo team, si costruirà e gestirà la piattaforma, ancorare le decisioni tecniche e sollevare la barra di ingegneria come noi maturano dall'automazione a un prodotto self-service. Il tuo ruolo
• operare e migliorare continuamente la zona di atterraggio cloud di Pictet su AWS e Azure, agendo come consulente tecnico affidabile per gli ingegneri che si costruiscono su di esso.
• per dare consigli e lavorare con i team di prodotti co-costruire i progetti cloud, trasformando i modelli condivisi in blocchi di costruzione self-service riutilizzabili.
• per portare il passaggio dall'automazione a una piattaforma self-service progettando il percorso pavimentato e lo strato di astrazione che riduce il carico cognitivo dei clienti interni.
• per agire come Tech Lead ancorando le decisioni chiave di progettazione, mentoring ingegneri e la regolazione degli standard pavimentati-road affidati dal team e dai suoi clienti interni.
• allineare con gli sviluppatori, gli ingegneri delle infrastrutture, la sicurezza informatica e i responsabili del rischio per applicare gli standard e fornire guida, e la costruzione in sicurezza e buona pratica per impostazione predefinita. Il tuo profilo
• Forte capacità di ingegneria del software: si scrive codice di qualità della produzione in Python, Go o un linguaggio equivalente, e portare la disciplina necessaria per trasformare l'automazione in una piattaforma self-service mantenibile.
• Competenze approfondite nell'infrastruttura come codice su AWS e/o Azure, con una forte esperienza Terraform e, idealmente, l'esposizione alla zona di atterraggio o alla governance e all'automazione multi-account.
• Sfondo di architettura solida nell'identità e nella gestione degli accessi, nella rete e nell'integrazione, con la capacità di ragionare attraverso le scelte di progettazione.
• Una mentalità platform-as-a-product: si tratta di ingegneri interni come clienti e la cura di adozione, self-service e l'esperienza di sviluppo.
• Esperienza come lead tecnologico o senior singoli collaboratori, prendere e guidare le decisioni tecniche per un team.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team Pictet Tech designs, integrates and operates software applications ranging from portfolio management systems and trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. The division is responsible for some of the Group’s key innovations while sustaining business operations. The Cloud Platform team operates Pictet’s cloud landing zone and is the partner our engineering teams turn to when they build on it. As cloud adoption grows across Pictet’s engineering community, our goal is to help teams move faster with less friction. As a Tech Lead in this team, you will build and operate the platform, anchor technical decisions and raise the engineering bar as we mature from automation to a self-service product. Your role
• to operate and continuously improve Pictet’s cloud landing zone on AWS and Azure, acting as a trusted technical advisor to the engineers who build on it.
• to give advice on and work with product teams co-build cloud blueprints, turning shared patterns into reusable, self-service building blocks.
• to lead the shift from automation to a self-service platform by designing the paved path and abstraction layer that reduce internal clients’ cognitive load.
• to Act as a Tech Lead by anchoring key design decisions, mentoring engineers and setting the paved-road standards relied on by the team and its internal clients.
• to align with developers, infrastructure engineers, cybersecurity and risk managers to apply standards and provide guidance, and building in security and good practice by default. Your profile
• Strong software engineering skills: you write production-grade code in Python, Go or an equivalent language, and bring the discipline needed to turn automation into a maintainable self-service platform.
• In-depth expertise in infrastructure as code on AWS and/or Azure, with strong Terraform experience and, ideally, exposure to landing-zone or multi-account governance and automation.
• Solid architecture background in identity and access management, networking and integration, with the ability to reason through design choices.
• A platform-as-a-product mindset: you treat internal engineers as clients and care about adoption, self-service and the developer experience.
• Experience as a tech lead or senior individual contributor, making and guiding technical decisions for a team.
• Experience with containers, orchestration and the wider tooling ecosystem, including Kubernetes and GitHub Actions or CI/CD.
• Exposure to DevSecOps, agentic AI or FinOps practices would be an advantage.
• A team player with strong communication skills, intellectual curiosity and a willingness to learn.
• Fluent English is required; French would be an advantage. Otherwise, candidates should be willing to learn it.
• Swiss resident or willing to relocate. • Abstimmung mit Entwicklern, Infrastrukturingenieuren, Cybersicherheits- und Risikomanagern zur Anwendung von Standards und zur Bereitstellung von Leitlinien sowie zum standardmäßigen Aufbau von Sicherheit und bewährten Verfahren. Dein Profil
• Starke Software-Engineering-Fähigkeiten: Sie schreiben Produktionscode in Python, Go oder einer gleichwertigen Sprache und bringen die Disziplin, die erforderlich ist, um die Automatisierung in eine wartbare Self-Service-Plattform zu verwandeln.
• Tiefe Expertise in Infrastruktur wie Code auf AWS und / oder Azure, mit starker Terraform-Erfahrung und idealerweise Kontakt zu Landing-Zone- oder Multi-Account-Governance und Automatisierung.
• Solider Architekturhintergrund in Identitäts- und Zugriffsmanagement, Vernetzung und Integration mit der Fähigkeit, durch Designentscheidungen zu argumentieren.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Votre équipe Pictet Tech conçoit, intègre et exploite des applications logicielles allant des systèmes de gestion de portefeuille et des plateformes de négociation aux solutions bancaires et d'entreprise. La division est responsable de certaines des principales innovations du Groupe tout en soutenant les opérations commerciales. L'équipe Cloud Platform exploite la zone d'atterrissage en nuage de Pictet. Au fur et à mesure que l'adoption du nuage se développe dans la communauté d'ingénierie de Pictet, notre objectif est d'aider les équipes à se déplacer plus rapidement avec moins de friction. En tant que responsable technique dans cette équipe, vous allez construire et exploiter la plateforme, ancrer les décisions techniques et élever la barre d'ingénierie à mesure que nous arrivons à maturité de l'automatisation à un produit en libre-service. Votre rôle
• d'exploiter et d'améliorer en permanence la zone d'atterrissage de Pictets sur AWS et Azure, agissant comme un conseiller technique de confiance pour les ingénieurs qui s'en servent.
• donner des conseils et travailler avec les équipes de produits co-construire des plans nuageux, transformer les modèles partagés en blocs de construction réutilisables en libre-service.
• pour conduire le passage de l'automatisation à une plate-forme de libre-service en concevant le chemin pavé et la couche d'abstraction qui réduisent la charge cognitive des clients internes.
• d'agir à titre de chef de file technique en ancreant les décisions clés en matière de conception, en parrainant des ingénieurs et en fixant les normes de la route pavée sur lesquelles se fondent l'équipe et ses clients internes.
• de s'aligner avec les développeurs, les ingénieurs en infrastructure, les gestionnaires de la cybersécurité et des risques pour appliquer les normes et fournir des conseils, et de renforcer la sécurité et les bonnes pratiques par défaut. Votre profil
• Fortes compétences en ingénierie logicielle : vous écrivez un code de qualité de production en Python, Go ou un langage équivalent, et apportez la discipline nécessaire pour transformer l'automatisation en une plate-forme de libre-service durable.
• Expertise approfondie dans l'infrastructure comme code sur AWS et/ou Azure, avec une solide expérience Terraform et, idéalement, une exposition à la zone d'atterrissage ou multi-comptes gouvernance et l'automatisation.
• Une architecture solide dans la gestion de l'identité et de l'accès, le réseautage et l'intégration, avec la capacité de raisonner par des choix de conception.
• Une plateforme en tant que produit : vous traitez les ingénieurs internes comme des clients et vous souciez de l'adoption, du libre-service et de l'expérience du développeur.
• Expérience en tant que chef de file technologique ou en tant que contributeur principal, prise et orientation de décisions techniques pour une équipe.
• Expérience avec les conteneurs, l'orchestration et l'écosystème d'outillage plus large, y compris Kubernetes et GitHub Actions ou CI/CD.
• L'exposition à DevSecOps, aux pratiques d'IA ou de FinOps serait un avantage.
• Un joueur d'équipe avec de solides compétences en communication, curiosité intellectuelle et une volonté d'apprendre.
• Le français serait un avantage. Autrement, les candidats devraient être prêts à l'apprendre.
• Suisse résidente ou disposée à déménager. La tua squadra Il Gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali asset manager indipendenti al mondo. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo è rappresentato a 31 uffici nei centri finanziari di tutto il mondo, attualmente con oltre 5.000 persone. Pictet Wealth Management combina oltre 220 anni di patrimonio bancario svizzero con competenze di investimento globali. Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà del Partner offre un servizio completo per persone e famiglie ricche, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consultive e servizi di ufficio familiare. Ti unirai a Pictet Wealth Management Ginevra e sarai parte del team di revisione AML del cliente con sede lì. Missione Esecuzione di tutte le attività relative al riciclaggio di denaro (AML) con un focus sulla gestione delle recensioni annuali per clienti ad alto rischio e PEP. Il tuo ruolo
• Effettuare un'analisi approfondita del riciclaggio di denaro (AML) per i clienti ad alto rischio in applicazione delle normative in materia di lotta contro il riciclaggio di denaro e il finanziamento del terrorismo (LBA, OBA-FINMA, CDB20) e presentando questioni sensibili al Comitato AML.
• Esecuzione di revisioni annuali del PEP in applicazione dei regolamenti sulla lotta contro il riciclaggio di denaro e il finanziamento del terrorismo (LBA, OBA-FINMA, CDB20) e presentando le conclusioni al Comitato AML. Il tuo profilo
• Conoscenza approfondita dell'ambiente finanziario e normativo.
• Comprehensive conoscenze legali relative alla conformità.
• Ottimo comando di francese e inglese; altre lingue sarebbero un plus.
• Forte mentalità analitica e capacità di problem solving.
• In grado di comunicare con precisione e distillare informazioni importanti.

• Esperienza di lavoro comprovata da 5 a 10 anni in una posizione simile.

Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 31 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5,000 people. Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 220 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. • Excellent command of French and English; other languages would be a plus.
• Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving skills.
• Able to communicate precisely and distil important information.
• Conscientious.
• Able to show discretion and handle confidential issues in an appropriate manner.
• Team player.
• Proven work experience of 5 to 10 years in a similar position.
• Able to handle the material and formal aspects of KYC/KYT reviews. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. We are looking for a dynamic candidate to join the Invoicing, Billing & Payments team . Your role You will ensure proper operational set up to perform this activity as expected by clients and management. This will include making sure organization and processes are efficient, tools are adequate and controls are in place. Acting as a point of contact for ad hoc queries of a pool of mainstream funds clients and front business lines, handling fund suppliers invoices, fund fees payments and monitoring fees budgets implemented by the funds. You will manage the funds fees payments database. You will also be involved in the preparation of fund tax declarations such as VAT, Lux & BE Subscription Tax, tantièmes. You will guarantee service levels and consistently thrive to exceed client’s needs and expectations. Responsibilities:
• Process Fund Suppliers invoices and funds fees payments in a timely manner according to fees calendars and invoice handling deadlines
• Monitor fund fees budgets and manage fees payments database
• Handle client queries relating to fees & payments, liaise with internal and external stakeholders involved in the invoice payment process
• Contribute to the maintenance of procedures and controls as well as the evolution of fees and payments tools to ensure transparency and risk monitoring
• Stay abreast of all internal policies and compliance to legal and regulatory requirements
• Proceed to tax declarations in compliance with the laws and in a timely manner Your profile Educational background and employment experience:
• Experience in funds accounting/ funds fees payments
• Good knowledge of financial products and their valuation
• Broad vision of fund administration Specific knowledge:
• Knowledge of foreign currency hedging and asset pooling techniques is a plus
• Experience in funds accounting on Multifonds is a plus
• Fund fees payment experience Language knowledge:
• Professional command of English and French Personal qualities:
• Rigorous, organised and good analytical skills
• Adaptability - Can-do attitude, client centric mindset
• Sense of initiative and willing to learn
• Good communication and problem solving
• A team player who is approachable and flexible Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. You will work closely with our bankers and fellow Investment Specialists to build lasting investment partnerships and deliver a distinctive investment experience tailored to each client’s needs and geographic circumstances. You will also support bankers in their business development efforts by identifying and presenting the most appropriate investment solutions and encouraging clients with non-managed accounts to consider actively managed options. • to develop, promote and retain discretionary mandates, while seeking to centralise their management.

• Excellent technical knowledge of asset classes, investment vehicles and discretionary and advisory mandate offerings.

• IT-proficiency, including knowledge of relevant software packages, online information systems, front-end management and order-placing systems (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Adobe, Bloomberg, Avaloq, Profolio, etc.).

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

We are an independent investment partnership known for our long-term mindset, responsible approach to business, and entrepreneurial spirit. These principles have defined us since 1805. For our clients, colleagues and wider society, we always aim to do the right thing and honour our commitment to enduring quality.

Pictet opened its Tokyo office in 1981 to conduct research on the Japanese economy and equity market. It began providing asset management services to institutional investors in 1987 and entered the investment trust (mutual fund) business in 1997. As of the end of March 2026, the firm’s assets under management totaled 4.56 trillion yen.

Your role

We are seeking an economist to lead our global research and analysis on macroeconomics, monetary policy, interest rates, and foreign exchange.

Key responsibilities include preparing reports and presentation materials on macroeconomic and financial market developments; delivering presentations to retail and institutional investors, financial institutions, and the media; and providing clear explanations and interpretive support during client meetings.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills and excellent communication abilities, with the proven ability to convey complex information effectively in both English and Japanese.

Responsibilities

• Conduct in-depth analysis of macroeconomic trends, monetary policy, interest rates, and foreign exchange in Japan and globally

• Prepare reports and presentation materials for both internal and external stakeholders

• Deliver presentations to retail and institutional investors, financial institutions, and the media

• Provide clear explanations and interpretation support during client meetings

Your profile

• Bachelor’s degree or higher

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience as an economist

• Deep understanding of macroeconomics and financial markets

• Native-level proficiency in Japanese and business-level or higher proficiency in English (reading, writing, and speaking)

• Excellent report writing and presentation skills

• Demonstrated experience in client-facing roles

Required Qualifications and Skills

• Certified Member Analyst of the Securities Analysts Association of Japan (CMA) or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)

• Bloomberg

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

descriptionByLocale.it: La tua squadra Il Gruppo Pictet è un'azienda leader di asset management indipendente che opera a livello globale. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo mantiene operazioni in 30 sedi in importanti centri finanziari in tutto il mondo, impiegando oltre 4.600 professionisti. Pictet è presente a Singapore da oltre 30 anni, sostenuto da un team superiore a 200 dipendenti. Stiamo cercando un diligente e intuitivo Buy-Side Analyst per aderire al nostro Asia Equity Research team. Sarete responsabili di condurre una ricerca fondamentale approfondita sulle aziende di tutti i settori dei mercati asiatici, con un focus sulle aziende industriali, energetiche e dei consumatori; sviluppare tesi di investimento complete; e fornire raccomandazioni di investimento ad alta concorrenza ai nostri stakeholder interni, in particolare ai responsabili del portafoglio e ai consulenti. Alcune competenze per il settore tecnologico e le sue principali aziende sarebbero vantaggiose. Il tuo ruolo • Ricerca fondamentale: Eseguire ricerche approfondite su aziende, industrie e tendenze macroeconomiche per identificare i valori mobiliari errati; primo focus sulle aziende industriali e dei consumatori. • Modellazione finanziaria: costruire e mantenere modelli finanziari complessi e dinamici per prevedere guadagni e rendimenti futuri. • Raccomandazioni di investimento: Autori di investimento memos e fornire raccomandazioni attuabili a Pictet Wealth Management. • Due diligence: Conduct management interviste, partecipare conferenze del settore, e interagire con gli analisti del settore per raccogliere informazioni proprietarie. • Ricerca potenziata dall'intelligenza artificiale: progettare e applicare strumenti e flussi di lavoro basati sull'intelligenza artificiale per accelerare la generazione dell'idea, migliorare il rilevamento dei modelli e aumentare l'agilità e la scalabilità della ricerca fondamentale. Il tuo profilo • Esperienza: Almeno 6 anni di esperienza di ricerca azionaria sul lato di acquisto o di vendita, idealmente con copertura multi-settore; prima esposizione a un istituto finanziario leader è un vantaggio forte. • Competenze linguistiche: comando eccellente di inglese scritto e parlato (nativo o equivalente) e comando fluente o migliore del mandarino scritto e parlato in quanto il ruolo richiede frequenti ricerche e comunicazioni che coinvolgono aziende cinesi e fonti di lingua mandarino • Ricerca e competenze analitiche: forti capacità fondamentali di ricerca azionaria con eccellenti competenze quantitative (ma non quantitative) e un approccio basato su principi all'analisi e alla comunicazione. • Abilità di comunicazione e presentazione: eccezionali capacità di comunicazione scritta (memoria di investimento, note di ricerca) e eccellenti capacità di presentazione per trasmettere idee complesse in modo chiaro e convincente. • Proficienza IT & Tools: Completa competenza in Bloomberg (terminal e Excel API), Microsoft Excel e PowerPoint; solida conoscenza di lavoro di VBA. • Competenza dell'intelligenza artificiale: utente sicuro ed efficace degli strumenti AI (ad esempio ChatGPT, Claude e applicazioni simili) per migliorare la produttività della ricerca, la generazione di informazioni e l'efficienza del flusso di lavoro. • Qualità personali: personalità indipendente, intuitiva, auto-avviamento con un forte senso di proprietà e responsabilità, pur essendo un giocatore di squadra. • Orientamento dei risultati: Forte attenzione a fornire prodotti di alta qualità, attuabili e soddisfare le aspettative basate sui risultati in un ambiente di investimento esigente. descriptionByLocale.en: Your team The Pictet Group is a leading independent wealth and asset management firm operating globally. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group maintains operations in 30 offices across key financial centers worldwide, employing more than 4,600 professionals. Pictet has been present in Singapore for over 30 years, supported by a team exceeding 200 employees. We are seeking a diligent and insightful Buy-Side Analyst to join our Asia Equity Research team. You will be responsible for conducting in-depth fundamental research on companies across sectors in Asian markets, with a focus on industrial, energy, and consumer companies; developing comprehensive investment theses; and providing high-conviction investment recommendations to our internal stakeholders, in particular portfolio managers and advisors. Some expertise to the technology sector and its major companies would be beneficial. Your role • Fundamental research: Perform deep-dive research into companies, industries, and macroeconomic trends to identify mispriced securities; initial focus on Industrial and Consumer companies. • Financial modelling: Build and maintain complex, dynamic financial models to forecast future earnings and returns. • Investment recommendations: Author investment memos and deliver actionable recommendations to Pictet Wealth Management. • Due diligence: Conduct management interviews, attend industry conferences, and interact with sell-side analysts to gather proprietary insights. • AI-augmented research: Design and apply AI-driven tools and workflows to accelerate idea generation, enhance pattern detection, and increase the agility and scalability of fundamental research. Your profile • Experience: At least 6 years of equity research experience on the buy side or sell side, ideally with multi-sector coverage; prior exposure to a leading financial institution is a strong plus. • Language skills: Excellent command of written and spoken English (native or equivalent) and fluent or better command of written and spoken Mandarin as the role requires frequent research and communication involving Chinese companies and Mandarin-language sources • Research & Analytical Skills: Strong fundamental equity research capabilities with excellent quantitative (but non-quant) skills, and a first-principles-based approach to analysis and communication. • Communication & Presentation Skills: Outstanding written communication skills (investment memos, research notes) and excellent presentation skills to convey complex ideas clearly and convincingly. • IT & Tools proficiency: Complete proficiency in Bloomberg (terminal and Excel API), Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; solid working knowledge of VBA. • AI proficiency: Confident and effective user of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude and similar applications) to enhance research productivity, insight generation and workflow efficiency. • Personal qualities: Independent-minded, intuitive, self-starter personality with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, while being a team player. • Results orientation: Strong focus on delivering high-quality, actionable outputs and meeting results-based expectations in a demanding investment environment. Vous serez chargé de mener des recherches fondamentales approfondies sur les entreprises dans tous les secteurs des marchés asiatiques, en mettant l'accent sur les entreprises industrielles, énergétiques et de consommation, en élaborant des thèses d'investissement complètes et en fournissant des recommandations d'investissement à haute conviction à nos intervenants internes, en particulier les gestionnaires de portefeuille et les conseillers. Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) combina oltre 200 anni di patrimonio bancario svizzero con competenze di investimento globali. Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà del Partner offre un servizio completo per persone e famiglie ricche, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consultive e servizi di ufficio familiare. Il tuo ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un Analista Finanziario altamente motivato per unire il nostro team Asia 2 come parte di un programma rotazionale di 4 anni unico e strutturato progettato per fornire una fondazione completa nel private banking e nella gestione degli investimenti. Al termine di questo programma, sarai attrezzato per assumere il ruolo di Private Banker, supportato da una robusta rete interna di specialisti e da una comprensione del nostro business e dei nostri clienti. Questa posizione permanente offre un viaggio di 48 mesi attraverso tre aree chiave del nostro business Wealth Management, consentendo di costruire competenze e sviluppare una forte rete professionale: • Anno 1: immersione con Client Relationship Officers per scoprire la gestione dei rapporti con i clienti e le operazioni quotidiane. • Anni 2 & 3: Integrazione all'interno della piattaforma di investimento per approfondire la vostra conoscenza di investimento e gestione del portafoglio, e per comprendere le esigenze dei gestori di portafoglio. • Anno 4: Ottenere esperienza pratica in consulenza di gestione della ricchezza di alto livello attraverso la gestione di un portafoglio clienti esistente. descriptionByLocale.en: Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 31 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5,000 people. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 25 years where it employs over 200 people. Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services. Your role We are seeking a highly motivated Financial Analyst to join our Asia 2 team as part of a unique, structured 4-year rotational programme designed to provide a comprehensive foundation in private banking and investment management. At the end of this programme, you will be equipped to take on the role of Private Banker, supported by a robust in-house network of specialists and an understanding of our business and clients. This permanent position offers a 48-month journey through three key areas of our Wealth Management business, allowing you to build expertise and develop a strong professional network: • Year 1: Immersion with Client Relationship Officers to discover client relationship management and daily operations. • Years 2 & 3: Integration within the Investment Platform to deepen your knowledge of investment and portfolio management, and to understand the needs of portfolio managers. • Year 4: Gaining practical experience in high-level wealth management advisory through the management of an existing client portfolio. Throughout the programme, you will be mentored by a Senior Banker and will collaborate with professionals across the banking sector, support the implementation of wealth management strategies, and contribute to the delivery of tailored solutions for our clients. You will also have the opportunity to complete professional certifications, such as the CFA, and participate in ongoing training and development activities. Your profile • Master’s or Bachelor's degree in Finance or Management with 3 to 5 years of professional experience. • Enthusiasm, interpersonal skills, and a strong interest in client relations. • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines. • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. • Team player with a positive attitude, strong work ethic, and the ability to adapt quickly. Con team basati a livello globale, PAA costruisce, gestisce e consiglia portafogli di soluzioni di investimento alternative per clienti istituzionali e privati. Sarete parte di un team che copre il ciclo di vita completo dei dipendenti PAA a livello globale. Il team HR svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel reclutamento, nello sviluppo professionale e personale dei dipendenti e nel facilitare le operazioni diurne. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con professionisti esperti che ti guideranno nella comprensione delle complessità della gestione delle risorse umane all'interno di un istituto finanziario. • Gestione dei dati: Mantenere registri dei dipendenti accurati e dati amministrativi all'interno dei nostri sistemi HR.
• Reclutamento: Organizzazione di interviste in-persona e online con candidati internazionali e gestione dell'imbarco di nuovi dipendenti.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione (scritta e verbale) e un senso acuto del servizio clienti.
• Altamente organizzato e attento ai dettagli, si prospera in ruoli amministrativi e godere delle sfide che presentano. Capace di gestire informazioni riservate con discrezione, si possiede un vero interesse per le risorse umane e sono desiderosi di imparare e contribuire alla squadra.

With teams based globally, PAA constructs, manages and advises portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients. You will be part of a team covering the full life cycle of PAA employees globally. The HR team plays a critical role in recruitment, employees professional & personal development, and facilitating effective day to day operations. You will collaborate closely with experienced professionals who will guide you in understanding the complexities of HR management within a financial institution. This environment will offer you practical insights and valuable hands-on experience in various aspects and contacts across the HR community in Switzerland but also outside of the country (mainly London, Luxembourg and Singapore). • Drafting documents: Preparing and publishing job advertisements (internally and externally), establishing employment references and contracts in both English and French.
• Data management: Maintaining accurate employee records and administrative data within our HR systems.
• Recruitment: Organising in-person and online interviews with international candidates and managing the onboarding of new employees.
• Administrative support: Assisting with various administrative tasks related to recruitment, scheduling internal meetings and other HR initiatives. Your profile
• Currently pursuing or have recently completed a university degree or a CFC in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field. HR assistant certificate would be an asset.
• Previous experience in a demanding work environment will be an asset.
• Proactive and capable of working autonomously and under tight deadlines.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, with strong capabilities in organising data and preparing presentations.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Organisation & Digital, Risk and Tax departments. The Corporate Compliance Officer participates in monitoring the company's activities to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and also takes part in the implementation of the CMP (Control Monitoring Plan). He also ensures the strengthening of the company's procedural and training framework. Your role
• Analyze regulatory watch screenings performing gap analysis on new regulations and assess their potential impact within the company.
• Contribute to the development and implementation of the Compliance Monitoring Plan by identifying applicable compliance standards and monitoring controls using a risk-based approach.
• Identify and assess compliance risks to which the company is exposed, make appropriate observations, and verify appropriate follow up on related to identified issues with the different stakeholders.
• Assist in establishing and maintaining a compliance manual, ensuring that all internal policies and procedures comply with legal requirements and group minimum standards.
• Assist in the training of new employees on compliance topics and ensure that compliance training is conducted at defined intervals.
• Participate in regulatory projects by providing advice on legal requirements and ensuring that delivered solutions comply with regulations and minimum group standards.
• Maintain and update various registers, including investor complaints, conflicts of interest, personal transactions, gifts, and identified issues.
• Follow up on audit recommendations and participate in the proper implementation.
• Collaborate with regulators and the Ministry of Finance to ensure compliance and respond to regulatory requests. Your profile Please insert the text for the job ad to be then published internally/externally Note We will not accept any CVs from agencies. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description. Flexible and modern ways of working As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave. Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Your team The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Your role The Taiwan Intermediary sales team is currently made up of professionals who prospect and service intermediary clients throughout Taiwan by marketing Pictet Asset Management’s (Pictet AM) strategies. Reporting to the Head of Sales - Taiwan, you will play a critical role in Pictet AM’s drive to further develop its business in Taiwan. Your responsibilities will be:
• Foster strong collaborative relationships with distributors and financial advisors to boost sales activities.
• Address and assist distributors' headquarters and clients in resolving product and market-related inquiries while nurturing relationships.
• Organize seminars and meetings to facilitate engagement and knowledge sharing.
• Actively participate in fund sales initiatives and strive to partner with distributors in campaigns to achieve the company's business goals and increase brand awareness.
• Regularly visit branches for fund promotion and training.
• Gather, organize, analyse, and share market intelligence related to distributors and industry peers.
• Contribute to the development of effective sales strategies based on market insights.
• Proactively carry out tasks assigned by the sales head, ensuring efficient and accurate completion of various assignments.
• Maintain various documents, including updating client contact information, preparing call reports, and documenting activity notes in Salesforce (SF). Your profile
• Hold a university degree or higher, with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in the financial industry.
• Have a deep understanding of various mutual fund products, such as equity, fixed-income, private equity and ETFs.
• Possess excellent interpersonal skills that foster effective teamwork and communication.
• Exhibit strong presentation skills to deliver persuasive sales pitches.
• Demonstrate problem-solving abilities and a strong sense of responsibility and commitment to the business. As the successful applicant you will show drive, have a keen entrepreneurial spirit and be able to develop successful business relationships and close deals. You will also have a flair for communication, be able to manage priorities and multi-task on different projects concurrently, as well as having an eye for detail. Working in a self-reliant manner in a broader team makes you excel. You will be joining a structured and highly motivated team. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List
