descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team The Corporate Functions division encompasses the Group’s non-banking activities and comprises over 600 employees. Staffed by specialists with deep expertise across all business lines, the central functions are organised into various group departments: Communication, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Corporate Office, Risk and Taxation. The Financial Institutions Management (FIM) team, part of the Finance Department, is the Group's centre of expertise for managing relationships with financial institutions. As a key member of this team, you will help maintain and enhance the Group's vital relationships with our financial counterparties. Your role We are seeking a proactive and analytical professional to take ownership of optimising data management, streamlining workflows, and driving process automation across the team's activities. You will lead the transformation and implementation of these initiatives to ensure continuous improvement and innovation. You will be responsible for the following tasks: Process improvement and automation
• Analyse and map current processes, systems and tools across the team's activities.
• Identify inefficiencies and take the initiative to propose and implement improvements.
• Take ownership of automation solutions and drive the digital transformation of our workflows, leveraging advanced analytics and the latest technologies.
• Reduce reliance on manual processes and email-based requests by introducing robust, scalable solutions. Data Management and Quality
• Maintain and enhance financial counterparty master data (codification, static data).
• Lead efforts to build and manage a centralised “golden source” of data, ensuring high data quality and consistency.
• Implement and monitor automated data quality controls, ensuring data reconciliation and consistency across systems. Reporting and Monitoring
• Prepare impactful dashboards reports, and presentations for internal teams and senior management, using state-of-the-art data visualisation tools.
• Participate in projects that impact the team's activities, driving innovation, efficiency and the adoption of new data science methodologies. Your profile
• Master’s degree or equivalent.
• 3 to 5 years of experience and keen interest in banking, or previous experience in the banking industry.
• Experience in KYC/AML would be a plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
• Proactive, solution-oriented and able to take initiative, structured, with strong attention to detail.
• Committed, results-driven and accountable.
• Strong team spirit with the ability to collaborate across teams and business lines.
• Keen interest in process improvement, automation and data visualisation, leveraging technology.
• Experience in SQL and Python.
• Experience with Business Intelligence Tools (Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau) and in Gen AI project implementation.
• Familiarity with data management concepts (data quality/governance).
• Fluent in French and English; other languages are a plus.
• Must be resident in Switzerland. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people. The Compliance function is responsible for helping Pictet’s senior management manage the compliance risks faced by Pictet. This role will focus on the risks faced by Pictet’s Singapore bank, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch. The AML/CFT Compliance Officer is part of the team that oversees the Bank’s financial crime framework, focused primarily on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance. The incumbent performs systematic AML/CFT reviews on high-risk clients before onboarding and subsequent periodic reviews, reviews alerts/issues escalated by first-line functions and reports suspicions of criminal or sanctioned activity, and provides advice on AML/CFT and sanctions management. . The officer monitors changes that may impact the business, working with business and support functions to ensure that the Bank complies with regulatory obligations and Group standards in the financial crime area. The role will report to the Compliance AML Lead. Your role Key responsibilities -Investigate relevant alerts and suspicious activities, and perform filing of STR to local authorities. -Perform ex-ante AML reviews on high-risk client onboarding and periodic reviews. -Review escalated alerts from first-line transaction monitoring, payment filtering and ongoing name screening controls. -Support external requests include production orders, due diligence queries and any relevant regulatory reporting (e.g. Remote Gambling Act reporting). -Act as an expert advisor to business and support functions on compliance and regulatory matters related to AML/CFT and international sanctions management. -Perform an annual AML/CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) identifying risks and framework/control gaps to the attention of management and Group -Compliance. -Assist with periodical risk-based design and operating effectiveness testing of first-line AML/CFT controls, including on lower-risk clients. -Represent Compliance as needed on financial crime related projects and initiatives. -Assist in the resolution of Compliance-owned management action plans from audits, inspections and Group reviews. -Produce relevant management information reports to board and senior management on the governance of financial crime risks. -Build and maintain a proactive and constructive relationship with business and functional stakeholders to ensure appropriate controls are in place for financial crime risk identification and management. -Keep abreast and understand the impact of new financial crime regulations and where needed, represent the Bank in industry consultations. -Support the Singapore AML Lead on all AML/CFT matters and any other duties as assigned. Your profile -Bachelor Degree in law, banking or business. -Working knowledge of the CDSA, AML/CFT typologies, relevant MAS Regulations and Guidance on AML/CFT and the international sanctions framework. -Working experience of Singapore regulatory landscape and expectations needed. Familiarity with regulations and guidance in an AML, Financial crime Compliance role. -6-10 years of relevant experience in AML/CFT compliance particularly on investigations. -Prior experience in a similar role in a Private Bank will be advantageous. -Highly effective verbal and written communication and organizational skills. -Ability to multi-task competing priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail. -Capable of working with cross-functional and senior stakeholders. -Sense of accountability, good time management and ability to meet tight deadlines. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

Your team The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Your role The Taiwan Intermediary sales team is currently made up of professionals who prospect and service intermediary clients throughout Taiwan by marketing Pictet Asset Management’s (Pictet AM) strategies. Reporting to the Head of Sales - Taiwan, you will play a critical role in Pictet AM’s drive to further develop its business in Taiwan. Your responsibilities will be:
• Foster strong collaborative relationships with distributors and financial advisors to boost sales activities.
• Address and assist distributors' headquarters and clients in resolving product and market-related inquiries while nurturing relationships.
• Organize seminars and meetings to facilitate engagement and knowledge sharing.
• Actively participate in fund sales initiatives and strive to partner with distributors in campaigns to achieve the company's business goals and increase brand awareness.
• Regularly visit branches for fund promotion and training.
• Gather, organize, analyse, and share market intelligence related to distributors and industry peers.
• Contribute to the development of effective sales strategies based on market insights.
• Proactively carry out tasks assigned by the sales head, ensuring efficient and accurate completion of various assignments.
• Maintain various documents, including updating client contact information, preparing call reports, and documenting activity notes in Salesforce (SF). Your profile
• Hold a university degree or higher, with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in the financial industry.
• Have a deep understanding of various mutual fund products, such as equity, fixed-income, private equity and ETFs.
• Possess excellent interpersonal skills that foster effective teamwork and communication.
• Exhibit strong presentation skills to deliver persuasive sales pitches.
• Demonstrate problem-solving abilities and a strong sense of responsibility and commitment to the business. As the successful applicant you will show drive, have a keen entrepreneurial spirit and be able to develop successful business relationships and close deals. You will also have a flair for communication, be able to manage priorities and multi-task on different projects concurrently, as well as having an eye for detail. Working in a self-reliant manner in a broader team makes you excel. You will be joining a structured and highly motivated team. • Hold a university degree or higher, with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in the financial industry.

Contatto - Ref.: FDAS/CC/BS

Your role
• Assurer la stabilité, la qualité et la sécurité des données mises à disposition, en particulier pour la production des nombreux indicateurs liés à la comptabilité analytique et financière.
• Développer, tenir à jour et optimiser des pipelines de données robustes en intégrant des solutions innovantes d’automatisation.
• Contribuer à la revue et à l’évolution de l’architecture des systèmes et des flux de données.
• Concevoir et développer des solutions innovantes, incluant l’intégration de modèles d’IA pour la détection d’anomalies, la prévision ou l’optimisation, afin d’améliorer la qualité, la disponibilité et la traçabilité des données et des rapports produits.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes du département Finances, les lignes de métier et la division Pictet Tech afin de concevoir et de mettre en œuvre le meilleur environnement pour l’utilisation optimale des données pertinentes.
• Piloter et assurer le suivi de projets de déploiement et/ou de transformation de systèmes informatiques majeurs au niveau du Groupe et/ou des entités juridiques, en coordonnant les activités entre les fournisseurs, Pictet Tech et les lignes de métier.

• Expérience d’au minimum 7 ans à des fonctions similaires, avec un accent important sur la gestion des données et l’innovation technologique.
• Bonnes connaissances en architecture des systèmes et en structuration des données.
• Excellente connaissance de la gestion des bases de données Oracle et Snowflake (PLSQL et SQL).
• Expérience en développement applicatif (Apex, Python, Streamlit, JavaScript, Angular et React).
• Expérience des outils de business intelligence (Tableau, BusinessObjects et Sigma).
• Expérience dans l’intégration de solutions d’intelligence artificielle (Copilot, Anthropic, etc.) et la création des agents: un atout majeur.

## Mansioni - Contribuire alla preparazione e trasmissione di documenti e rapporti finanziari personalizzati, alla verifica della conformità delle firme e delle istruzioni di pagamento. - Svolgere un ruolo centrale nella trasformazione delle attività, essendo motore nell'identificazione, nella messa in atto e nell'ottimizzazione di soluzioni di automazione e digitalizzazione dei processi, nel rispetto delle procedure interne e delle esigenze regolamentari e nel sostegno alle diverse linee di business della Banca. ## Ruolo - Assicurare la revisione approfondita e la conformità delle strutture di conti clienti prima di ogni autorizzazione di pagamento. - Garantire la coerenza tra le direttive interne e la validità delle firme per le istruzioni di pagamento. - Preparare e fornire i documenti contrattuali e i rapporti finanziari necessari alle visite clienti. - Generare rapporti finanziari personalizzati a richiesta dei gestori e dei clienti. - Essere motore nella trasformazione digitale del servizio: identificare, proporre e mettere in atto soluzioni di automazione e di intelligenza artificiale adatte alla realtà operativa e regolamentare di Pictet. - Partecipare attivamente all'ampliamento continuo delle metodologie di lavoro, favorendo la standardizzazione, la riduzione delle attività manuali e l'industrializzazione dei controlli di qualità. - Rispondere alle diverse richieste di tutte le linee di business della Banca relative alle attività del Registro Clienti. ## Profilo - Formazione CFC, Bachelor o Master, ideale se completata da una prima esperienza nel settore bancario (Operazioni o IT). - Polyvalenza e curiosità: si ama imparare, adattarsi e evolversi in un ambiente in trasformazione, e non si esita a uscire dalla zona di comfort per aiutare l'équipe su argomenti variati. - Interesse marcato per l'automazione, la digitalizzazione e le nuove tecnologie, con capacità di concepire, mantenere o migliorare strumenti operativi automatizzati (Python, SQL, low-code, LLMs, agenti IA, ecc.), nel rispetto dei standard di sicurezza e di conformità. - Eccellente padronanza degli strumenti informatici, in particolare MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). La conoscenza dell'outil bancaire Avaloq è un atout. - Capacità di gestire più compiti e scadenze in un ambiente dinamico, priorizzando la qualità, la fidelità e la conformità. - Senso del servizio client, eccellenti competenze interpersonali e abilità di collaborare efficacemente con interlocutori variati (Front, IT, Data Office, Compliance, ecc.). - Padronanza corrente del francese e dell'inglese, sia scritto che orale. La conoscenza del tedesco è un atout. - Residenza in Svizzera obbligatoria. ##
• Cosa offriamo - Opportunità di crescita e sviluppo professionale in un ambiente dinamico e in trasformazione. - Collaborazione con un'équipe di professionisti motivati e appassionati. - Accesso a formazione e sviluppo continua per migliorare le competenze e le abilità. - Ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e diversificato. ## Contatto - Per inviare il tuo curriculum, scrivi a [indirizzo email] - Per ulteriori informazioni, visita il nostro sito web [indirizzo sito web]

Your team Les opérations assurent un traitement sécurisé et efficace des transactions bancaires et des fonds d'investissement de Pictet. Nos équipes veillent à ce que toutes les activités respectent les réglementations et gèrent les risques. En développant et en maintenant une infrastructure moderne et robuste, nous garantissons des services fiables et de haute qualité pour la gestion de patrimoine, la gestion d'actifs et de l’immobilier. Contribuer à la préparation et transmission de documents et rapports financiers personnalisés, la vérification de la conformités des signatures et des instructions de paiement. Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la transformation de nos activités, en étant moteur dans l’identification, la mise en place et l’optimisation de solutions d’automatisation et de digitalisation de nos processus, tout en veillant au respect des procédures internes et des exigences réglementaires et en soutenant les différentes lignes de métier de la Banque. Your role
• Assurer la revue approfondie et la conformité des structures de comptes clients avant toute autorisation de paiement.
• Garantir la cohérence entre les directives internes et la validité des signatures pour les instructions de paiement.
• Préparer et fournir les documents contractuels et rapports financiers nécessaires aux visites clients.
• Générer des rapports financiers personnalisés à la demande des gestionnaires et des clients.
• Être moteur dans la transformation digitale du service : identifier, proposer et mettre en œuvre des solutions d’automatisation et d’intelligence artificielle adaptées à la réalité opérationnelle et réglementaire de Pictet.
• Participer activement à l’amélioration continue des méthodes de travail, en favorisant la standardisation, la réduction des tâches manuelles et l’industrialisation des contrôles de qualité.
• Répondre aux différentes demandes de l’ensemble des lignes de métier de la Banque concernant les activités du Client Register. Your profile
• Formation CFC, Bachelor ou Master, idéalement complétée par une première expérience dans le secteur bancaire (Opérations ou IT).
• Polyvalence et curiosité : vous aimez apprendre, vous adapter et évoluer dans un environnement en transformation, et vous n’hésitez pas à sortir de votre zone de confort pour aider l’équipe sur des sujets variés.
• Intérêt marqué pour l’automatisation, la digitalisation et les nouvelles technologies, avec capacité à concevoir, maintenir ou améliorer des outils opérationnels automatisés (Python, SQL, low-code, LLMs, agents IA, etc.), dans le respect des standards de sécurité et de conformité.
• Excellente maîtrise des outils informatiques, notamment MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). La connaissance de l’outil bancaire Avaloq, un atout.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. The Role is to provide 1st level support on Fund Admnistration activities. To centralise, coordinate, and respond to Clients, Business Lines & Auditors requests and contribute to improvements of the processes, procedures and operational platforms to guarantee the proper application of controls and consistently exceed client’s needs and expectations. Your role
• Collaborate with Business Implementation Team, Client Relationship Managers (CRM), Management Companies and other key stakeholders (Custody Bank, Pricing, Transfer Agent (TA)…) on Projects & fund-related events.
• Act as the main liaison for both external and internal Clients, as well as Auditors, regarding all Fund Administration day-to-day activities.
• Manage the end-to-end Audit process for the funds, from initial planning & timetable, preparation and coordination of the financial statements to final approval and CSSF filling. Respond to Audit queries and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions and / or process improvement & automation as needed.
• Support Fund Administration Operations teams and effectively manage relationships across various business lines, including CRM, Business Implementation Team, TA , Tax, and others.
• Demonstrate a proactive mindset in addressing fund-related issues, actively challenge the status quo, and contribute innovative ideas for process enhancement.
• Participate in due diligence meetings, service reviews, Client visits, and Board meetings as required.
• Monitor internal and external KPIs and take actions when needed
• Manage and resolve internal and external escalations, taking appropriate actions and escalating to management when necessary.
• Assist in the review of Operating Memorandum, Service Level Agreements, Prospectus, internal policies, procedures working instructions & check-list, RCSA Matrix and any other related documentation.
• Remain up to date with all internal policies and ensure strict adherence to legal and regulatory requirements.
• Act as back-up of Head of Client Services and participate in the Management Committee of the Funds Accounting Unit when required Your profile
• Strong knowledge of financial products and funds regulation.
• Master's degree in Economics or Finance
• Min 10 years experience in Accounting
• Fluent in French and English
• In-depth understanding of Fund Administration and the relationships with the different stakeholders
• Experience in NAV calculations and NAV production
• Strong experience in financial reporting and audit process
• Good knowledge in foreign currency hedging and asset pooling techniques.
• Experience in fund events (merger, CIK/RIK, fund restructuring, etc.).
• Knowledge of Multifonds.
• Good knowledge in MS Office tool (mainly Excel).
• Flexibility - Can-do attitude
• Client oriented mindset.
• Sense of initiative and willing to learn.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Strong communication & presentation skills
• Rigorous and organized.
• Manage Stress and prioritization. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. • Taking a critical view of the procedures in place and contributing to the development of the Accounting Department with a view to optimising processes and minimising risks.
• Contributing to all tasks relating to the lifecycle of funds. Your profile Qualifications and Experience:

• Previous experience or internship in a fund environment would be an asset. Desirable Knowledge and Skills:

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra Pictet Tech progetta, integra e gestisce applicazioni software che vanno dai sistemi di gestione del portafoglio e piattaforme di trading alle soluzioni bancarie e aziendali. La divisione è responsabile di alcune delle innovazioni chiave del Gruppo, sostenendo le operazioni aziendali. Il team Identity Management Platforms è dedicato alla gestione delle identità utente e della sicurezza in tutta l'organizzazione. Siamo responsabili per l'implementazione, l'automazione e la supervisione di soluzioni di autenticazione, autorizzazione e controllo accessi per tutte le applicazioni e le infrastrutture. La nostra missione è garantire l'accesso sicuro, senza soluzione di continuità e conforme a tutti gli utenti, migliorando continuamente i nostri processi e adottando le ultime tecnologie. Il tuo ruolo
• Progettazione, distribuzione e manutenzione di piattaforme e soluzioni IAM sia in ambienti cloud che ibridi.
• Automatizzare i processi di integrazione, distribuzione e gestione dell'identità/accesso utilizzando gli strumenti DevOps.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team di sicurezza, infrastruttura e sviluppo per garantire la conformità e la sicurezza degli accessi.
• Contribuire alla definizione e all'attuazione delle politiche di sicurezza, audit e gestione degli accessi.
• Monitorare, diagnosticare e risolvere incidenti e problemi legati all'AM.
• Resta aggiornato sulle ultime tendenze e progressi nelle tecnologie IAM e DevOps Il tuo profilo
• Istruzione superiore in informatica o esperienza equivalente.
• Esperienza significativa nell'ingegneria DevOps con una comprensione approfondita dei Kubernetes e dell'orchestrazione dei container.
• Proficienza nelle pratiche di artigianato software, programmazione e progettazione API (Python, Java, Go, Bash o equivalente).
• Esperienza con sistemi Cloud come Azure o Amazon e configurazione di infrastruttura-as-code.
• Capacità di eseguire il debugging interfunzionale su entrambi i livelli di applicazione e infrastruttura.
• Comprensione completa dell'architettura del sistema e dei componenti della piattaforma.
• Spirito di squadra, autonomia, rigore e capacità di lavorare in un ambiente agile.
• Fluente in francese e inglese.
• residente svizzero o disponibilità a trasferirsi. Perché unirsi a noi?
• Lavorare su progetti innovativi e strategici critici per la sicurezza dell’azienda.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team Pictet Tech designs, integrates and operates software applications ranging from portfolio management systems and trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. The division is responsible for some of the Group’s key innovations while sustaining business operations. The Identity Management Platforms team is dedicated to managing user identities and security across the organisation. We are responsible for the implementation, automation and oversight of authentication, authorisation and access control solutions for all applications and infrastructure. Our mission is to ensure secure, seamless and compliant access for all users, while continuously improving our processes and adopting the latest technologies. Your role
• Design, deploy and maintain IAM platforms and solutions in both Cloud and hybrid environments.
• Automate integration, deployment and identity/access management processes using DevOps tools.
• Collaborate closely with security, infrastructure and development teams to ensure access compliance and security.
• Contribute to the definition and implementation of security, audit and access management policies.
• Monitor, diagnose and resolve IAM-related incidents and issues.
• Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in IAM and DevOps technologies Your profile
• Higher education in computer science or equivalent experience.
• Significant experience in DevOps engineering with in-depth understanding of Kubernetes and container orchestration.
• Proficiency in software craftsmanship practices, programming and API design (Python, Java, Go, Bash or equivalent).
• Experience with Cloud systems such as Azure or Amazon and infrastructure-as-code configuration.
• Ability to perform cross-functional debugging across both application and infrastructure layers.
• Comprehensive understanding of system architecture and platform components.
• Team spirit, autonomy, rigor and ability to work in an agile environment.
• Fluent in French and English.
• Swiss resident or willingness to relocate. Why join us?
• Work on innovative and strategic projects that are critical to the company’s security.
• Grow in a dynamic, technically challenging and ever-evolving environment. Der Geschäftsbereich ist für einige der wichtigsten Innovationen des Konzerns verantwortlich und unterstützt den Geschäftsbetrieb. Das Team von Identity Management Platforms widmet sich der Verwaltung von Nutzeridentitäten und Sicherheit in der gesamten Organisation. Wir sind für die Implementierung, Automatisierung und Überwachung von Authentifizierungs-, Berechtigungs- und Zugriffskontrolllösungen für alle Anwendungen und Infrastrukturen verantwortlich. Unsere Mission ist es, einen sicheren, nahtlosen und konformen Zugang für alle Nutzer zu gewährleisten und unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern und die neuesten Technologien zu übernehmen. Ihre Rolle
• Entwicklung, Bereitstellung und Wartung von IAM-Plattformen und -Lösungen in Cloud- und Hybridumgebungen.
• Automatische Integration, Bereitstellung und Identität/Access-Management-Prozesse mit DevOps-Tools.
• enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sicherheits-, Infrastruktur- und Entwicklungsteams, um die Einhaltung und Sicherheit des Zugangs zu gewährleisten.
• Beitrag zur Definition und Umsetzung von Sicherheits-, Audit- und Zugangsmanagement-Politiken.
• Überwachen, diagnostizieren und lösen IAM-bezogene Vorfälle und Probleme.
• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden mit den neuesten Trends und Fortschritten in IAM und DevOps Technologien Ihr Profil
• Höhere Bildung in der Informatik oder gleichwertige Erfahrung.
• Signifikante Erfahrung in der DevOps-Engineering mit tiefem Verständnis von Kubernetes und Container-Orchestrierung.
• Proficiency in Software-Handwerkspraktiken, Programmierung und API-Design (Python, Java, Go, Bash oder gleichwertig).
• Erfahrung mit Cloud-Systemen wie Azure oder Amazon und Infrastruktur-as-Code-Konfiguration.
• Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifende Debuggings über Anwendungs- und Infrastrukturebenen durchzuführen.
• Umfassendes Verständnis von Systemarchitektur und Plattformkomponenten.
• Teamgeist, Autonomie, Strenge und Fähigkeit, in einer agilen Umgebung zu arbeiten.
• Flöent auf Französisch und Englisch.
• Schweizer Einwohner oder Verlagerungsbereitschaft. Warum bei uns?
• Arbeiten Sie an innovativen und strategischen Projekten, die für die Sicherheit des Unternehmens entscheidend sind.
• Wachsen Sie in einer dynamischen, technisch anspruchsvollen und sich ständig weiterentwickelnden Umgebung. La division est responsable de certaines des principales innovations du Groupe tout en soutenant les opérations commerciales. L'équipe Identity Management Platforms est dédiée à la gestion de l'identité des utilisateurs et de la sécurité dans toute l'organisation. Nous sommes responsables de la mise en œuvre, de l'automatisation et du contrôle des solutions d'authentification, d'autorisation et de contrôle d'accès pour toutes les applications et infrastructures. Notre mission est d'assurer un accès sécurisé, transparent et conforme pour tous les utilisateurs, tout en améliorant continuellement nos processus et en adoptant les dernières technologies. Votre rôle
• Concevoir, déployer et entretenir des plateformes et des solutions IAM dans les environnements Cloud et hybrides.
• Automatiser les processus d'intégration, de déploiement et de gestion d'identité/accès en utilisant les outils DevOps.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes chargées de la sécurité, de l'infrastructure et du développement pour assurer le respect et la sécurité de l'accès.
• Contribuer à la définition et à la mise en œuvre des politiques de sécurité, d'audit et de gestion de l'accès.
• Surveiller, diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents et les problèmes liés à l'IAM.
• Restez au courant des dernières tendances et des progrès des technologies IAM et DevOps Votre profil
• Enseignement supérieur en informatique ou expérience équivalente.
• Expérience significative en ingénierie DevOps avec une compréhension approfondie des Kubernetes et de l'orchestration des conteneurs.
• Compétence en artisanat logiciel, programmation et conception d'API (Python, Java, Go, Bash ou équivalent).
• Expérience avec les systèmes Cloud comme Azure ou Amazon et la configuration infrastructure-as-code.
• Capacité d'effectuer un débogage interfonctionnel à la fois pour les applications et les infrastructures.
• Compréhension complète de l'architecture du système et des composants de la plate-forme.
• Esprit d'équipe, autonomie, rigueur et capacité à travailler dans un environnement agile.
• En français et en anglais.

• Travailler sur des projets innovants et stratégiques qui sont essentiels à la sécurité de l'entreprise.
• Se développer dans un environnement dynamique, techniquement difficile et en constante évolution. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. Your role The scope of the function is to oversee all the workflow from the trade reception, data analysis and life cycle data management to instruments pricing. The scope of asset includes listed products (equities, bonds, loan, derivatives), OTC products (IRS,CDS, FX & Equity options, TRS, CFD…) and Structured products (autocall, Reverse convertible, dual currency deposit, accumulator, Airbag…).
• Integration and control of assets opening in our global platform Neoxam.
• Control and publish prices, greeks, market data and analytics.
• Life cycle management of all Assets.
• Set up the necessary files to complement these feeds.
• Introduce the necessary settings for queries and Data/pricing flows for securities newly registered in our systems from our various financial information providers (Bloomberg, SIX, Reuters and ICE).
• Regularly check and update these settings.
• Provide the assistance requested by the various users of these Data (accountants for investment funds, valuers, administrators, asset managers, wealth managers, etc.).
• Challenge of various assets type with the counterparty's prices.
• Liaise directly with our main stakeholders in case of issue. Your profile Requested experience:
• Master’s degree in Finance, economics.
• 2 to 5 years’ experience minimum in a similar position. Knowledge / technical skills:
• Good knowledge of financial products and good level in financial mathematic.
• Good knowledge of financial information providers.
• Skilled user of office software applications, especially Excel. Soft skills:
• Driven and capable of showing initiative in solving problems.
• An enquiring mind with strong learning skills and a well-developed critical faculty.
• Accuracy and thoroughness in searching for the information required to value securities.
• Good capacity to collaborate and find win-win solution. Language skills:
• French: fluent level
• English: good knowledge (written and spoken) Note We will not accept any CVs from agencies. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description. Flexible and modern ways of working As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave. Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. You will be a member of the Quality Control & Mobile team , reporting to the head of the team. In this role you will work on quality-control-related activities for the three teams ( Fund Accounting, Transfer Agency and Private Equity ) and occasionally provide support to the production teams during peak periods. Your role You will assist our Quality Control & Mobile team for the fund operations processes :
• Providing support operational teams in their daily tasks,
• Identifying areas of improvement in terms of the process and control framework,
• Contributing to the implementation of key quality control deliverables such as KPIs and the procedure framework review,
• Contributing to any other transversal project aimed at improving service delivery. Your profile Qualifications and experience:
• Pursuing a university degree in Finance, Economics or a related field. Specific knowledge:
• Knowledge in fund operations,
• Experience in process and data analysis,
• Project management and organizational skills,
• Good Excel and PowerPoint skills. Language skills:
• Spoken fluency in English and French. Personal qualities:
• Flexibility and agility,
• Strong interpersonal skills that enable effective communication and collaboration with colleagues and clients. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. Il Gruppo Pictet Il Gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali gestori indipendenti di ricchezza e asset a livello mondiale. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo è rappresentato in 31 uffici situati nei principali centri finanziari del mondo, impiegando attualmente oltre 5.000 persone. Il Gruppo è di proprietà e gestito da pouf soci e distingue per uno spirito imprenditoriale e fedeltà. Pictet è presente a Zurigo dal 1982, dove impiega oltre 200 persone. La sede di Zurigo si trova al Leuenhof, uno degli edifici più storici della prestigiosa Bahnhofstrasse. Ruolo e Mansioni
• Stiamo cercando un Chef de Rang appassionato da unirsi al nostro team a Zurigo. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 31 offices in financial centers worldwide, currently employing more than 5’000 people. The group is owned and managed by eight partners and stands out as a company with an entrepreneurial spirit and loyalty. Pictet has been present in Zurich since 1982 where it employs over 200 people. The Zurich branch is located at the Leuenhof, one of the most historic buildings on the prestigious Bahnhofstrasse. We are looking for a passionate Chef de Rang to join our team in Zurich. As a key member of our motivated team, you will be working for Food & Beverage activities, in our beautiful premises in the heart of Zurich. You will bring your communication skills, your ability to work independently and your good knowledge of foreign languages to a service-oriented team that will appreciate your motivation, high quality standards and networked thinking. Your organizational skills and thoughtful approach to your work will enable you to maintain an overview even in hectic situations. You will use your sense of responsibility, pleasant manner and outstanding client focus to support our own staff as well as our clients. Your role You will manage the activities of the restaurant dedicated to the Bank's clients and management, as well as external and internal events (banquets and catering). You will be the main contact for the kitchen and reception teams and coordinate and perform all the Food & Beverage activities. As a Food & Beverage Coordinator, you provide a first-class Food & Beverage service with an emphasis on quality and always maintain absolute discretion. Working hours are primarily during office hours, with only occasional evening shifts. Your responsibilities include the following:
• Plan and organize client lunches and hospitality service with or without external catering service
• Ensure the setting up of lounges or banquets according to the reservation forecasts and menus
• Take orders and propose food and wine pairings, if necessary
• Manage the wine cellar in coordination with Geneva’s F&B team
• Monitor the service and ensure its excellence
• Help to prepare client-facing events
• Ensure the maintenance of the material (silverware, glasses...), as well as its inventory
• Perform general administrative duties
• Participate in the establishment and improvement of standards and procedures Your profile
• Hotel management training/apprenticeship
• At least 5 years of experience in a high-end hospitality environment or in a successful running restaurant
• Native German speaker, fluent in English and knowledge of French would be an advantage
• Service-oriented, smart and confident appearance
• Must be resident in Switzerland Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide,currently employing over 4600 people. Pictet has been present in Luxembourg since 1989 where it employs over 600 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. You will join the PETAL - Private Assets team, the Pictet Luxembourg Private Assets operational servicing entity.
• Start date : September 2026
• Duration : 6 months full time or 12 months in apprenticeship
• Mandatory : A tripartite internship agreement signed with your school Your role
• Perform daily checks to ensure that all transactions are recorded in due time.
• Understand the investment made by client (review of the prospectus).
• Analyze notices received from Private Equity, Real Estate and Private Debt funds to perform the booking accurately.
• Cash reconciliation.
• Assist the team with various tasks (draft annual accounts, reply to audit queries, prepare ad hoc reporting to clients,…
• Monitor team mailboxes and ensure continuity of operations. Your profile Qualifications and experience:
• Pursuing a Master or University degree in Finance/Economics/Engineering Specific knowledge:
• Prioritising and time management skills to address the volumes and urgent subjects
• Analytical mindset to investigate, analyse and understand our investments and counter parties communications
• Collaborative skills to navigate a multinational workplace Language skills:
• Written and spoken fluency in French and English Personal qualities:
• Adaptive and transversal knowledge capability to be able to communicate (in written and orally) with Petal teams
• Rigorous and attentive to detail.
• Team player who is approachable and flexible.
• Dynamic and possesses an enquiring mind. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. Your role
• Monitor orders for UCI share subscriptions/redemptions, transfers and conversions.
• Prepare and send out confirmations and reports to promoters, distributors and other fund intermediaries.
• Respond rapidly to different requests from clients (inside and outside the Group) to guarantee that a quality service is provided that meets the requirements of a demanding client.
• Manage client commissions and dividends for in-house and third-party funds.
• Manage events on Funds (in kind transfers, launches, liquidations…).
• Work on automating various configurations within the tool “Multifonds Global Investor”, primarily focusing on Fund setup, by implementing key controls.
• Play a coordinating role in fund-related events across teams, including fund launches, compartments, classes, mergers, and liquidations.
• Review Fund’s prospectuses to ensure alignment between promoter requests and system feasibility.
• Offer technical and functional support to other teams within the service. Your profile
• Extensive knowledge of the Transfer Agent business and all-round understanding of fund administration processes
• Unversity degree in Economics or Finance
• 5 years' experience in similar position
• Fluent in french and english
• Excellent knowledge of the “MFGI - Multifonds Global Investor” tool and proven experience in its usage.
• Extensive knowledge of the Office suite.
• SQL knowledge is a must have.
• Flexibility
• Ability to handle stress.
• Rigor in checking, sending, confirming and monitoring orders.
• Enthusiasm and drive and ability to show initiative in solving problems.
• Enquiring mind and ability to learn quickly.
• Team player. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Your role Pictet is seeking to recruit a Marketing Manager (1-Year Contract) to work in the Marketing Asia - HKG team to support and coordinate marketing activities for Pictet Asset Management in Asia excluding Japan, contributing to brand visibility and business development in the region.
• Coordinate and execute regional marketing strategies and campaigns, including advertising, events, web, social media, and other marketing initiatives.
• Assist in the development and production of marketing collaterals, from information and data collection through to distribution, ensuring consistency with brand guidelines.
• Monitor the publication of global marketing content and support local content production and translation, liaising with external service providers as needed.
• Demonstrate creativity in developing innovative marketing campaigns and designing thoughtful client gifts that are highly valued and appreciated by recipients.
• Work closely with internal stakeholders, including local business teams, compliance, and headquarter marketing counterparts, to deliver marketing activities.
• Help maintain and update the firm’s web, digital, and social media platforms, ensuring content is accurate and engaging.
• Manage relationships with external vendors for the production of marketing assets, campaigns, events, and other communications materials.
• Track and report on marketing performance using analytics and KPIs, providing insights for ongoing improvement. Your profile
• University graduate in Marketing, Communications, or a relevant discipline.
• 5-10 years of solid marketing and communications experience in financial institutions is highly preferred.
• Strong attention to detail and creativity.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and desktop publishing tools.
• Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) in English and Chinese.
• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a diverse, multicultural environment.
• A proactive, results-oriented team player with a passion for marketing. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. The Role is to provide 1st level support on Fund Admnistration activities. To centralise, coordinate, and respond to Clients, Business Lines & Auditors requests and contribute to improvements of the processes, procedures and operational platforms to guarantee the proper application of controls and consistently exceed client’s needs and expectations. Your role
• Collaborate with Business Implementation Team, Client Relationship Managers (CRM), Management Companies and other key stakeholders (Custody Bank, Pricing, Transfer Agent (TA)…) on Projects & fund-related events.
• Act as the main liaison for both external and internal Clients, as well as Auditors, regarding all Fund Administration day-to-day activities.
• Manage the end-to-end Audit process for the funds, from initial planning & timetable, preparation and coordination of the financial statements to final approval and CSSF filling. Respond to Audit queries and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions and / or process improvement & automation as needed.
• Support Fund Administration Operations teams and effectively manage relationships across various business lines, including CRM, Business Implementation Team, TA , Tax, and others.
• Demonstrate a proactive mindset in addressing fund-related issues, actively challenge the status quo, and contribute innovative ideas for process enhancement.
• Participate in due diligence meetings, service reviews, Client visits, and Board meetings as required.
• Monitor internal and external KPIs and take actions when needed
• Manage and resolve internal and external escalations, taking appropriate actions and escalating to management when necessary.
• Assist in the review of Operating Memorandum, Service Level Agreements, Prospectus, internal policies, procedures working instructions & check-list, RCSA Matrix and any other related documentation.
• Remain up to date with all internal policies and ensure strict adherence to legal and regulatory requirements.
• Act as back-up of Head of Client Services and participate in the Management Committee of the Funds Accounting Unit when required Your profile
• Strong knowledge of financial products and funds regulation.
• Master's degree in Economics or Finance
• Min 10 years experience in Accounting
• Fluent in French and English
• In-depth understanding of Fund Administration and the relationships with the different stakeholders
• Experience in NAV calculations and NAV production
• Strong experience in financial reporting and audit process
• Good knowledge in foreign currency hedging and asset pooling techniques.
• Experience in fund events (merger, CIK/RIK, fund restructuring, etc.).
• Knowledge of Multifonds.
• Good knowledge in MS Office tool (mainly Excel).
• Flexibility - Can-do attitude
• Client oriented mindset.
• Sense of initiative and willing to learn.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Strong communication & presentation skills
• Rigorous and organized.
• Manage Stress and prioritization. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire principal des finances (contrat de 12 mois)

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra La divisione Corporate Functions comprende le attività non bancarie del Gruppo e comprende oltre 600 dipendenti. Personalizzato da specialisti con profonda competenza in tutte le linee aziendali, le funzioni centrali sono organizzate in vari dipartimenti di gruppo: Comunicazione, conformità, finanza, risorse umane, sicurezza dell'informazione, controllo interno, legale, ufficio aziendale, rischio e tassazione. Group Finance è dedicata a garantire una solida gestione finanziaria e reporting, supportando gli obiettivi strategici del Gruppo attraverso operazioni finanziarie efficaci, controlli interni forti e il rispetto dei requisiti normativi. Come membro della comunità delle Finanze del Gruppo, il Senior Finance Manager si unirà al team di Contabilità, Data & Reporting, segnalando al responsabile del reporting finanziario e delle soluzioni di reporting regolamentare. Il ruolo coinvolgerà una stretta collaborazione con tutti i membri del team Accounting, Data & Reporting, così come con altri team interni, per garantire l'efficace gestione delle operazioni finanziarie e reporting. Il tuo ruolo In qualità di Senior Finance Manager, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nella supervisione e nell'esecuzione dei processi finanziari fondamentali all'interno della funzione Finanza di Gruppo. Potrai sfruttare la tua forte competenza finanziaria e la comprensione del settore bancario per garantire l'accuratezza, l'integrità e la tempestività dei dati finanziari e la reportistica. Sarete responsabili dei seguenti compiti:
• Partecipare a progetti relativi alla finanza, compresi i miglioramenti dei processi, i miglioramenti del sistema e l'attuazione di nuovi requisiti normativi.
• supervisionare le operazioni finanziarie quotidiane, compresa la manutenzione dei dati, la riconciliazione e i controlli operativi per garantire l'accuratezza e la conformità.
• Contribuire alla preparazione e alla consegna delle relazioni finanziarie, regolamentari e gestionali, garantendo coerenza con gli standard normativi e le politiche interne.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con tutti i membri del team Accounting, Data & Reporting e altri stakeholder interni, inclusi i team Finance, Risk e IT, per raccogliere i requisiti, risolvere i problemi e guidare l'ottimizzazione dei processi.
• Sostenere gli audit interni ed esterni preparando la documentazione, rispondendo alle domande e alle raccomandazioni di attuazione.
• Mantenere il sistema di controllo interno (ICS), per garantire l'adesione alle politiche interne e alle normative esterne.
• Contribuire allo sviluppo e alla documentazione dei processi e delle procedure finanziarie. Il tuo profilo
• Laurea magistrale in Finanza o equivalente.
• Almeno dieci anni di esperienza nel settore bancario all’interno di un dipartimento di finanza e/o di audit esterno.
• Forte conoscenza della rendicontazione finanziaria, dei principi contabili e dei requisiti normativi nel settore bancario.
• Eccellente capacità analitiche e di problem solving, con la capacità di interpretare i dati finanziari complessi e fornire insight attuabili.
• Provata esperienza nella gestione delle operazioni finanziarie, dei controlli e dei processi di reporting.
• Forte proattività, adattabilità, autonomia, curiosità e un atteggiamento in grado di fare.
• Eccellente capacità di collaborazione, con la capacità di lavorare in modo efficace con gli stakeholder tecnici e funzionali.
• Fluente in francese e inglese.
• Deve essere residente in Svizzera. Nota Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie. Rif.: SFM/CC/SM Diversità e inclusione Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione sul posto di lavoro. Applicare Salva lavoro Email a un contatto Torna alla lista

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team The Corporate Functions division encompasses the Group’s non-banking activities and comprises over 600 employees. Staffed by specialists with deep expertise across all business lines, the central functions are organised into various group departments: Communication, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Corporate Office, Risk, and Taxation. Group Finance is dedicated to ensuring robust financial management and reporting, supporting the Group’s strategic objectives through effective financial operations, strong internal controls, and compliance with regulatory requirements. As a member of the Group Finance community, the Senior Finance Manager will join the Accounting, Data & Reporting team, reporting to the Head of Financial Reporting and Regulatory Reporting Solutions. The role will involve close collaboration with all members of the Accounting, Data & Reporting team, as well as with other internal teams, to ensure the effective management of financial operations and reporting. Your role As a Senior Finance Manager, you will play a key role in overseeing and executing core financial processes within the Group Finance function. You will leverage your strong finance expertise and understanding of the banking industry to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of financial data and reporting. You will be responsible for the following tasks:
• Participate in finance-related projects, including process improvements, system enhancements, and implementation of new regulatory requirements.
• Oversee daily financial operations, including data maintenance, reconciliations, and operational controls to ensure accuracy and compliance.
• Contribute to the preparation and delivery of financial, regulatory and management reports, ensuring consistency with both regulatory standards and internal policies.
• Collaborate closely with all members of the Accounting, Data & Reporting team and other internal stakeholders, including Finance, Risk, and IT teams, to gather requirements, resolve issues, and drive process optimization.
• Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, responding to queries, and implementing recommendations.
• Maintain the Internal Control System (ICS), to ensure adherence to internal policies and external regulations.
• Contribute to the development and documentation of finance processes and procedures. Your profile
• Master’s degree in Finance or equivalent.
• At least ten years’ experience in the banking industry within a Finance department and/or in external audit.
• Strong knowledge of financial reporting, accounting principles, and regulatory requirements in the banking sector.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and provide actionable insights.
• Proven experience in managing financial operations, controls, and reporting processes.
• Strong proactivity, adaptability, autonomy, curiosity, and a can-do attitude.
• Excellent collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and functional stakeholders.
• Fluent in French and English.
• Must be a resident in Switzerland. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies. Ref. : SFM/CC/SM Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.de:
Ihr Team Der Geschäftsbereich Corporate Functions umfasst die Nicht-Banking-Aktivitäten des Konzerns und umfasst über 600 Mitarbeiter. Die zentralen Funktionen werden von Spezialisten mit fundierter Expertise in allen Geschäftsbereichen in verschiedene Gruppenabteilungen organisiert: Kommunikation, Compliance, Finanzen, Humanressourcen, Informationssicherheit, Interne Audit, Recht, Corporate Office, Risiko und Steuern. Die Group Finance ist darauf ausgerichtet, ein robustes Finanzmanagement und eine solide Berichterstattung zu gewährleisten, die strategischen Ziele der Gruppe durch effektive Finanzoperationen, starke interne Kontrollen und die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen zu unterstützen. Als Mitglied der Group Finance Community wird der Senior Finance Manager dem Team Accounting, Data & Reporting beitreten und dem Leiter Financial Reporting und Regulatory Reporting Solutions melden. Die Rolle wird eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit allen Mitgliedern des Teams Accounting, Data & Reporting sowie mit anderen internen Teams beinhalten, um die effektive Verwaltung von Finanzgeschäften und Berichterstattung zu gewährleisten. Ihre Rolle Als Senior Finance Manager spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Überwachung und Durchführung von Kernfinanzprozessen innerhalb der Group Finance Funktion. Sie nutzen Ihre starke Finanzexpertise und das Verständnis der Bankenbranche, um die Richtigkeit, Integrität und Aktualität von Finanzdaten und Berichterstattung zu gewährleisten. Sie sind für folgende Aufgaben verantwortlich:

Your team Pictet Alternative Advisors is a leading alternative investment specialist with expertise in hedge funds, private equity and global real estate. The Geneva- and London-based team constructs, manages and advises on portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients. The Group has strong development ambitions for Pictet Alternative Advisors for the coming years, notably to expand its product offering to include additional asset classes and to further develop its institutional client base. In view of these developments, Pictet Alternative Advisors is looking to hire an Operations Officer to steer its development. Based in Geneva, you will be joining a busy team at the core of supporting a strong level of activity and growth across our alternative investments platform. You will provide operational support across a diversified range of investment strategies, as well as managed accounts. Your role
• Managing and coordinating operations linked to the investment teams (Products and mandates)
• Providing support for the investment teams, management and internal clients.
• Monitoring NAV calculations, FX hedging, reporting, transactions and client services.
• Coordinating with all service providers (legal, tax, compliance, administrators, back-office, etc.).
• Monitoring risks and investment constraints.
• Working on various occasional and recurrent projects (e.g. TER calculations).
• Optimising and automating processes (IT development). Your profile
• At least five years’ experience in a similar role in a fund department or with an asset manager.
• Proven practical knowledge of alternative products (Hedge Funds, Private Equity, Real Estate) operations management.
• Rigorous, with excellent numeracy skills and a keen attention to detail.
• A certain ability to deal with issues/topics with specialists from various businesses (investment managers, tax, compliance, etc.), with excellent verbal and writing skills in these particular situations.
• Advanced user of Excel and generally at ease with new IT systems. Ideally with an AI interest or experience.
• At ease expressing yourself in both French and English, with the relevant written proficiency to draft documentation and discuss complex matters with both internal and external parties, whether native speakers or not.
• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate. As the chosen applicant you will show energy and enthusiasm in your work and be rigorous in your approach. You will also stand out owing to your excellent teamworking skills. Furthermore, you will be trustworthy, able to show discretion and keep in mind that client’s interests and excellence in what you deliver is what matters the most. • Coordination avec tous les prestataires de services (juridique, fiscal, conformité, administrateurs, back-office, etc.).
• Suivi des risques et des contraintes d'investissement.
• Travail sur divers projets occasionnels et récurrents (par exemple calculs TER).
• Optimisation et automatisation des processus (développement des technologies de l'information). Votre profil
• Au moins cinq ans d'expérience dans un rôle similaire dans un département de fonds ou avec un gestionnaire d'actifs.
• Connaissance pratique éprouvée de la gestion des opérations de produits alternatifs (fonds de couverture, fonds d'investissement privés, immobilier).
• Rigieuse, avec d'excellentes compétences en calcul et une attention particulière au détail.
• Une certaine capacité à traiter des questions/thèmes avec des spécialistes de diverses entreprises (gestionnaires d'investissements, fiscalité, conformité, etc.), avec d'excellentes compétences verbales et écrites dans ces situations particulières.
• Utilisateur avancé d'Excel et généralement à l'aise avec les nouveaux systèmes informatiques. Idéalement avec un intérêt ou une expérience d'IA.
• À l'aise de s'exprimer en français et en anglais, avec la compétence écrite nécessaire pour rédiger la documentation et discuter de questions complexes avec les parties internes et externes, qu'elles soient ou non de langue maternelle.
• Doit résider en Suisse ou vouloir déménager. En tant que candidat choisi, vous ferez preuve d'énergie et d'enthousiasme dans votre travail et serez rigoureux dans votre approche. Vous vous démarquerez également en raison de vos excellentes compétences en travail d'équipe. De plus, vous serez digne de confiance, capable de faire preuve de discrétion et garder à l'esprit que les intérêts et l'excellence du client dans ce que vous livrez est ce qui compte le plus. Remarque Nous n'accepterons aucun CV par l'intermédiaire des agences Diversité et inclusion Pictet est un employeur à chances égales et s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. You will be a member of the Quality Control & Mobile team , reporting to the head of the team. In this role you will work on quality-control-related activities for the three teams ( Fund Accounting, Transfer Agency and Private Equity ) and occasionally provide support to the production teams during peak periods. Your role You will assist our Quality Control & Mobile team for the fund operations processes :
• Providing support operational teams in their daily tasks,
• Identifying areas of improvement in terms of the process and control framework,
• Contributing to the implementation of key quality control deliverables such as KPIs and the procedure framework review,
• Contributing to any other transversal project aimed at improving service delivery. Your profile Qualifications and experience:
• Pursuing a university degree in Finance, Economics or a related field. Specific knowledge:
• Knowledge in fund operations,
• Experience in process and data analysis,
• Project management and organizational skills,
• Good Excel and PowerPoint skills. Language skills:
• Spoken fluency in English and French. Personal qualities:
• Flexibility and agility,
• Strong interpersonal skills that enable effective communication and collaboration with colleagues and clients. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. 業務概要 オルタナティブ投資の中でも、プライベート資産（プライベートエクイティ、プライベートデット、不動産）およびこれらの低流動性資産を組み入れるマルチアセット戦略の開発を担当するプロダクトスペシャリストとして、受託者責任（fiduciary）および説明責任（accountability）を果たしつつ、ビジネスの拡大に貢献していただきます。 金融市場およびプライベート資産に関する専門知識を活かし、グローバル運用部門や営業部門など関連部署と連携しながら新規案件の獲得や既存案件の管理を行います。さらに、商品開発・マーケティング・バックオフィス等の社内ステークホルダーと協働し、クライアントニーズに即した商品組成やソリューション構築、マルチアセット戦略の開発に積極的に関与していただきます。 主な職務内容
• 顧客への運用ソリューションの提案
• 担当プロダクトの顧客向け説明およびビジネスデベロップメント活動（営業部門との協働）

• 担当プロダクトの運用状況の把握、運用報告会や運用報告書等での説明
• RFPや顧客からの質問への対応（RFPチームと協働）

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra

A Pictet, le nostre divisioni Technology and Operations lavorano in stretta collaborazione per fornire soluzioni innovative, sicure ed efficienti che spingono il successo del Gruppo. La divisione Technology sviluppa e integra soluzioni software avanzate, come sistemi di gestione del portafoglio, piattaforme di trading e applicazioni bancarie, giocando un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione digitale del Gruppo e nella creazione del valore del cliente. La divisione Operazioni garantisce il trattamento sicuro ed efficiente delle transazioni bancarie e dei fondi di investimento, mantenendo la conformità normativa e la gestione dei rischi operativi per supportare l'affidabilità dei nostri servizi finanziari.

Insieme, la tecnologia e le operazioni costituiscono la spina dorsale della capacità di Pictet di offrire esperienze client eccezionali, svolgendo un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione digitale del Gruppo e nella creazione di valore.

Sarai parte del team Finance Pictet Tech & Operations. Il team svolge un ruolo fondamentale nello sterzo finanziario della divisione, fornendo dati finanziari tempestivi e rilevanti e report nell'allineamento delle strategie finanziarie con gli obiettivi aziendali e fornendo informazioni attuabili agli stakeholder.

Il tuo ruolo

Come membro del team Finance Tech & Operations, possiederai lo sviluppo di dashboard finanziari, gestirai modelli di dati analitici finanziari, automatizza i processi di produzione di report e agirai come principale collegamento di finanza con il team Central Data Engineering. Contribuirai sia alla continuità operativa dei processi finanziari sia alla trasformazione a più lungo termine dell'analisi delle finanze all'interno della Pictet Technology and Operations.

• Assicurare la coerenza e l'integrità dei dati attraverso gli strati di reporting di finanza e le pipeline di dati a monte.
• Sviluppare e gestire il modello di dati analitici finanziari, assicurando che riflette con precisione le ultime opinioni analitiche.
• Guidare l'automazione dei processi di produzione e reporting dei dati finanziari, eliminando i flussi di lavoro manuali e migliorando l'affidabilità e la frequenza dei report finanziari.
• Progettazione, costruzione e manutenzione di cruscotti finanziari che coprono P&L per prodotto, allocazione dei costi e KPI operativi allineati con nuovo modello operativo.
• Supporto FP&A e attività di gestione contabile con analisi robuste e scalabili.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea magistrale in informatica, scienza dei dati, ingegneria o un campo correlato.
• 3-5 anni di esperienza come analista di dati – esperienza di collaborazione con i team finanziari è un vantaggio.
• Forte competenza in SQL, pitone e esperienza con strumenti di visualizzazione.
• Eccellente capacità analitiche e di problem solving, con un'attenta attenzione ai dettagli.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di collegare gli stakeholder tecnici (Data Engineering) e aziendali (Finance).
• Automotivato, proattivo e in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente.
• Volontà di imparare e adattarsi a nuove tecnologie e strumenti.
• Residente in Svizzera o disposto a trasferirsi.

Nota

Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie.

Ref.: FDA/CC/ FAA

Diversità e inclusione

Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione sul posto di lavoro.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

At Pictet, our Technology and Operations divisions work in close partnership to deliver innovative, secure, and efficient solutions that drive the Group’s success. The Technology division develops and integrates advanced software solutions, such as portfolio management systems, trading platforms, and banking applications – playing a key role in the Group’s digital transformation and client value creation. The Operations division ensures the secure and efficient processing of banking transactions and investment funds, maintaining regulatory compliance and managing operational risks to support the reliability of our financial services.

Together, Technology and Operations form the backbone of Pictet’s ability to deliver outstanding client experiences, playing a key role in the Group’s digital transformation and value creation.

You will be part of the Finance Pictet Tech & Operations team. The team plays a pivotal role in the financial steering of the division, by providing timely, relevant financial data and reports in aligning financial strategies with business objectives and delivering actionable insights to stakeholders.

Your role

As a member of the Finance Tech & Operations team, you will own the development of financial dashboards, manage finance analytical data models, automate reporting production processes, and act as the primary Finance liaison with the Central Data Engineering team. You will contribute to both the operational continuity of financial processes and the longer-term transformation of Finance analytics within Pictet Technology and Operations.

• Ensure data consistency and integrity across finance reporting layers and upstream data pipelines.
• Develop and manage the finance analytical data model, ensuring it accurately reflects latest analytical views.
• Drive the automation of finance data production and reporting processes, eliminating manual workflows and enhancing the reliability and frequency of financial reporting.
• Design, build, and maintain financial dashboards covering P&L by product, cost allocation, and operational KPIs aligned with new operating model.
• Support FP&A and management accounting activities with robust, scalable analytics.

Your profile

• Master’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field.
• 3-5 years of experience as a data analyst – experience collaborating with finance teams is a plus.
• Strong proficiency in SQL, python, and experience with visualisation tools.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical (Data Engineering) and business (Finance) stakeholders.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently.
• Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and tools.
• Resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Ref. : FDA/CC/FAA

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.
